canonical_question: What is the maximum investment limit in Public Provident Fund (PPF) in a financial year?
alternate_phrasings: PPF me ek saal me kitna paisa jama kar sakte hain?
Can I deposit more than 1.5 lakh in PPF?
PPF maximum deposit limit per year
short_answer: The maximum statutory investment limit in a Public Provident Fund (PPF) account is ₹1,50,000 per financial year across all accounts held by an individual, including deposits made on behalf of a minor.
detailed_answer: Under the Public Provident Fund Scheme, 2019, notified by the Ministry of Finance, an individual can deposit a minimum of ₹500 and a maximum of ₹1,50,000 in a financial year (April 1 to March 31). This ₹1.5 lakh ceiling applies cumulatively to all PPF accounts operated under the same PAN, including any account opened as a guardian on behalf of a minor child. Any deposit exceeding ₹1,50,000 in a financial year is treated as irregular: it earns zero interest and does not qualify for tax deductions under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act.

hi.short_answer: पब्लिक प्रोविडेंट फंड (PPF) में एक वित्तीय वर्ष में अधिकतम ₹1,50,000 तक जमा किए जा सकते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: पब्लिक प्रोविडेंट फंड स्कीम, 2019 के तहत एक वित्तीय वर्ष (1 अप्रैल से 31 मार्च) में न्यूनतम ₹500 और अधिकतम ₹1,50,000 जमा किए जा सकते हैं। यह ₹1.5 लाख की सीमा स्वयं के खाते और नाबालिग बच्चे के खाते दोनों को मिलाकर लागू होती है। ₹1.5 लाख से अधिक जमा की गई राशि पर कोई ब्याज नहीं मिलता और न ही सेक्शन 80C के तहत टैक्स छूट मिलती है।

hinglish.short_answer: PPF account me ek financial year me maximum deposit limit ₹1,50,000 hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: PPF Scheme 2019 ke anusar ek saal me minimum ₹500 aur maximum ₹1.5 lakh deposit kiya ja sakta hai. Yeh limit self account aur minor child ke account dono ko milakar calculate hoti hai. ₹1.5 lakh se upar deposit karne par na to interest milta hai aur na hi 80C tax deduction.

supporting_claims.claim: Maximum deposit limit in PPF is ₹1,50,000 per financial year across self and minor accounts.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Government Savings Promotion General Rules, 2018 & PPF Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 4

supporting_claims.claim: Deposits exceeding ₹1.5 lakh earn no interest and are refunded without interest.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance GSR Notification 915(E)

source_title: Public Provident Fund Scheme, 2019 Notification GSR 915(E)
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Statutory cap reaffirmed under Section 80C and Small Savings Scheme rules.

canonical_question: Why should PPF deposits be made on or before the 5th of every month?
alternate_phrasings: PPF interest calculation 5th of month rule
PPF me interest kab calculate hota hai?
Best date to deposit money in PPF
short_answer: PPF interest is calculated on the lowest balance between the close of the 5th day and the end of the calendar month. Depositing by the 5th ensures you earn interest on that deposit for that entire month.
detailed_answer: As per statutory PPF interest computation rules, interest is calculated on the minimum balance maintained in the account between the close of the 5th day and the last day of each calendar month. If funds are deposited on or after the 6th day of any month, that deposit is excluded from interest calculations for that month, effectively earning zero interest for that period. Although interest is calculated monthly, it is compounded and credited to the account once annually on March 31st.

hi.short_answer: PPF में ब्याज की गणना महीने के 5वें दिन की समाप्ति और महीने के अंत के बीच के न्यूनतम बैलेंस पर होती है। 5 तारीख तक जमा करने पर पूरे महीने का ब्याज मिलता है।
hi.detailed_answer: सरकारी नियमों के अनुसार, PPF खाते में ब्याज की गणना हर महीने की 5 तारीख की समाप्ति से लेकर महीने के अंतिम दिन के बीच के सबसे कम बैलेंस पर की जाती है। यदि 6 तारीख या उसके बाद पैसा जमा किया जाता है, तो उस महीने उस जमा राशि पर कोई ब्याज नहीं मिलता। गणना मासिक होती है, लेकिन ब्याज खाते में हर साल 31 मार्च को क्रेडिट किया जाता है।

hinglish.short_answer: PPF interest har mahine ki 5th date ke close aur month-end ke lowest balance par count hota hai. 5th tak deposit karne se us month ka pura interest milta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Agar aap 5th date ya usse pehle PPF me deposit karte hain, to us deposit par current month ka interest milta hai. 6th date ya baad me deposit karne par us month ka interest zero ho jata hai aur interest agle month se shuru hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Interest is calculated on the lowest balance between the close of the 5th day and the end of the month.
supporting_claims.citation_source: PPF Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 6(1)

source_title: PPF Scheme 2019 Rules on Interest Calculation
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Crucial operational timing rule for all small savers.

canonical_question: Can an NRI continue an existing PPF account after moving abroad?
alternate_phrasings: NRI PPF account rules
Can NRI extend PPF after 15 years?
NRI banne ke baad PPF account ka kya hota hai?
short_answer: Yes, an Indian resident who opened a PPF account and subsequently becomes a Non-Resident Indian (NRI) can continue the account until its 15-year maturity on a non-repatriable basis, but cannot extend it further.
detailed_answer: Non-Resident Indians are prohibited from opening new PPF accounts. However, if an account was lawfully opened while the individual was a resident Indian, they are permitted to maintain the existing account until its 15-year maturity period expires. All deposits and interest earned will be held on a non-repatriable basis. Crucially, once the 15-year tenure completes, NRIs cannot extend the account for 5-year blocks either with or without contributions.

hi.short_answer: हां, यदि खाता निवासी भारतीय रहते हुए खोला गया था, तो NRI बनने के बाद भी 15 साल की परिपक्वता तक खाता जारी रखा जा सकता है, लेकिन इसे आगे नहीं बढ़ाया जा सकता।
hi.detailed_answer: अनिवासी भारतीय (NRI) नया PPF खाता नहीं खोल सकते। लेकिन यदि खाता भारतीय नागरिक रहते हुए खोला गया था, तो वह 15 वर्ष की परिपक्वता तक जारी रहेगा। परिपक्वता के बाद NRI इसे 5 साल के ब्लॉक में आगे (extend) नहीं बढ़ा सकते।

hinglish.short_answer: Haan, resident rehte hue open kiya gaya PPF account NRI banne ke baad 15 years maturity tak continue kar sakte hain, par extend nahi kar sakte.
hinglish.detailed_answer: NRI naya PPF account nahi khol sakte, lekin purana active account 15 years tak chala sakte hain. 15 years complete hone ke baad NRIs ko account close karna hota hai, extension allow nahi hoti.

supporting_claims.claim: NRIs cannot open fresh PPF accounts but can retain existing accounts till 15-year maturity without extension.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance Office Memorandum No. 1/3/2017-NS and Public Provident Fund Scheme 2019

source_title: Ministry of Finance Clarification on PPF Accounts of Non-Resident Indians
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs
reviewer_notes: Reconciled with 2018 DEA rollback of immediate closure notification.

canonical_question: What is the premature withdrawal penalty and rule for PPF accounts after 5 years?
alternate_phrasings: PPF se 5 saal baad kitna paisa nikal sakte hain?
PPF premature closure grounds and penalty
Partial withdrawal limit in PPF
short_answer: Premature closure of a PPF account is permitted after 5 financial years for life-threatening medical treatment, higher education, or change of residency, subject to a 1% interest rate penalty.
detailed_answer: Under Rule 13 of the PPF Scheme 2019, premature closure of the entire PPF account is allowed only after the completion of 5 full financial years from the year of account opening, under three strict conditions: (1) Treatment of life-threatening disease of the account holder, spouse, dependent children or parents; (2) Higher education expenses of the account holder or dependent children; or (3) Change of residency status of the account holder. Upon premature closure, interest is recalculated at a rate 1% lower than the prevailing rate applicable for each year the account was held.

hi.short_answer: PPF खाता 5 वित्तीय वर्ष पूरे होने पर गंभीर बीमारी, उच्च शिक्षा या नागरिकता बदलाव के आधार पर 1% ब्याज कटौती के साथ समय पूर्व बंद किया जा सकता है।
hi.detailed_answer: PPF स्कीम 2019 के नियम 13 के तहत 5 पूर्ण वित्तीय वर्ष के बाद खाता समय पूर्व बंद (premature closure) किया जा सकता है। इसके लिए मेडिकल इमरजेंसी, बच्चों की उच्च शिक्षा या विदेश में निवास का प्रमाण देना होता है। समय पूर्व बंद करने पर पूरे कार्यकाल के दौरान मिले ब्याज में से 1% की कटौती की जाती है।

hinglish.short_answer: 5 financial years complete hone ke baad medical emergency, higher education ya NRI status change par 1% interest penalty ke saath PPF account close ho sakta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: PPF account ko 5 saal baad band karne ke liye valid proof dena hota hai. Account opening se lekar closure tak ke pure interest rate me se 1% deduct karke balance payout kiya jata hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Premature closure is allowed after 5 financial years with a 1% deduction in interest rate.
supporting_claims.citation_source: PPF Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 13

source_title: PPF Scheme 2019 Premature Closure Conditions
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Distinct from partial withdrawal (Form 2) which has no penalty.

canonical_question: What is the maximum age limit of a girl child to open a Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) account?
alternate_phrasings: Sukanya Samriddhi me ladki ki age kitni honi chahiye?
Can I open SSY account for 11 year old daughter?
SSY entry age limit
short_answer: The maximum age limit for a girl child to open a Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana account is 10 years at the time of account opening.
detailed_answer: Under the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019, notified by the Ministry of Finance, an account can be opened by the natural or legal guardian in the name of a girl child from her birth up to the age of 10 years. An official birth certificate issued by the competent municipal or registrar authority is mandatory proof of age. Once a girl child completes 10 years of age, she becomes ineligible for a fresh SSY account opening.

hi.short_answer: सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना (SSY) खाता खोलने के लिए बालिका की अधिकतम आयु 10 वर्ष है।
hi.detailed_answer: सुकन्या समृद्धि खाता योजना, 2019 के अनुसार, माता-पिता या कानूनी अभिभावक बालिका के जन्म से लेकर उसके 10 वर्ष की आयु पूरी करने तक यह खाता खोल सकते हैं। इसके लिए जन्म प्रमाण पत्र प्रस्तुत करना अनिवार्य है।

hinglish.short_answer: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) account open karne ke liye girl child ki maximum age 10 saal honi chahiye.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Parents apni beti ke birth se lekar 10 saal ki age tak post office ya authorized bank me SSY account open karwa sakte hain. 10 saal se badi hone par account open nahi kiya ja sakta.

supporting_claims.claim: Account can be opened for a girl child till she attains the age of 10 years.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 3(1)

source_title: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019 GSR 914(E)
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Statutory age limit strictly enforced by post offices and banks.

canonical_question: How many Sukanya Samriddhi accounts can be opened in one family?
alternate_phrasings: Can twins have 3 SSY accounts?
Kya 3 betiyon ke liye Sukanya account khul sakta hai?
SSY rules for twins and triplets
short_answer: A family can open a maximum of two Sukanya Samriddhi accounts for two girl children, with an exception allowing a third account in the case of twin or triplet births.
detailed_answer: Under the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme 2019 rules, a parent or guardian can open only one account per girl child and a maximum of two accounts in a family for two girl children. A third account is permitted only if twin or triplet girls are born in the first birth, or if twin girls are born after the first girl child, supported by a medical certificate from an authorized medical institution.

hi.short_answer: एक परिवार में अधिकतम दो बालिकाओं के लिए दो सुकन्या खाते खोले जा सकते हैं। जुड़वा या तीन बच्चियों के जन्म पर तीसरा खाता अनुमन्य है।
hi.detailed_answer: नियमों के अनुसार, एक परिवार में अधिकतम दो बेटियों के नाम पर सुकन्या समृद्धि खाते खोले जा सकते हैं। यदि पहले प्रसव में या पहले बच्चे के बाद जुड़वा/तीन बेटियों का जन्म होता है, तो मेडिकल सर्टिफिकेट के आधार पर तीसरे खाते की अनुमति दी जाती है।

hinglish.short_answer: Ek family me maximum 2 girl children ke liye SSY accounts open ho sakte hain. Twins ya triplets ke case me 3 accounts allowed hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Standard rule ke mutabiq per family 2 accounts allowed hain. Agar pehli delivery me ya pehli beti ke baad twins betiyan paida hoti hain to medical proof ke sath 3rd account open kiya ja sakta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Maximum of two accounts per family, with exception for twin/triplet births.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 3(2)

source_title: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme Rules on Family Limits
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Third account requires hospital certificate verifying multiple birth.

canonical_question: What is the lock-in period and maturity tenure of Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana?
alternate_phrasings: Is SSY tenure 15 years or 21 years?
Sukanya Samriddhi ka paisa kitne saal me milta hai?
SSY 15 year deposit vs 21 year maturity rule
short_answer: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana matures after 21 years from the date of account opening or upon the marriage of the girl child after attaining 18 years of age. Deposits are required for the first 15 years.
detailed_answer: The SSY account has a total maturity tenure of 21 years from the date of opening. Contributions are required to be made for the first 15 years only. From year 16 to year 21, no further deposits are accepted, but the accumulated corpus continues to earn compounded interest at the prevailing scheme rate. The account can be closed early upon the girl child's marriage after attaining 18 years of age, provided the marriage application is submitted between 1 month prior to and 3 months after the wedding date.

hi.short_answer: सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना खाता खोलने की तारीख से 21 वर्ष बाद परिपक्व होता है। इसमें केवल पहले 15 वर्षों तक पैसे जमा करने होते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: खाते की कुल परिपक्वता अवधि 21 वर्ष है। इसमें केवल शुरुआती 15 वर्षों तक सालाना न्यूनतम ₹250 जमा करने होते हैं। 16वें से 21वें वर्ष तक कोई पैसा जमा नहीं करना होता, लेकिन ब्याज लगातार मिलता रहता है। बालिका की आयु 18 वर्ष पूरी होने के बाद उसके विवाह के समय भी खाता बंद किया जा सकता है।

hinglish.short_answer: SSY account 21 saal me mature hota hai. Isme shuru ke 15 saal deposit karna hota hai aur baaki 6 saal bina deposit ke compound interest milta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Total tenure 21 years hai. 15 saal deposit tenure ke baad 16 se 21 saal tak interest continue rehta hai. Beti ki 18 saal ki age ke baad marriage par account mature karwaya ja sakta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Tenure is 21 years from account opening; deposits required for 15 years.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 11

source_title: SSY Maturity and Tenure Statutory Provisions
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Key distinction: 15-year deposit tenure vs 21-year maturity tenure.

canonical_question: What is the maximum investment limit in Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS)?
alternate_phrasings: SCSS limit 15 lakh or 30 lakh?
Senior Citizen Savings Scheme me maximum kitna invest kar sakte hain?
SCSS joint account maximum limit for spouses
short_answer: The maximum investment limit in Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS) is ₹30,00,000 per individual, enhanced from ₹15 lakh in the Union Budget 2023.
detailed_answer: Effective from April 1, 2023, the Ministry of Finance doubled the maximum deposit ceiling for the Senior Citizen Savings Scheme from ₹15 lakh to ₹30 lakh. Deposits must be made in multiples of ₹1,000 and cannot exceed the actual retirement benefits received if the individual retires between age 55 and 60. In joint accounts with a spouse, each spouse can invest up to ₹30 lakh in separate accounts if both independently meet the eligibility criteria, allowing a couple to invest up to ₹60 lakh combined.

hi.short_answer: सीनियर सिटीजन सेविंग्स स्कीम (SCSS) में अधिकतम निवेश सीमा ₹30,00,000 (तीस लाख रुपये) है।
hi.detailed_answer: केंद्रीय बजट 2023 के तहत SCSS की अधिकतम जमा सीमा ₹15 लाख से बढ़ाकर ₹30 लाख कर दी गई थी, जो 1 अप्रैल 2023 से प्रभावी है। यदि पति और पत्नी दोनों पात्र हैं, तो वे अलग-अलग खाते खोलकर कुल ₹60 लाख तक निवेश कर सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS) me maximum deposit limit ₹30,00,000 hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Budget 2023 me SCSS limit ko ₹15 lakh se badhakar ₹30 lakh kar diya gaya tha. Husband aur wife dono eligible hone par alag-alag accounts me total ₹60 lakh tak invest kar sakte hain.

supporting_claims.claim: Maximum deposit ceiling under SCSS is ₹30 lakh effective April 1, 2023.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance Notification GSR 240(E) dated 31st March 2023

source_title: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (Amendment) Rules, 2023
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Statutory enhancement confirmed in Gazette Notification GSR 240(E).

canonical_question: Can retired individuals aged 55 to 60 invest in SCSS?
alternate_phrasings: Can VRS employees open SCSS at age 55?
SCSS age relaxation for defense personnel and VRS retirees
55 saal me SCSS account khul sakta hai kya?
short_answer: Yes, retired civilian individuals aged 55 to 60 can invest in SCSS provided they invest within 3 months of receiving their retirement benefits, and retired defence personnel can invest from age 50.
detailed_answer: Under SCSS Scheme Rules, while the standard entry age is 60 years, two special concessions apply: (1) Retired civilian employees who retired on superannuation or under a Voluntary Retirement Scheme (VRS) between 55 and 60 years of age can open an account, provided the deposit is made within 3 months of receiving retirement benefits and does not exceed the total retirement proceeds; (2) Retired defence personnel (excluding civilian defence employees) are eligible from 50 years of age under identical retirement benefit conditions.

hi.short_answer: हां, 55 से 60 वर्ष के सेवानिवृत्त नागरिक कर्मचारी रिटायरमेंट लाभ मिलने के 3 महीने के भीतर SCSS में निवेश कर सकते हैं। रक्षा कर्मी 50 वर्ष की आयु से पात्र हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: 55 से 60 वर्ष के सेवानिवृत्त कर्मचारी (VRS या सामान्य सेवानिवृत्ति) रिटायरमेंट फंड मिलने के 3 माह के भीतर निवेश कर सकते हैं, बशर्ते निवेश राशि रिटायरमेंट लाभों से अधिक न हो। रक्षा सेवाओं से सेवानिवृत्त कर्मी 50 वर्ष की आयु से निवेश के पात्र हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Haan, 55 to 60 years ke retired employees retirement benefits milne ke 3 months ke andar SCSS me invest kar sakte hain. Defence personnel 50 saal se eligible hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Standard age 60 saal hai, lekin 55-60 saal ke retirees retirement benefits milne ke 3 months ke andar SCSS account khol sakte hain. Deposit amount unke actual retirement benefits se zyada nahi ho sakta.

supporting_claims.claim: Retirees aged 55-60 can invest within 3 months of retirement; defence retirees eligible from age 50.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme Rules, 2019, Paragraph 3

source_title: SCSS Eligibility Rules for Retired Personnel
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Three-month timeline strictly enforced from receipt of retirement check.

canonical_question: Is interest earned on Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB) taxable?
alternate_phrasings: Is SGB 2.5% interest tax free?
SGB maturity capital gains exemption under Income Tax
Sovereign Gold Bond par tax lagta hai kya?
short_answer: Yes, the 2.50% annual interest on Sovereign Gold Bonds is fully taxable according to the investor's income tax slab, but capital gains at maturity after 8 years are 100% tax-free for individuals.
detailed_answer: Sovereign Gold Bonds offer two income streams with distinct tax treatments: (1) The semi-annual interest paid at 2.50% per annum on the nominal value is fully taxable under the head 'Income from Other Sources' at the investor's marginal income tax slab. No TDS is deducted at payout. (2) The capital gains arising upon final redemption after the 8-year maturity period are completely exempt from capital gains tax for individual investors under Section 47(viic) of the Income Tax Act.

hi.short_answer: हां, सॉवरेन गोल्ड बॉन्ड (SGB) पर मिलने वाला 2.50% सालाना ब्याज टैक्स योग्य है, लेकिन 8 वर्ष की परिपक्वता पर कैपिटल गेंस पूरी तरह टैक्स-फ्री होता है।
hi.detailed_answer: SGB पर मिलने वाला 2.5% वार्षिक ब्याज निवेशक के इनकम टैक्स स्लैब के अनुसार कर योग्य होता है। हालांकि, इस पर TDS नहीं काटा जाता। 8 साल की परिपक्वता पर रिडेम्पशन से होने वाला पूंजीगत लाभ (Capital Gains) आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 47(viic) के तहत व्यक्तिगत निवेशकों के लिए 100% कर-मुक्त है।

hinglish.short_answer: Haan, SGB par milne wala 2.5% annual interest tax slab ke hisab se taxable hai, lekin 8 saal maturity par capital gains 100% tax-free hota hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: SGB ke semi-annual interest par income tax slab ke mutabiq tax lagta hai (par TDS nahi katta). 8-year maturity par redemption par capital gains tax Section 47(viic) ke tehat completely exempt hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Interest on SGB is taxable under Income Tax Act; capital gains on redemption for individuals are exempt.
supporting_claims.citation_source: RBI FAQs on Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme & Section 47(viic) of Income Tax Act

source_title: Reserve Bank of India Master Direction - Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme
source_publisher: Reserve Bank of India
reviewer_notes: Secondary market sale before 8 years incurs capital gains tax under revised Budget 2024 rules.

canonical_question: When can Sovereign Gold Bonds be prematurely redeemed through the RBI window?
alternate_phrasings: Can I redeem SGB before 8 years?
SGB 5 year early exit window rules
SGB premature redemption kaise kare?
short_answer: Premature redemption of Sovereign Gold Bonds through the RBI window is permitted after 5 years from the issue date, specifically on the coupon interest payment dates.
detailed_answer: Although Sovereign Gold Bonds have an overall tenure of 8 years, early encashment is permitted starting from the 5th year from the date of issue. Premature redemption through the RBI window can be executed only on the semi-annual coupon payment dates. Investors must submit their redemption request to their receiving office, bank, or depository participant at least 10 to 30 days prior to the coupon date. The redemption price is based on the simple average of the closing gold price (999 purity) published by IBJA for the preceding three working days.

hi.short_answer: सॉवरेन गोल्ड बॉन्ड (SGB) को जारी होने के 5 वर्ष पूरे होने के बाद, ब्याज भुगतान की तारीखों पर RBI विंडो के माध्यम से समय से पहले भुनाया जा सकता है।
hi.detailed_answer: SGB की कुल अवधि 8 वर्ष है, लेकिन 5वें वर्ष से समय पूर्व निकासी (premature redemption) की अनुमति होती है। यह केवल ब्याज भुगतान की तिथियों पर ही संभव है। इसके लिए कूपन तिथि से 10 से 30 दिन पहले बैंक या पोस्ट ऑफिस में आवेदन करना होता है। रिडेम्पशन मूल्य पिछले 3 कार्य दिवसों के IBJA सोने के औसत भाव पर तय होता है।

hinglish.short_answer: SGB ko 5 saal complete hone ke baad interest payout dates par RBI window ke through prematurely redeem kiya ja sakta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: 8 saal ke tenure me se 5th year ke baad early redemption option open hota hai. Yeh request coupon payment date se pehle bank me submit karni hoti hai aur payment IBJA ke 3-day average gold price par hoti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Premature redemption permitted from fifth year onwards on coupon payment dates.
supporting_claims.citation_source: RBI SGB Operational Guidelines, Paragraph 8

source_title: RBI Sovereign Gold Bond Operational Guidelines
source_publisher: Reserve Bank of India
reviewer_notes: Secondary market trading on stock exchanges provides liquidity before year 5.

canonical_question: How is the interest rate on RBI Floating Rate Savings Bonds (FRSB) determined?
alternate_phrasings: How is FRSB interest linked to NSC rate?
RBI floating rate bond spread over NSC
FRSB interest reset dates January and July
short_answer: The interest rate on RBI Floating Rate Savings Bonds is pegged to the National Savings Certificate (NSC) rate with a statutory spread of plus 0.35%, and resets semi-annually on January 1 and July 1.
detailed_answer: RBI Floating Rate Savings Bonds (FRSB) 2020 (Taxable) carry a floating coupon rate reset every six months by the Government of India. The coupon is mathematically benchmarked to the prevailing National Savings Certificate (NSC) rate plus a fixed spread of 35 basis points (+0.35%). For instance, when the NSC rate is 7.70%, the FRSB interest rate is fixed at 8.05%. Interest is paid semi-annually on January 1st and July 1st of each year, and there is no option for cumulative interest payout.

hi.short_answer: RBI फ्लोटिंग रेट सेविंग्स बॉन्ड की ब्याज दर NSC दर से 0.35% अधिक तय की जाती है और यह हर साल 1 जनवरी और 1 जुलाई को रीसेट होती है।
hi.detailed_answer: RBI FRSB बॉन्ड की ब्याज दर स्थिर नहीं होती। यह राष्ट्रीय बचत पत्र (NSC) की ब्याज दर से 35 बेसिस पॉइंट (+0.35%) अधिक तय की जाती है। यदि NSC की दर 7.7% है, तो FRSB की दर 8.05% होगी। ब्याज का भुगतान हर 6 महीने में 1 जनवरी और 1 जुलाई को सीधे बैंक खाते में किया जाता है।

hinglish.short_answer: RBI Floating Rate Bonds ka interest NSC rate se +0.35% zyada hota hai, jo har saal 1 January aur 1 July ko reset hota hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: FRSB bonds me floating rate system hota hai. Formula hai: NSC Interest Rate + 0.35%. Interest har 6 months me January 1 aur July 1 ko bank account me credit hota hai. Isme cumulative option nahi hota.

supporting_claims.claim: Coupon rate of FRSB is linked to NSC rate with a spread of (+) 35 bps and resets on Jan 1 and July 1.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Government of India Notification F.No.4(10)-B(W&M)/2020 dated June 26, 2020

source_title: Floating Rate Savings Bonds, 2020 (Taxable) Scheme Notification
source_publisher: Reserve Bank of India
reviewer_notes: Statutory spread formula guarantees FRSB always yields 35 bps higher than NSC.

canonical_question: Can RBI Floating Rate Savings Bonds be traded in secondary markets or pledged for loans?
alternate_phrasings: Can I take loan against RBI floating bonds?
Is FRSB liquid or transferable?
Can FRSB bonds be sold on stock exchange?
short_answer: No, RBI Floating Rate Savings Bonds are strictly non-transferable, cannot be traded in secondary markets, and cannot be pledged as collateral for bank loans.
detailed_answer: Unlike government securities and Sovereign Gold Bonds, RBI Floating Rate Savings Bonds (FRSB) are issued as Bond Ledger Accounts (BLA) managed by the Reserve Bank of India and authorized banks. They are strictly non-negotiable and non-transferable, except in the event of the holder's death to a designated nominee or legal heir. They cannot be traded on stock exchanges, sold to third parties, or pledged as collateral security to banks, NBFCs, or financial institutions.

hi.short_answer: नहीं, RBI फ्लोटिंग रेट सेविंग्स बॉन्ड गैर-हस्तांतरणीय हैं। इन्हें शेयर बाजार में बेचा नहीं जा सकता और न ही लोन के लिए गिरवी रखा जा सकता है।
hi.detailed_answer: RBI FRSB बॉन्ड को सेकेंडरी मार्केट में ट्रेड नहीं किया जा सकता। इन्हें बैंक लोन के लिए सुरक्षा या जमानत (collateral) के रूप में गिरवी रखने की अनुमति नहीं है। खाताधारक की मृत्यु की स्थिति में ही यह केवल नामांकित व्यक्ति को हस्तांतरित किए जा सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Nahi, RBI Floating Rate Bonds non-transferable hote hain. Inhe stock market me trade nahi kiya ja sakta aur na hi bank loan ke liye pledge kiya ja sakta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Yeh bonds Bond Ledger Account form me hote hain. Inhe secondary market me becha nahi ja sakta aur kisi bhi bank ya NBFC me collateral security ke taur par pledge karna prohibited hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Bonds are not transferable except to nominees and cannot be pledged for bank loans.
supporting_claims.citation_source: RBI FRSB 2020 Scheme Notification, Clause 13 & 14

source_title: RBI Guidelines on Floating Rate Savings Bonds Tradability and Collateral
source_publisher: Reserve Bank of India
reviewer_notes: Key liquidity limitation compared to Sovereign Gold Bonds.

canonical_question: What is the maximum investment limit for Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)?
alternate_phrasings: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate me kitna paisa jama kar sakte hain?
MSSC interest rate and 2 year tenure
Can a man open Mahila Samman Certificate?
short_answer: The maximum investment limit for Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC) is ₹2,00,000 per individual female account holder across all accounts.
detailed_answer: Under the Mahila Samman Savings Certificate Rules, 2023, notified by the Ministry of Finance, an eligible woman or a guardian on behalf of a minor girl can deposit a minimum of ₹1,000 and a maximum of ₹2,00,000. An investor may open multiple accounts, but a mandatory minimum gap of three months must be maintained between opening an existing account and a new account, and the aggregate balance across all accounts of the individual cannot exceed the ₹2 lakh ceiling.

hi.short_answer: महिला सम्मान बचत प्रमाणपत्र (MSSC) में अधिकतम निवेश सीमा ₹2,00,000 (दो लाख रुपये) है।
hi.detailed_answer: महिला सम्मान बचत प्रमाणपत्र योजना, 2023 के तहत किसी महिला या नाबालिग लड़की के नाम पर न्यूनतम ₹1,000 और अधिकतम ₹2,00,000 जमा किए जा सकते हैं। एक महिला एक से अधिक खाते खोल सकती है, लेकिन दो खातों के बीच 3 महीने का अंतर होना चाहिए और कुल जमा राशि ₹2 लाख से अधिक नहीं हो सकती।

hinglish.short_answer: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC) me maximum deposit limit ₹2,00,000 hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: MSSC scheme me minimum ₹1,000 aur maximum ₹2 lakh deposit kiya ja sakta hai. Multiple accounts open kiye ja sakte hain par do accounts ke beech me 3 months ka gap hona mandatory hai aur total balance ₹2 lakh se zyada nahi ho sakta.

supporting_claims.claim: Maximum deposit limit under MSSC is ₹2 lakh with 3-month gap between multiple accounts.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate Scheme, 2023, GSR 237(E) dated 31st March 2023

source_title: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate Scheme Rules, 2023
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Scheme tenure valid for deposits made up to March 31, 2025 unless extended.

canonical_question: What is the difference between National Savings Certificate (NSC) and Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP)?
alternate_phrasings: NSC vs KVP which is better?
Does KVP have 80C tax deduction like NSC?
KVP me kitne mahine me paisa double hota hai?
short_answer: NSC has a 5-year fixed tenure and qualifies for Section 80C tax deductions, whereas KVP has a 115-month doubling tenure, does not qualify for Section 80C deductions, but allows premature withdrawal after 2.5 years.
detailed_answer: National Savings Certificate (NSC VIII Issue) and Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) differ fundamentally across four criteria: (1) Tenure: NSC has a fixed 5-year tenure, while KVP matures when the principal doubles (currently 115 months at 7.5% interest); (2) Tax Benefits: Initial deposit and accrued interest in the first 4 years of NSC qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5 lakh (Old Tax Regime), whereas KVP offers zero Section 80C tax benefits; (3) Premature Withdrawal: NSC cannot be closed before 5 years except on death or court order, while KVP permits premature encashment after a 30-month (2.5 years) lock-in period; (4) Eligibility: Trusts can invest in KVP, while only individuals can invest in NSC.

hi.short_answer: NSC की अवधि 5 वर्ष है और इसमें सेक्शन 80C टैक्स छूट मिलती है, जबकि KVP का पैसा 115 महीने में दोगुना होता है, इसमें 80C छूट नहीं मिलती लेकिन 2.5 साल बाद निकासी संभव है।
hi.detailed_answer: NSC में 5 साल की लॉक-इन अवधि होती है और 80C के तहत ₹1.5 लाख तक टैक्स डिडक्शन मिलता है। इसके विपरीत KVP में 80C की कोई छूट नहीं मिलती, लेकिन इसमें 30 महीने (ढाई साल) के बाद समय से पहले पैसे निकालने (premature encashment) की सुविधा मिलती है। KVP में वर्तमान में 7.5% ब्याज पर पैसा 115 महीनों में दोगुना होता है।

hinglish.short_answer: NSC 5 saal ka tax-saving instrument hai jisme 80C deduction milta hai, jabki KVP 115 months me paisa double karta hai bina 80C tax benefit ke par 2.5 saal baad liquidity deta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: NSC me 5-year lock-in rehta hai aur 80C tax benefit milta hai. KVP me 80C nahi milta, par 30 months (2.5 years) ke baad premature withdrawal allow hota hai. KVP ka tenure paisa double hone tak hota hai (current 115 months).

supporting_claims.claim: NSC matures in 5 years with 80C tax deduction; KVP doubles in 115 months with 30-month lock-in and no 80C benefit.
supporting_claims.citation_source: National Savings Certificates (VIII Issue) Scheme 2019 & Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme 2019

source_title: Comparative Framework for NSC and KVP Schemes
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Both schemes carry identical sovereign guarantees from Ministry of Finance.

canonical_question: What is the maximum project cost and subsidy under PMEGP for manufacturing units?
alternate_phrasings: PMEGP me manufacturing ke liye kitna loan milta hai?
PMEGP 50 lakh manufacturing vs 20 lakh service limit
PMEGP margin money subsidy percentage urban rural
short_answer: The maximum eligible project cost under PMEGP for manufacturing units is ₹50 lakh, with a margin money subsidy of 15% to 35% (up to ₹17.5 lakh) depending on beneficiary category and urban or rural location.
detailed_answer: Under the revised Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) guidelines issued by the Ministry of MSME, the maximum project cost for establishing a new manufacturing enterprise was enhanced to ₹50 lakh (and ₹20 lakh for service units). Government subsidy (Margin Money) varies: (1) General category applicants receive 15% in urban areas and 25% in rural areas, requiring a 10% own contribution; (2) Special categories (SC, ST, OBC, Minorities, Women, Ex-servicemen, Differently-abled, NER, Hill and Border areas) receive 25% in urban areas and 35% in rural areas, requiring only a 5% own contribution. The maximum subsidy payable on a ₹50 lakh rural special-category project is ₹17.50 lakh.

hi.short_answer: PMEGP के तहत विनिर्माण (मैन्युफैक्चरिंग) इकाइयों के लिए अधिकतम परियोजना लागत ₹50 लाख है, जिस पर 15% से 35% (अधिकतम ₹17.5 लाख) तक सब्सिडी मिलती है।
hi.detailed_answer: सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यम मंत्रालय (MSME) के अनुसार, विनिर्माण क्षेत्र में नई इकाई लगाने के लिए अधिकतम प्रोजेक्ट कॉस्ट ₹50 लाख है। सब्सिडी की दरें: सामान्य वर्ग को शहरी क्षेत्र में 15% और ग्रामीण में 25%; विशेष वर्ग (महिलाएं, SC, ST, OBC, अल्पसंख्यक) को शहरी में 25% और ग्रामीण क्षेत्र में 35% सब्सिडी मिलती है।

hinglish.short_answer: PMEGP me manufacturing units ke liye maximum project cost ₹50 lakh hai, jisme 15% se 35% (max ₹17.5 lakh) tak margin money subsidy milti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Manufacturing me ₹50 lakh tak ka loan apply kiya ja sakta hai. Rural special category (women, SC/ST, OBC) ko highest 35% subsidy milti hai aur own contribution sirf 5% dena hota hai. Urban general category ko 15% subsidy milti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Maximum project cost for manufacturing enhanced to ₹50 lakh; subsidy ranges from 15% to 35%.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of MSME PMEGP Revised Guidelines 2022

source_title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) Scheme Guidelines
source_publisher: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)
reviewer_notes: Ceilings enhanced from ₹25L to ₹50L in 2022 policy revision.

canonical_question: Is educational qualification required to apply for a PMEGP loan?
alternate_phrasings: PMEGP ke liye kitna padha likha hona chahiye?
Is 8th pass mandatory for PMEGP projects above 10 lakh?
Educational qualification for small PMEGP projects
short_answer: An educational qualification of at least 8th standard pass is mandatory only for manufacturing projects costing above ₹10 lakh and service sector projects costing above ₹5 lakh.
detailed_answer: Under PMEGP eligibility criteria, any individual above 18 years of age can apply. There is no educational qualification requirement for projects below ₹10 lakh in the manufacturing sector or below ₹5 lakh in the service/business sector. However, if the project cost exceeds ₹10 lakh for a manufacturing unit or ₹5 lakh for a service unit, the applicant must have passed at least 8th standard (Class VIII) from a recognized school board, and must submit their school certificate with the online application.

hi.short_answer: PMEGP में केवल ₹10 लाख से अधिक की मैन्युफैक्चरिंग और ₹5 लाख से अधिक की सर्विस परियोजनाओं के लिए न्यूनतम 8वीं कक्षा पास होना अनिवार्य है।
hi.detailed_answer: 18 वर्ष से अधिक आयु का कोई भी व्यक्ति PMEGP में आवेदन कर सकता है। ₹10 लाख तक के मैन्युफैक्चरिंग प्रोजेक्ट और ₹5 लाख तक के सर्विस प्रोजेक्ट के लिए किसी शैक्षणिक योग्यता की आवश्यकता नहीं है। इन सीमाओं से अधिक के प्रोजेक्ट्स के लिए आवेदक का न्यूनतम 8वीं पास होना अनिवार्य है।

hinglish.short_answer: Manufacturing me ₹10 lakh se upar aur service sector me ₹5 lakh se upar ke projects ke liye minimum 8th class pass hona mandatory hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Chote projects (₹10 lakh manufacturing, ₹5 lakh service) ke liye koi education qualification zaroori nahi hai. Par agar project cost in limits se zyada hai to 8th pass certificate portal par upload karna compulsory hai.

supporting_claims.claim: At least VIII standard pass required for manufacturing projects above ₹10 lakh and service projects above ₹5 lakh.
supporting_claims.citation_source: KVIC PMEGP Scheme Operational Guidelines, Clause 3(ii)

source_title: PMEGP Operational Manual and Beneficiary Eligibility Criteria
source_publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
reviewer_notes: Verified against KVIC e-portal mandatory field validation.

canonical_question: Can an existing business apply for a PMEGP subsidy loan?
alternate_phrasings: Can existing unit get PMEGP subsidy?
Purani dukaan ke liye PMEGP loan mil sakta hai kya?
PMEGP 2nd loan for expansion vs fresh new projects
short_answer: Only existing units previously funded under PMEGP, MUDRA, or REGP that have successfully repaid their first loan and remained profitable for 3 years can apply under the special '2nd Loan for Upgradation' category.
detailed_answer: The primary PMEGP scheme is strictly meant for setting up new greenfield enterprises; existing businesses cannot apply for first-time PMEGP assistance to clear old debts or expand existing units. However, the government introduced the '2nd Loan for Upgradation of existing PMEGP/REGP/Mudra units'. To qualify, the unit must have fully repaid the first loan on time, been profitable for the last 3 continuous financial years, possess valid Udyam Registration, and create additional employment.

hi.short_answer: नई PMEGP योजना केवल नए व्यवसाय के लिए है। केवल वे मौजूदा इकाइयां जिन्होंने पहले PMEGP/मुद्रा लोन लिया था और 3 साल से मुनाफे में हैं, वे 'अपग्रेडेशन के लिए दूसरे लोन' के तहत आवेदन कर सकती हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: सामान्य PMEGP लोन केवल नए उद्योग शुरू करने के लिए मिलता है। लेकिन यदि किसी इकाई ने पहले PMEGP, REGP या मुद्रा के तहत लोन लिया था और उसे समय पर चुका दिया है तथा पिछले 3 वर्षों से लगातार लाभ में है, तो वह अपने व्यवसाय के विस्तार (अपग्रेडेशन) के लिए PMEGP 2nd Loan के तहत आवेदन कर सकती है।

hinglish.short_answer: General PMEGP sirf new business ke liye hai. Par pehle se PMEGP/Mudra loan successfully repay karne wali profitable units 2nd loan for upgradation ke liye apply kar sakti hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Normal existing businesses first PMEGP loan ke liye eligible nahi hote. Sirf wahi existing units apply kar sakti hain jinhone pehle PMEGP/REGP/Mudra loan time par clear kiya ho aur pichle 3 saal se continuous profit me chal rahi hon.

supporting_claims.claim: First PMEGP is strictly for new units; existing units eligible only under 2nd loan for upgradation window.
supporting_claims.citation_source: KVIC Guidelines on 2nd Loan for Upgradation under PMEGP

source_title: PMEGP Scheme Guidelines for Second Loan for Existing Units
source_publisher: Khadi and Village Industries Commission
reviewer_notes: Key distinction between new enterprise subsidy vs existing unit upgradation.

canonical_question: What are the three categories of Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) loans?
alternate_phrasings: Mudra loan me Shishu Kishor Tarun ki limit kya hai?
Mudra loan amount categories up to 10 lakh and 20 lakh Tarun Plus
Which Mudra category gives 50000 loan?
short_answer: The three core categories under PMMY are Shishu (loans up to ₹50,000), Kishor (loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5,00,000), and Tarun (loans above ₹5,00,000 and up to ₹10,00,000), expanded by Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh.
detailed_answer: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana categorizes non-farm micro and small enterprise loans into three developmental tiers: (1) Shishu: Covering startup loans up to ₹50,000 for early-stage micro-entrepreneurs; (2) Kishor: Covering loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5,00,000 for purchasing equipment or working capital; (3) Tarun: Covering loans above ₹5,00,000 and up to ₹10,00,000 for established enterprises expanding operations. In the Union Budget 2024, a fourth tier called 'Tarun Plus' (above ₹10 lakh up to ₹20 lakh) was officially introduced for repeat borrowers.

hi.short_answer: मुद्रा योजना (PMMY) में तीन मुख्य श्रेणियां हैं: शिशु (₹50,000 तक), किशोर (₹50,000 से ₹5 लाख तक) और तरुण (₹5 लाख से ₹10 लाख तक)। बजट 2024 में 'तरुण प्लस' (₹20 लाख तक) जोड़ा गया है।
hi.detailed_answer: PMMY सूक्ष्म व्यवसायों को उनकी वित्तीय आवश्यकता अनुसार तीन श्रेणियों में लोन देती है: शिशु (₹50,000 तक), किशोर (₹50,001 से ₹5,00,000 तक) और तरुण (₹5,00,001 से ₹10,00,000 तक)। केंद्रीय बजट 2024 में सफल पुराने कर्जदारों के लिए तरुण प्लस श्रेणी के तहत सीमा ₹20 लाख तक बढ़ा दी गई है।

hinglish.short_answer: PMMY ke 3 categories hain: Shishu (upto ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh), aur Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh). Budget 2024 me Tarun Plus (₹20 lakh) add kiya gaya hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Mudra loan business stage ke hisab se分 divided hai: Shishu early micro businesses ke liye, Kishor growing units ke liye, aur Tarun established enterprises ke liye. Purane punctual borrowers ke liye limit ab ₹20 lakh ho chuki hai.

supporting_claims.claim: PMMY categorizes loans into Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishor (₹50k-₹5L), and Tarun (₹5L-₹10L).
supporting_claims.citation_source: Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency (MUDRA) Framework

source_title: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana Loan Products Overview
source_publisher: MUDRA Ltd, Department of Financial Services
reviewer_notes: Tarun Plus tier operationalized in October 2024.

canonical_question: Is collateral or security required to get a Mudra loan?
alternate_phrasings: Kya Mudra loan ke liye guarantee chahiye?
Is Mudra loan 100% collateral free?
Collateral requirements under PMMY
short_answer: No, Mudra loans are strictly collateral-free; banks and financial institutions are legally prohibited from demanding any physical collateral or third-party guarantee for loans sanctioned under PMMY.
detailed_answer: Under RBI Master Directions and statutory PMMY guidelines, loans sanctioned under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (across Shishu, Kishor, Tarun, and Tarun Plus categories) are 100% collateral-free. Lenders are expressly prohibited from demanding mortgage of immovable property, physical asset pledges, or third-party personal guarantees. To protect banks from default risks, the Government of India provides automated credit guarantee coverage through the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU) managed by NCGTC.

hi.short_answer: नहीं, मुद्रा लोन पूरी तरह संपार्श्विक-मुक्त (collateral-free) होता है। बैंक या वित्तीय संस्थान मुद्रा लोन के लिए किसी भी संपत्ति को गिरवी रखने या गारंटर की मांग नहीं कर सकते।
hi.detailed_answer: RBI और भारत सरकार के नियमों के अनुसार, मुद्रा योजना के तहत किसी भी प्रकार की जमानत (collateral) या थर्ड-पार्टी गारंटी की आवश्यकता नहीं होती। बैंकों के जोखिम को कवर करने के लिए सरकार 'क्रेडिट गारंटी फंड फॉर माइक्रो यूनिट्स' (CGFMU) के माध्यम से गारंटी प्रदान करती है।

hinglish.short_answer: Nahi, Mudra loan 100% collateral-free hota hai. Banks kisi bhi property, gold ya third-party guarantor ki demand nahi kar sakte.
hinglish.detailed_answer: RBI rules ke mutabiq Mudra loan me collateral lena strictly prohibited hai. Banks ko default protection dene ke liye government CGFMU (Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units) ke through automated guarantee deti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Mudra loans are collateral-free; covered by Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU).
supporting_claims.citation_source: RBI Master Direction on Priority Sector Lending & MUDRA Guidelines

source_title: MUDRA Credit Guarantee Framework and Collateral Exemption Guidelines
source_publisher: Reserve Bank of India & Department of Financial Services
reviewer_notes: Applies across all commercial banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, and MFIs.

canonical_question: Who is eligible for loans under the Stand-Up India scheme?
alternate_phrasings: Can general category male apply for Stand-Up India?
Stand Up India loan eligibility for SC ST and women entrepreneurs
Stand Up India me 10 lakh se 1 crore loan kisko milta hai?
short_answer: The Stand-Up India scheme provides bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and Women entrepreneurs for setting up new greenfield enterprises.
detailed_answer: Launched by the Department of Financial Services, Stand-Up India facilitates bank credit between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one Woman borrower per commercial bank branch. Eligibility rules require: (1) Borrower must be an SC/ST or woman individual aged 18+; (2) The enterprise must be a new greenfield project in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or trading; (3) In the case of non-individual enterprises (such as partnerships or private limited companies), at least 51% of shareholding and controlling stake must be held by an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.

hi.short_answer: स्टैंड-अप इंडिया योजना के तहत केवल अनुसूचित जाति (SC), अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) और महिला उद्यमी ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक के बैंक लोन के पात्र हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: यह योजना प्रत्येक बैंक शाखा से कम से कम एक SC/ST और एक महिला उद्यमी को ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का लोन देने के लिए है। उद्यम मैन्युफैक्चरिंग, सर्विस, ट्रेडिंग या कृषि से संबंधित क्षेत्र में नई (ग्रीनफील्ड) इकाई होनी चाहिए। कंपनी या पार्टनरशिप के मामले में कम से कम 51% शेयरधारिता महिला या SC/ST के पास होनी चाहिए।

hinglish.short_answer: Stand-Up India scheme me sirf SC, ST aur Women entrepreneurs eligible hain jinko new business ke liye ₹10 lakh se ₹1 crore ka bank loan milta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Har bank branch ko mandatory 1 SC/ST aur 1 woman entrepreneur ko loan sanction karna hota hai. Business greenfield (naya) hona chahiye. Agar private limited company hai to 51% equity SC/ST ya woman ke pas honi zaroori hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Stand-Up India loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore are reserved for SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs for greenfield units.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Stand-Up India Scheme Guidelines, Department of Financial Services

source_title: Stand-Up India Scheme Guidelines and Portal Architecture
source_publisher: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Agri-allied activities included in eligibility via 2021 Cabinet revision.

canonical_question: What benefits and tool-kit incentive are provided under PM Vishwakarma Yojana?
alternate_phrasings: PM Vishwakarma toolkit 15000 grant and 5% loan
PM Vishwakarma yojana me kitna loan milta hai?
Which 18 traditional trades are eligible for PM Vishwakarma?
short_answer: PM Vishwakarma provides 18 traditional artisan trades with PM Vishwakarma certification, skill training with a ₹500/day stipend, a ₹15,000 modern toolkit grant, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 lakh at a concessional 5% interest rate.
detailed_answer: PM Vishwakarma Yojana offers end-to-end institutional support to traditional artisans and craftspeople: (1) Recognition: PM Vishwakarma certificate and digital ID card; (2) Skill Training: 5-7 days basic training and 15 days advanced training with a daily stipend of ₹500 credited via DBT; (3) Toolkit Incentive: Up to ₹15,000 provided as an e-voucher to procure modern tools; (4) Credit Support: Collateral-free enterprise development loans up to ₹3 lakh in two tranches (Tranche 1: up to ₹1 lakh with 18 months tenure; Tranche 2: up to ₹2 lakh with 30 months tenure) at a highly concessional interest rate of 5% with government interest subvention of up to 8%; (5) Digital transaction incentives: ₹1 per digital transaction up to 100 transactions monthly.

hi.short_answer: पीएम विश्वकर्मा योजना में 18 पारंपरिक कारीगरों को पहचान पत्र, ₹500/दिन वजीफे के साथ ट्रेनिंग, ₹15,000 का टूलकिट वाउचर और 5% रियायती ब्याज पर ₹3 लाख तक का लोन मिलता है।
hi.detailed_answer: योजना के लाभ: (1) विश्वकर्मा सर्टिफिकेट और आईडी कार्ड; (2) बेसिक और एडवांस ट्रेनिंग के दौरान ₹500 प्रतिदिन स्टाइपेंड; (3) आधुनिक औजार खरीदने के लिए ₹15,000 का ई-वाउचर; (4) बिना गारंटी 5% ब्याज पर लोन (पहली किस्त ₹1 लाख, दूसरी किस्त ₹2 लाख); (5) डिजिटल लेन-देन पर ₹1 प्रति ट्रांजैक्शन (अधिकतम ₹100 प्रतिमाह) प्रोत्साहन राशि।

hinglish.short_answer: PM Vishwakarma me 18 traditional trades ke artisans ko certificate, ₹500/day training stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit voucher aur 5% interest par ₹3 lakh tak collateral-free loan milta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Yojana me artisans ko ₹15,000 ka toolkit e-voucher milta hai, training ke dauran ₹500 per day direct bank me milta hai, aur pehle tranche me ₹1 lakh aur dusre tranche me ₹2 lakh ka loan sirf 5% interest par milta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: PM Vishwakarma provides ₹15,000 toolkit grant, ₹500/day training stipend, and loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of MSME PM Vishwakarma Scheme Guidelines 2023

source_title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme Central Sector Guidelines
source_publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
reviewer_notes: Covers 18 trades including carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, masons, cobblers.

canonical_question: How much subsidy is provided for rooftop solar under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana?
subcategory: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
alternate_phrasings: PM Surya Ghar subsidy amount for 1kW, 2kW, and 3kW
Solar rooftop par kitni subsidy milti hai 78000?
Maximum CFA subsidy cap under PM Surya Ghar
short_answer: Under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, residential households receive ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and a maximum capped subsidy of ₹78,000 for systems of 3 kW capacity and above.
detailed_answer: Launched in February 2024, the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana provides Central Financial Assistance (CFA) directly credited via DBT to residential consumer bank accounts: (1) 1 kW capacity system: ₹30,000 fixed subsidy; (2) 2 kW capacity system: ₹60,000 fixed subsidy (₹30,000 per kW); (3) 3 kW capacity system and above: ₹78,000 fixed subsidy (₹30,000/kW for first 2 kW plus ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW). Systems exceeding 3 kW capacity remain capped at the maximum ₹78,000 subsidy. The scheme aims to generate up to 300 units of free electricity per month for 1 crore households.

hi.short_answer: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना के तहत 1 kW पर ₹30,000, 2 kW पर ₹60,000 और 3 kW या उससे अधिक के सिस्टम पर अधिकतम ₹78,000 की सब्सिडी मिलती है।
hi.detailed_answer: पीएम सूर्य घर योजना में आवासीय घरों के लिए छत पर सोलर लगाने हेतु केंद्रीय वित्तीय सहायता दी जाती है: 1 किलोवाट के लिए ₹30,000; 2 किलोवाट के लिए ₹60,000; तथा 3 किलोवाट या इससे बड़े सिस्टम पर अधिकतम ₹78,000 की सब्सिडी तय है। 3 किलोवाट से बड़ा पैनल लगाने पर भी अधिकतम सब्सिडी ₹78,000 ही रहती है।

hinglish.short_answer: PM Surya Ghar me residential solar par 1 kW ke liye ₹30,000, 2 kW ke liye ₹60,000 aur 3 kW+ ke liye maximum ₹78,000 subsidy milti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Central government DBT se subsidy sidhe bank account me transfer karti hai. 1 kW par ₹30k, 2 kW par ₹60k, aur 3 kW par ₹78k fixed hai. Agar aap 5 kW ya 10 kW ka panel lagwate hain tab bhi maximum subsidy ₹78,000 hi capped rehti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Residential rooftop solar subsidy is ₹30k for 1kW, ₹60k for 2kW, and capped at ₹78k for 3kW+.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy PM Surya Ghar Operational Guidelines

source_title: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Central Financial Assistance Structure
source_publisher: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
reviewer_notes: Subsidy disbursed within 30 days of DISCOM commissioning and net meter installation.

canonical_question: Can commercial buildings or rented shops get PM Surya Ghar solar subsidy?
subcategory: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
alternate_phrasings: Is PM Surya Ghar only for residential houses?
Can housing societies and flats apply for PM Surya Ghar?
Dukaan par solar panel lagane par subsidy milti hai kya?
short_answer: No, PM Surya Ghar subsidy is strictly reserved for residential households with individual electricity connections; commercial establishments, private shops, and industrial units are completely excluded.
detailed_answer: Under the statutory eligibility rules of PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, Central Financial Assistance is restricted exclusively to residential electricity consumers with valid domestic electricity connections (domestic tariff category). Commercial buildings, factories, rented shops, educational institutes, and government buildings are ineligible for capital subsidies under this scheme. However, commercial entities may install rooftop solar under standard open-access or net-metering regulations without central subsidy, or utilize separate commercial solar accelerated depreciation tax benefits under Section 32 of the Income Tax Act.

hi.short_answer: नहीं, पीएम सूर्य घर योजना की सब्सिडी केवल आवासीय घरों (घरेलू बिजली कनेक्शन) के लिए है। वाणिज्यिक (कमर्शियल) दुकानों या कारखानों को सब्सिडी नहीं मिलती।
hi.detailed_answer: नियमों के अनुसार, केवल घरेलू बिजली टैरिफ वाले आवासीय उपभोक्ता ही सब्सिडी के पात्र हैं। दुकानें, होटल, मॉल, वाणिज्यिक परिसर और औद्योगिक इकाइयां इस योजना में सब्सिडी की हकदार नहीं हैं, हालांकि वे बिना सरकारी सब्सिडी के सामान्य नेट-मीटरिंग के तहत सोलर पैनल लगवा सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Nahi, PM Surya Ghar subsidy sirf residential houses (domestic meter) ke liye hai. Commercial shops, factories aur offices isme eligible nahi hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Subsidy lene ke liye electricity bill domestic category ka hona compulsory hai. Commercial units bina subsidy ke rooftop solar install kar sakti hain aur Section 32 ke tehat accelerated depreciation tax benefit claim kar sakti hain.

supporting_claims.claim: PM Surya Ghar subsidy is restricted exclusively to residential category electricity connections.
supporting_claims.citation_source: MNRE PM Surya Ghar Operational Manual, Section 3 Eligibility

source_title: PM Surya Ghar Eligibility Criteria and Disqualifications
source_publisher: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
reviewer_notes: Electricity consumer account must match residential tariff schedule of respective DISCOM.

canonical_question: How to check beneficiary status and eKYC under PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi?
alternate_phrasings: PM Kisan installment status check by Aadhaar or mobile number
PM Kisan eKYC kaise kare?
PM Kisan ka paisa kab aayega next installment?
short_answer: Beneficiary status and eKYC can be verified on pmkisan.gov.in under 'Farmers Corner' by entering Registration Number/Aadhaar, and completing eKYC via OTP, biometric CSC, or Face Auth on the PM-KISAN app.
detailed_answer: To verify your PM-KISAN installment and compliance status: (1) Visit the official portal pmkisan.gov.in; (2) In 'Farmers Corner', click on 'Know Your Status' and enter your PM-KISAN Registration Number and captcha; (3) The portal displays whether the three mandatory criteria are satisfied: eKYC Status (Yes/No), Land Seeding (Yes/No), and Aadhaar Bank Account Seeding Status (Yes/No); (4) If eKYC is pending, it can be completed online via OTP on the portal, through the PM-KISAN mobile app using Face Authentication without OTP, or physically at any Common Service Centre (CSC) using biometric thumb verification.

hi.short_answer: pmkisan.gov.in पर 'फार्मर्स कॉर्नर' में 'Know Your Status' पर जाकर रजिस्ट्रेशन नंबर से स्टेटस चेक करें। eKYC पोर्टल पर OTP, ऐप पर फेस ऑथेंटिकेशन या CSC पर बायोमेट्रिक से करें।
hi.detailed_answer: पीएम-किसान पोर्टल पर स्टेटस देखने के लिए: (1) pmkisan.gov.in पर जाएं; (2) 'Know Your Status' पर क्लिक करके रजिस्ट्रेशन नंबर डालें; (3) जांचें कि eKYC, Land Seeding और Aadhaar Bank Seeding तीनों 'Yes' हैं या नहीं। यदि eKYC बाकी है, तो आधार से लिंक मोबाइल नंबर के OTP से, मोबाइल ऐप पर चेहरे के स्कैन से या सीएससी सेंटर पर फिंगरप्रिंट लगाकर तुरंत पूरा करें।

hinglish.short_answer: pmkisan.gov.in par 'Know Your Status' me Registration Number dalkar status check karein. eKYC OTP, PM Kisan app Face Auth ya CSC par biometric se complete hoti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Portal par teen cheezein check karni hoti hain: eKYC Status, Land Seeding, aur Aadhaar Bank Seeding. Teeno 'Yes' hona mandatory hai tabhi ₹2,000 ki installment account me credit hoti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Mandatory conditions for PM-KISAN payment are completed eKYC, verified land seeding, and Aadhaar bank seeding.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Agriculture PM-KISAN Standard Operating Procedure

source_title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Portal Beneficiary Navigation Guide
source_publisher: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
reviewer_notes: eKYC is 100% compulsory for installment disbursement.

canonical_question: Who is eligible for interest subsidy under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) Urban 2.0?
alternate_phrasings: PMAY income limit for EWS, LIG, and MIG categories
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana me kitna subsidy milta hai home loan par?
PMAY housing subsidy eligibility criteria
short_answer: Under PMAY-U 2.0, Economically Weaker Section (EWS, income up to ₹3 lakh), Low Income Group (LIG, income up to ₹6 lakh), and Middle Income Group (MIG, income up to ₹9 lakh) families constructing or buying their first pucca house are eligible for interest subsidies.
detailed_answer: Approved in August 2024 by the Union Cabinet for 1 crore urban houses, PMAY-Urban 2.0 provides an Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) for home loans up to ₹25 lakh (with property value up to ₹35 lakh): (1) EWS (annual income up to ₹3 lakh), LIG (annual income ₹3-6 lakh), and MIG (annual income ₹6-9 lakh) households are eligible; (2) An interest subsidy of 4.0% per annum is provided on home loan amounts up to ₹8 lakh for a tenure of up to 5 years, delivering an upfront subsidy benefit of up to ₹1.80 lakh via 5-yearly installments; (3) The beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India, and female head ownership/co-ownership is mandatory.

hi.short_answer: PMAY अर्बन 2.0 में EWS (वार्षिक आय ₹3 लाख तक), LIG (आय ₹6 लाख तक) और MIG (आय ₹9 लाख तक) के वे परिवार पात्र हैं जो देश में अपना पहला पक्का मकान खरीद या बना रहे हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: अगस्त 2024 में मंजूर PMAY-U 2.0 के तहत ₹35 लाख तक के मकान पर ₹25 लाख तक के होम लोन के लिए ब्याज सब्सिडी मिलती है। ₹8 लाख तक के लोन पर 5 वर्षों के लिए 4.0% ब्याज सब्सिडी दी जाती है, जिससे कुल ₹1.80 लाख तक का शुद्ध लाभ 5 किस्तों में मिलता है। लाभार्थी के पास पहले से कोई पक्का मकान नहीं होना चाहिए और मकान में महिला का नाम होना अनिवार्य है।

hinglish.short_answer: PMAY-U 2.0 me EWS (income upto ₹3L), LIG (upto ₹6L) aur MIG (upto ₹9L) families eligible hain jinka pure India me pehle se koi pucca house nahi hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Cabinet ne August 2024 me PMAY-U 2.0 approve kiya hai jisme ₹8 lakh tak ke home loan par 4% annual interest subsidy milti hai (max ₹1.8 lakh subsidy benefit). Female co-ownership mandatory condition hai.

canonical_question: What is the PAIMANA portal launched by MoSPI for infrastructure project monitoring?
alternate_phrasings: Which infrastructure projects are tracked on PAIMANA?
PAIMANA portal tracks projects above 150 crore
Difference between OCMS and PAIMANA portal MoSPI
short_answer: PAIMANA (Project Assessment, Infrastructure Monitoring and Network Analysis) is the official web-based monitoring platform launched by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) to track central sector infrastructure projects costing ₹150 crore and above.
detailed_answer: The PAIMANA portal operates under MoSPI's Infrastructure and Project Monitoring Division (IPMD). It provides real-time digital monitoring and analytics for central sector infrastructure projects costing ₹150 crore or more across 16 major economic sectors including Railways, Roads, Power, Petroleum, and Coal. Implementing public sector enterprises and ministries upload monthly physical progress milestones, financial expenditure data, and milestone revisions to PAIMANA, which automatically generates the monthly Infrastructure Sector Flash Report assessing time and cost overruns.

hi.short_answer: पैमाना (PAIMANA) सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय (MoSPI) का एक केंद्रीय वेब पोर्टल है, जो ₹150 करोड़ या उससे अधिक लागत वाली केंद्रीय बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं की निगरानी करता है।
hi.detailed_answer: MoSPI के अवसंरचना और परियोजना निगरानी प्रभाग (IPMD) द्वारा संचालित PAIMANA पोर्टल 16 प्रमुख क्षेत्रों में ₹150 करोड़ से अधिक की केंद्रीय परियोजनाओं की वास्तविक समय में निगरानी करता है। संबंधित मंत्रालय और सार्वजनिक उपक्रम (PSUs) अपनी भौतिक प्रगति और वित्तीय व्यय का मासिक डेटा इस पर अपडेट करते हैं, जिससे मासिक फ्लैश रिपोर्ट तैयार होती है।

hinglish.short_answer: PAIMANA MoSPI ka official online portal hai jo ₹150 crore aur usse upar ki central infrastructure projects ki physical aur financial progress monitor karta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: MoSPI ke IPMD division dwara operate hone wala PAIMANA portal 16 major sectors jaise Railways, Highways aur Power ki ₹150 crore+ projects ko track karta hai. Ministries isme monthly expenditure aur milestone progress upload karti hain jisse time aur cost overrun track hota hai.

canonical_question: Why are PAIMANA and MoSPI infrastructure projects categorized as pipeline monitoring rather than commercial tenders?
alternate_phrasings: Can contractors directly bid on PAIMANA project listings?
Are infrastructure projects on SarkarSaathi open for public bidding?
How to evaluate infrastructure project cost overruns and commissioning dates
short_answer: PAIMANA and MoSPI projects represent macro-level capital expenditure tracking and status monitoring of sanctioned public works, rather than active procurement notices seeking commercial vendor bids.
detailed_answer: While procurement portals such as the Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP) and Government e-Marketplace (GeM) publish competitive tenders, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and bids for vendor execution, MoSPI's PAIMANA functions as an apex project governance and monitoring registry. It tracks high-level statutory milestones, revised cost estimates, land acquisition status, environmental clearances, and contractual completion percentages of projects already sanctioned by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) or relevant administrative ministries.

hi.short_answer: पैमाना और MoSPI परियोजनाएं स्वीकृत बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं की मैक्रो-स्तरीय प्रगति निगरानी हैं, न कि विक्रेताओं के लिए जारी किए गए वाणिज्यिक टेंडर।
hi.detailed_answer: CPPP और GeM जहां विक्रेताओं से निविदाएं आमंत्रित करते हैं, वहीं MoSPI का पैमाना पोर्टल कैबिनेट द्वारा स्वीकृत परियोजनाओं की वित्तीय और भौतिक प्रगति, लागत वृद्धि और समय-सीमा की निगरानी करता है। यह निविदा मंच नहीं बल्कि प्रशासनिक निगरानी मंच है।

hinglish.short_answer: PAIMANA aur MoSPI projects government ki macro project tracking system hain, commercial vendor tenders nahi.
hinglish.detailed_answer: CPPP aur GeM commercial bidding aur RFP ke liye use hote hain, jabki PAIMANA already sanctioned infrastructure projects ki physical timeline, cost overruns aur completion status ko monitor karta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: MoSPI IPMD is responsible for monitoring progress of projects, not awarding procurement contracts.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Allocation of Business Rules, Cabinet Secretariat & MoSPI Mandate

source_title: Monitoring Guidelines for Central Sector Infrastructure Projects
source_publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
reviewer_notes: Clarifies core taxonomy boundary between Tenders (CPPP/GeM) and Pipeline Monitoring (MoSPI/PAIMANA).

canonical_question: What is India Investment Grid (IIG) and how do investors evaluate project stages on it?
alternate_phrasings: How to search state sector investment opportunities on IIG
IIG project stage: conceptual, under implementation, completed
Who manages India Investment Grid DPIIT Invest India
short_answer: India Investment Grid (IIG) is an interactive statutory online platform developed by DPIIT and Invest India that showcases investible infrastructure and industrial opportunities across India, categorized across six standardized project lifecycle stages.
detailed_answer: Developed under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) and managed by Invest India, the IIG portal (indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in) hosts thousands of national, state, and private investment opportunities. Investors evaluate projects by filtering across six standard stages: 1) Conceptual / Conceptualization, 2) Under Feasibility / DPR Preparation, 3) Under Approval / Tendering, 4) Under Implementation, 5) Operational, and 6) Stalled. IIG provides direct access to promoters, fiscal incentives, policy guidelines, and contact channels for expressing interest.

hi.short_answer: इंडिया इन्वेस्टमेंट ग्रिड (IIG) डीपीआईआईटी और इन्वेस्ट इंडिया का राष्ट्रीय पोर्टल है, जो निवेशकों को भारत भर में विभिन्न परियोजना चरणों के आधार पर निवेश अवसरों का मूल्यांकन करने की सुविधा देता है।
hi.detailed_answer: IIG पोर्टल (indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in) देश भर की बुनियादी ढांचा और औद्योगिक परियोजनाओं को प्रदर्शित करता है। निवेशक परियोजनाओं को छह चरणों—अवधारणा, व्यवहार्यता/डीपीआर, अनुमोदन/निविदा, कार्यान्वयन, परिचालन और रुकी हुई—के आधार पर फ़िल्टर और विश्लेषण कर सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: India Investment Grid (IIG) DPIIT aur Invest India ka platform hai jo India ki investible projects ko 6 lifecycle stages me showcase karta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: IIG portal par global aur domestic investors projects ko unke development stages (Conceptual, DPR/Feasibility, Approval/Tendering, Under Implementation, Operational) ke mutabiq explore aur evaluate kar sakte hain.
