canonical_question: How can MSMEs and startups get Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) exemption on the GeM portal?
alternate_phrasings: GeM portal par EMD exemption kaise le Udyam certificate se?
Are medium enterprises eligible for EMD exemption on GeM?
GFR Rule 170 EMD exemption for micro and small enterprises
short_answer: MSMEs registered with a valid Udyam Registration Certificate and DPIIT-recognized startups are completely exempt from submitting Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) on GeM under Rule 170(i) of General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017.
detailed_answer: Under Rule 170(i) of GFR 2017 and the Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order 2012, Micro and Small Enterprises holding an active Udyam Registration Certificate are exempt from EMD (Bid Security) for goods and services they are registered to produce. DPIIT-recognized startups are also exempt under Government of India guidelines. To claim exemption on GeM, sellers must verify their Udyam Number or DPIIT startup recognition number in their GeM seller profile. When participating in a bid, the system automatically checks profile credentials and asks the bidder to submit a Bid Security Declaration in lieu of a financial EMD bank guarantee or DD.

hi.short_answer: वैध उद्यम पंजीकरण वाले सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यम (MSMEs) और DPIIT-मान्यता प्राप्त स्टार्टअप GFR 2017 के नियम 170(i) के तहत GeM पोर्टल पर बयाना राशि (EMD) से पूरी तरह मुक्त हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: सार्वजनिक खरीद नीति 2012 और GFR नियम 170(i) के अनुसार, उद्यम पंजीकृत MSEs और DPIIT मान्यता प्राप्त स्टार्टअप्स को GeM पर बोली लगाते समय EMD जमा करने की आवश्यकता नहीं होती। बोलीदाताओं को ईएमडी के स्थान पर केवल एक 'बोली सुरक्षा घोषणा' (Bid Security Declaration) अपलोड करनी होती है।

hinglish.short_answer: GeM portal par valid Udyam Registration certificate wale MSMEs aur DPIIT startups ko GFR Rule 170(i) ke tehat EMD (Bid Security) se 100% exemption milti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: GFR 2017 Rule 170(i) ke mutabiq MSEs aur recognized startups ko bank guarantee ya DD ke roop me EMD nahi deni hoti. Unhe bid submit karte waqt sirf 'Bid Security Declaration' upload karna hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Micro and Small Enterprises registered under Udyam and DPIIT startups are exempt from Bid Security (EMD).
supporting_claims.citation_source: General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, Rule 170(i) & Public Procurement Policy for MSEs 2012

source_title: General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017 & GeM Terms of Service for Bidders
source_publisher: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance & GeM SPV
reviewer_notes: Exemption applies to MSEs for goods/services they are manufacturer/service provider of, not pure traders.

canonical_question: Has GeM removed mandatory Caution Money deposit for sellers and service providers?
alternate_phrasings: Is caution money still required on GeM portal?
GeM caution money removal notification for sellers
GeM par caution money kitna lagta hai?
short_answer: Yes, GeM has substantially relaxed and eliminated mandatory Caution Money deposits for sellers with small turnovers and introduced automated slabs, while MSEs continue to receive preferential fee waivers.
detailed_answer: Historically, GeM required all registered sellers to deposit Caution Money based on annual turnover (₹2,000 for turnover under ₹1 crore, ₹5,000 for ₹1-10 crore, and ₹10,000 for above ₹10 crore). Under updated GeM policies and digital ease-of-doing-business initiatives, onboarding friction has been reduced. For new micro enterprises and small vendors, initial mandatory blockage of caution money has been either waived or converted to rolling transactional safeguards, and forfeited caution money mechanisms have been replaced by structured incident management under the GeM Incident Management Policy 2025.

hi.short_answer: हाँ, GeM ने छोटे विक्रेताओं के लिए अनिवार्य कॉशन मनी के नियमों में बड़ी छूट दी है और इसे लेन-देन आधारित सुरक्षा उपायों से बदला है।
hi.detailed_answer: पहले GeM पर टर्नओवर के आधार पर ₹2,000 से ₹10,000 की कॉशन मनी जमा करनी अनिवार्य थी। व्यापार सुगमता पहलों के तहत नए सूक्ष्म उद्यमों के लिए अग्रिम ब्लॉक की जाने वाली राशि को काफी सरल बना दिया गया है और उल्लंघनों के लिए इंसिडेंट मैनेजमेंट पॉलिसी लागू की गई है।

hinglish.short_answer: Haan, GeM ne micro sellers aur service providers ke onboarding ease ke liye upfront caution money deposit requirements ko kafi relax kar diya hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Pehle turnover ke hisaab se ₹2,000 se ₹10,000 mandatory caution money block hoti thi. Ab GeM Incident Management Policy 2025 ke tehat transparent grievance aur transaction-linked safeguards follow hote hain.

supporting_claims.claim: GeM revised Caution Money deposit rules to reduce entry barriers for micro sellers and service providers.
supporting_claims.citation_source: GeM Incident Management & Seller Caution Money Circulars

source_title: GeM Seller Onboarding Terms & Caution Money Guidelines
source_publisher: Government e-Marketplace (GeM SPV)
reviewer_notes: Sellers should verify their specific profile tier under GeM Seller Account Dashboard.

canonical_question: Why is a Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) mandatory for e-procurement on CPPP?
alternate_phrasings: Can I use Class 2 DSC on eprocure portal?
Class 3 combo DSC signing plus encryption for CPPP tender bidding
CPPP par tender submit karne ke liye DSC kaise banwaye?
short_answer: A Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) is legally mandated under the Information Technology Act, 2000 and CPPP guidelines to guarantee non-repudiation, tamper-proof bid encryption, and legally binding bidder identity.
detailed_answer: The Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP / eprocure.gov.in) enforces Class 3 DSC (the highest level of cryptographic assurance in India, issued by licensed Certifying Authorities under the Controller of Certifying Authorities - CCA). A Class 3 DSC requires in-person or video-based identity verification of the applicant. In electronic tendering, it serves two critical cryptographic functions: 1) Signing: applying a legal cryptographic digital signature on bid documents to establish authorship and prevent non-repudiation; and 2) Encryption: encrypting financial bids into the CPPP secure vault so no buyer or procurement officer can access financial figures until the technical bid evaluation is formally completed and authorized.

hi.short_answer: CPPP पर ई-प्रोक्योरमेंट के लिए क्लास 3 डिजिटल सिग्नेचर सर्टिफिकेट (DSC) सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी अधिनियम, 2000 के तहत कानूनी रूप से बाध्यकारी पहचान और बोलियों के छेड़छाड़-मुक्त एन्क्रिप्शन के लिए अनिवार्य है।
hi.detailed_answer: कंट्रोलर ऑफ सर्टिफाइंग अथॉरिटीज (CCA) द्वारा जारी क्लास 3 डीएससी उच्चतम सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है। यह बोली दस्तावेजों पर डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर करके उनकी प्रमाणिकता सुनिश्चित करता है और वित्तीय बोलियों को एन्क्रिप्ट करता है ताकि तकनीकी मूल्यांकन पूरा होने से पहले कोई उन्हें खोल न सके।

hinglish.short_answer: CPPP par e-tendering ke liye Class 3 DSC mandatory hai taaki bids legally tamper-proof rahein aur financial bid securely encrypt ho sake.
hinglish.detailed_answer: IT Act 2000 ke tehat Class 3 DSC highest identity assurance deta hai. Yeh do kaam karta hai: Signing (legal ownership of documents) aur Encryption (financial bids ko tamper-proof lock karna jab tak technical evaluation complete na ho).

supporting_claims.claim: Class 3 DSC is mandatory for online bid submission and financial bid encryption on CPPP.
supporting_claims.citation_source: CPPP National Informatics Centre (NIC) Bidder Manual & IT Act 2000

source_title: CPPP Guidelines on Digital Signatures & Encryption Certificates
source_publisher: National Informatics Centre (NIC) & Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA)
reviewer_notes: Class 2 DSCs were discontinued in India in 2021; only Class 3 DSC is valid for government tendering.

canonical_question: What is a tender corrigendum and why must bidders check it before final bid submission?
alternate_phrasings: What happens if bidder ignores corrigendum amendment?
Corrigendum kya hota hai tender me?
Where to find latest corrigendum on eprocure portal
short_answer: A tender corrigendum is an official legal addendum or amendment issued by the procuring entity that modifies original tender specifications, dates, quantities, or terms, taking legal precedence over the initial tender notice.
detailed_answer: When a government ministry, PSU, or urban local body publishes a tender, bidders often raise queries during the mandatory pre-bid meeting. In response, the procuring authority issues a formal 'Corrigendum' (or Addendum) on CPPP or GeM. A corrigendum may: 1) Extend bid submission deadlines; 2) Relax technical qualification criteria or turnover requirements; 3) Clarify Bill of Quantities (BOQ) specifications; or 4) Update contract terms. Bidders who fail to read and incorporate corrigenda risk automatic technical rejection for submitting bids against outdated specifications or unrevised BOQ templates.

hi.short_answer: टेंडर शुद्धिपत्र (Corrigendum) खरीद प्राधिकरण द्वारा जारी किया गया आधिकारिक कानूनी संशोधन है, जो मूल निविदा की शर्तों, तारीखों या विनिर्देशों में बदलाव करता है।
hi.detailed_answer: प्री-बिड बैठक या तकनीकी स्पष्टीकरण के बाद जारी किया जाने वाला शुद्धिपत्र मूल निविदा से अधिक मान्य होता है। इसमें तारीखों का विस्तार, तकनीकी योग्यता में छूट या BOQ में बदलाव हो सकता है। इसे चेक न करने पर पुरानी शर्तों के आधार पर भरी गई बोली सीधे खारिज हो सकती है।

hinglish.short_answer: Tender corrigendum buyer authority dwara issue kiya gaya official amendment hota hai jo original tender terms, dates ya specifications ko update karta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Pre-bid meeting ke baad authorities corrigendum upload karti hain jisme BOQ change, deadline extension ya technical relaxation hoti hai. Bidders ko latest corrigendum download karke uske mutabiq bid file karni hoti hai warna technical rejection ho jata hai.

supporting_claims.claim: A corrigendum legally amends original tender specifications and takes precedence over initial clauses.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Manual for Procurement of Goods, Department of Expenditure (Rule 5.3)

source_title: Manual for Procurement of Goods & Central Public Procurement Guidelines
source_publisher: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Always re-download the latest BOQ spreadsheet from CPPP if a corrigendum amends financial items.

canonical_question: How does the L1 purchase preference work for MSMEs in government tenders?
alternate_phrasings: MSME 15 percent price band matching L1 price rule
Mandatory 25 percent annual procurement from MSEs by CPSUs
GeM L1 price matching preference for small businesses
short_answer: Under the Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order 2012, qualifying Micro and Small Enterprises bidding within L1 + 15% are offered the opportunity to match the lowest non-MSE price (L1) and secure up to 25% of the tendered quantity.
detailed_answer: In central government and CPSE tenders where the lowest quoted bid (L1) is from a non-MSE firm, participating MSE bidders quoting within a price band of L1 + 15% are granted purchase preference. The qualifying MSE is invited to match the L1 price. Upon agreeing to match L1, that MSE is awarded at least 25% of the total tendered procurement quantity (or the entire order if the item is not technically divisible). If multiple MSEs fall within L1 + 15%, the opportunity to match L1 is offered strictly in the order of their evaluated bid rank (MSE L2, then MSE L3).

hi.short_answer: सार्वजनिक खरीद नीति 2012 के तहत, यदि कोई गैर-MSE कंपनी L1 बनती है, तो L1 + 15% के दायरे में बोली लगाने वाले पात्र MSEs को L1 मूल्य से मिलान करने और निविदा मात्रा का 25% तक ऑर्डर प्राप्त करने की प्राथमिकता दी जाती है।
hi.detailed_answer: यदि L1 गैर-एमएसई है और कोई एमएसई L1+15% मूल्य सीमा में है, तो उस एमएसई को L1 मूल्य से मिलान करने का अवसर दिया जाता है। सहमति देने पर उसे कुल ऑर्डर का 25% आवंटित किया जाता है। यदि सामग्री अविभाज्य है, तो पूरा 100% ऑर्डर उस एमएसई को मिल सकता है।

hinglish.short_answer: MSE Public Procurement Policy ke tehat agar non-MSE L1 banta hai, to L1 + 15% price band wale eligible MSE ko L1 rate match karke 25% quantity lene ka preference milta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Jab non-MSE lowest bidder (L1) hota hai, tab L1+15% range me aane wale Udyam MSE ko invite kiya jata hai L1 price match karne ke liye. Match karne par use total tender quantity ka 25% award kiya jata hai.

supporting_claims.claim: MSEs quoting within price band of L1 + 15% are allowed to supply at least 25% of tender value by matching L1 price.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 (Paragraph 6)

source_title: Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012
source_publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
reviewer_notes: Statutory mandatory minimum share was increased from 20% to 25% by Cabinet decision in 2018.

canonical_question: How frequently are small savings scheme interest rates revised by the Ministry of Finance?
alternate_phrasings: Does Ministry of Finance change PPF rate every quarter?
Small savings interest rate notification schedule quarterly
Post office scheme ka interest rate kab change hota hai?
short_answer: Small savings scheme interest rates are reviewed and notified on a quarterly basis by the Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance, effective on the first day of each financial quarter.
detailed_answer: Under the Government Savings Promotion General Rules, 2018, and policy recommendations instituted in 2016 following the Shyamala Gopinath Committee report, interest rates on National Savings Schemes (including PPF, SSY, SCSS, NSC, KVP, and Post Office Time Deposits) are reset quarterly. The four review cycles align with the financial quarters: Quarter 1 (April 1 to June 30), Quarter 2 (July 1 to September 30), Quarter 3 (October 1 to December 31), and Quarter 4 (January 1 to March 31). The Ministry of Finance issues a formal Office Memorandum at the end of the preceding quarter declaring whether rates are revised or maintained unchanged.

hi.short_answer: डाकघर लघु बचत योजनाओं की ब्याज दरों की समीक्षा और अधिसूचना वित्त मंत्रालय के आर्थिक मामलों के विभाग (DEA) द्वारा त्रैमासिक (हर तीन महीने में) आधार पर जारी की जाती है।
hi.detailed_answer: वित्त मंत्रालय प्रत्येक वित्तीय तिमाही के लिए ब्याज दरों की घोषणा करता है: Q1 (अप्रैल-जून), Q2 (जुलाई-सितंबर), Q3 (अक्टूबर-दिसंबर), और Q4 (जनवरी-मार्च)। पिछली तिमाही के अंतिम सप्ताह में एक आधिकारिक कार्यालय ज्ञापन (OM) जारी कर नई या यथावत दरों की पुष्टि की जाती है।

hinglish.short_answer: Small savings schemes ki interest rates Ministry of Finance ke DEA department dwara quarterly (har 3 mahine) basis par review aur notify hoti hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Har financial quarter ke start par rates effective hoti hain: April-June, July-September, October-December, aur January-March. Ministry of Finance previous quarter ke end me official OM issue karke rates declare karti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Small savings interest rates are reviewed on a quarterly basis by the Ministry of Finance.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance (DEA) Quarterly Office Memorandums on Small Savings Rates

source_title: Ministry of Finance Office Memorandums on Revision of Interest Rates for Small Savings Schemes
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Next quarterly revision notification cycle is monitored every March, June, September, and December.

canonical_question: When small savings interest rates are revised, do existing accounts get the new rate?
alternate_phrasings: Will my existing SCSS or NSC interest rate change if government cuts rates?
Does PPF rate revision affect ongoing PPF accounts?
Fixed tenure small savings vs floating quarterly PPF rate rule
short_answer: Whether existing accounts receive the revised rate depends strictly on scheme design: floating-rate schemes (PPF and Sukanya Samriddhi) adjust immediately for all existing accounts, whereas fixed-rate term schemes (SCSS, NSC, KVP, POTD) lock in the rate applicable at opening for their entire tenure.
detailed_answer: The Government Savings Promotion Act specifies two distinct interest rate application mechanisms: 1) Floating Rate Schemes: For Public Provident Fund (PPF) and Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY), interest is dynamic. Any upward or downward revision announced by the government applies immediately to all existing account balances from the effective date of the notification; 2) Fixed Contractual Schemes: For Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS), National Savings Certificate (NSC), Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP), and Post Office Time Deposits (POTD), the interest rate prevailing on the date the deposit was opened is locked and guaranteed for the entire original term. Rate revisions apply only to fresh accounts opened on or after the notification date.

hi.short_answer: यह योजना के प्रकार पर निर्भर करता है: फ्लोटिंग योजनाओं (PPF और SSY) में सभी मौजूदा खातों पर नई दर तुरंत लागू होती है, जबकि फिक्स्ड योजनाओं (SCSS, NSC, KVP, POTD) में खाता खोलने के समय की दर पूरे कार्यकाल के लिए लॉक रहती है।
hi.detailed_answer: PPF और सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना में सरकार जब भी दरें बदलती है, तो पहले से खुले सभी खातों की ब्याज दर स्वतः बदल जाती है। इसके विपरीत NSC, KVP, SCSS और सावधि जमा (Time Deposit) में खाता खुलवाते समय तय की गई ब्याज दर परिपक्वता तक स्थिर रहती है; नई दरें केवल नए खुले खातों पर लागू होती हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Yeh scheme type par depend karta hai: PPF aur SSY floating rate hain to purane accounts par bhi nayi rate turant lagti hai, jabki SCSS, NSC, KVP me account open hone wali rate maturity tak lock rehti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: PPF aur Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana me quarterly revision existing balances par immediately apply hoti hai. Lekin NSC, KVP, Post Office FD aur SCSS me jo rate account opening date par thi, wahi pore tenure ke liye guaranteed rehti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: PPF and SSY interest rates are floating and update for all accounts; SCSS, NSC, and POTD rates are locked at account inception.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Government Savings Promotion General Rules, 2018 & Department of Posts Operational Handbooks

source_title: Operational Rules for Interest Rate Applicability in Small Savings Schemes
source_publisher: Department of Posts & National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Key investor protection rule preventing retrospective interest rate cuts on fixed term certificates.

canonical_question: How can citizens verify whether a WhatsApp or social media scheme notification is official or fake?
alternate_phrasings: PIB fact check for government money transfer messages
How to spot fake Sarkari Yojana portals and phishing links
Sarkari yojana fake news verification kaise kare?
short_answer: Citizens can verify whether a viral scheme notification is genuine by checking the official Press Information Bureau Fact Check unit (factcheck.pib.gov.in or WhatsApp +91 8799711259) and verifying that the scheme is hosted on an authentic .gov.in or .nic.in domain.
detailed_answer: Social media and messaging platforms frequently circulate fraudulent notifications claiming free laptops, monthly direct cash stipends, or uncollateralized loans under forged government emblems. Citizens can verify authenticity through three official checks: 1) PIB Fact Check Unit: Submit forwarded messages, screenshots, or YouTube links directly to PIB Fact Check via WhatsApp (+91 8799711259), email (pibfactcheck@gmail.com), or web portal (factcheck.pib.gov.in); 2) Domain Check: Legitimate Indian government portals strictly end in '.gov.in' or '.nic.in'. Portals using .com, .in, .org, or .xyz asking for processing fees are unauthorized; 3) Scheme Search on myScheme.gov.in: Authentic central and state welfare initiatives are indexed on the national myScheme repository.

hi.short_answer: नागरिक पत्र सूचना कार्यालय (PIB) की फैक्ट चेक यूनिट (factcheck.pib.gov.in या व्हाट्सएप +91 8799711259) के माध्यम से और केवल .gov.in या .nic.in वेबसाइटों पर जानकारी की पुष्टि करके फर्जी संदेशों की जांच कर सकते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: सोशल मीडिया पर फर्जी सब्सिडी या मुफ्त योजनाओं के दावों की पुष्टि के लिए: 1) पीआईबी फैक्ट चेक को व्हाट्सएप (+91 8799711259) पर भेजें; 2) देखें कि वेबसाइट का पता .gov.in या .nic.in पर समाप्त होता है या नहीं (.org या .com वाली निजी साइटें फर्जी हो सकती हैं); 3) राष्ट्रीय पोर्टल myScheme.gov.in पर योजना की वास्तविकता जांचें।

hinglish.short_answer: Citizens viral schemes ko PIB Fact Check (WhatsApp +91 8799711259 ya factcheck.pib.gov.in) par verify kar sakte hain aur check karein ki portal authentic .gov.in domain par hai ya nahi.
hinglish.detailed_answer: WhatsApp fake forward verify karne ke liye: 1) PIB Fact Check WhatsApp (+91 8799711259) par forward karein; 2) Check karein website strictly .gov.in ya .nic.in ho (.com/.xyz nahi); 3) myScheme.gov.in portal par check karein ki scheme officially listed hai ya nahi.

supporting_claims.claim: PIB Fact Check Unit operates official verification via WhatsApp (+91 8799711259) and web portal.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Press Information Bureau Fact Check Portal & Ministry of Information and Broadcasting

source_title: PIB Fact Check Verification Guidelines & Citizen Advisory
source_publisher: Press Information Bureau (PIB), Ministry of Information and Broadcasting
reviewer_notes: PIB Fact Check maintains a dedicated debunking archive accessible to all citizens.

canonical_question: How does the myScheme portal determine which central and state schemes a citizen is eligible for?
alternate_phrasings: myScheme portal check eligibility step by step
Can I apply directly on myScheme portal?
myScheme par sarkari yojana kaise search kare?
short_answer: The myScheme portal (myscheme.gov.in) uses an intelligent rule-based eligibility engine that matches a citizen's self-reported profile attributes (gender, age, caste, state, occupation, income, and disability status) against thousands of scheme criteria.
detailed_answer: Developed by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and the National e-Governance Division (NeGD), myScheme is India's unified national scheme discovery platform. A citizen completes an anonymous multi-step questionnaire answering basic demographic criteria: age, gender, state of residence, rural/urban domicile, social category (General/OBC/SC/ST/Minority), economic status (BPL/EWS/annual income), employment type (student, farmer, entrepreneur, artisan), and special categories (differently abled, single parent). The platform's automated engine filters over 1,500 central and state schemes and generates a tailored list of schemes for which the user qualifies, linking directly to official application forms.

hi.short_answer: माईस्कीम (myScheme.gov.in) पोर्टल एक नियम-आधारित पात्रता इंजन का उपयोग करता है जो नागरिक द्वारा दर्ज की गई जनसांख्यिकीय जानकारी (आयु, लिंग, आय, राज्य, जाति और व्यवसाय) के आधार पर उपयुक्त सरकारी योजनाओं की सूची तैयार करता है।
hi.detailed_answer: MeitY और NeGD द्वारा विकसित यह पोर्टल 1,500 से अधिक केंद्रीय और राज्य योजनाओं का डेटाबेस रखता है। उपयोगकर्ता अपनी बुनियादी जानकारी भरकर तुरंत जान सकते हैं कि वे किन-किन सरकारी लाभों के पात्र हैं, और सीधे आवेदन लिंक प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: myScheme portal (myscheme.gov.in) citizen ke profile data (age, gender, caste, income, state aur occupation) ko thousands of government schemes se match karke customized eligibility list dikhata hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: NeGD aur MeitY dwara banaya gaya myScheme platform ek automated filter engine use karta hai. User bina login kiye bhi apne attributes daalkar central aur state government schemes ki tailored list check kar sakta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: myScheme uses an automated rule-based filtering engine across demographic attributes to determine eligibility across 1,500+ schemes.
supporting_claims.citation_source: myScheme Portal Architecture & NeGD Platform Documentation

canonical_question: What is the difference between Central Government portals (.gov.in) and state single window clearance portals?
alternate_phrasings: National Single Window System (NSWS) vs State Single Window portals
How to verify government portal domain security .gov.in and .nic.in
State government industrial portals vs central approvals
short_answer: Central Government portals (.gov.in) administer nation-wide policies, central sector schemes, and federal clearances, whereas State Single Window portals handle state-level industrial approvals, land allotments, utility connections, and local factory inspections.
detailed_answer: Under the constitutional division of legislative powers (Union List vs State List / Concurrent List): 1) Central Portals: Operated by federal ministries (e.g., DPIIT, MoEFCC's PARIVESH, Ministry of Corporate Affairs' MCA21) granting PAN/TAN, company incorporation, central environmental clearances, and foreign direct investment (FDI) approvals; 2) State Single Window Clearances (SWCS): Operated by state investment promotion bureaus (e.g., MAITRI in Maharashtra, Nivesh Mitra in Uttar Pradesh, Guidance in Tamil Nadu) granting state-specific industrial clearances including municipal building plan approvals, State Pollution Control Board Consent to Establish/Operate (CTE/CTO), electricity load sanction, factory licenses, and fire NOCs.

hi.short_answer: केंद्रीय पोर्टल (.gov.in) राष्ट्रीय नीतियों, निगमन और केंद्रीय पर्यावरण मंजूरियों का संचालन करते हैं, जबकि राज्य सिंगल विंडो पोर्टल भूमि आवंटन, बिजली कनेक्शन, अग्निशमन एनओसी और स्थानीय फैक्ट्री लाइसेंस जारी करते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: संवैधानिक शक्तियों के तहत कंपनी निगमन (MCA21) और केंद्रीय पर्यावरण मंजूरी (PARIVESH) केंद्र सरकार के पोर्टल संभालते हैं। इसके विपरीत औद्योगिक भूमि, जल आपूर्ति, प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड की मंजूरी और स्थानीय श्रम पंजीकरण राज्य के सिंगल विंडो सिस्टम (जैसे उत्तर प्रदेश में निवेश मित्र) द्वारा दिए जाते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Central portals federal approvals (MCA, Income Tax, central pollution) manage karte hain, jabki State single window portals land allocation, power connection, state pollution CTE/CTO aur local factory licenses handle karte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Union List subjects Central portals handle karte hain jaise Corporate Affairs aur Foreign Investment. State portals (jaise Nivesh Mitra, MAITRI) ground implementation clearances dete hain jaise industrial plot allotment, fire NOC aur state commercial taxes.

supporting_claims.claim: Central portals manage federal approvals while State Single Windows administer municipal, pollution, and utility sanctions.
supporting_claims.citation_source: DPIIT Business Reforms Action Plan (BRAP) & Single Window Framework

source_publisher: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

canonical_question: What is JanSamarth portal and which government loan schemes can be applied through it?
alternate_phrasings: Can I apply PMEGP and Mudra loan on JanSamarth portal?
JanSamarth portal digital approval in principle letter
JanSamarth portal par loan ke liye apply kaise kare?
short_answer: JanSamarth (jansamarth.in) is India's unified digital credit portal linking lenders with borrowers to disburse government-subsidized loans across 13+ credit schemes under 4 major loan categories: Education, Agri Infrastructure, Business Activity, and Livelihood.
detailed_answer: Launched by the Prime Minister in June 2022 and managed under the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, JanSamarth connects beneficiaries directly with more than 125 lending institutions (Public Sector Banks, Private Banks, Regional Rural Banks, and NBFCs). Major schemes hosted include: 1) Business Loans: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY), Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP), Stand-Up India, and PM SVANidhi; 2) Education Loans: Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) and Padho Pardesh; 3) Agricultural Infrastructure: Agri Clinic & Agri Business Centres (ACABC) and Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF); 4) Livelihood: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM.

hi.short_answer: जनसमर्थ (jansamarth.in) भारत का एकीकृत क्रेडिट पोर्टल है, जो 13 से अधिक सरकारी ऋण योजनाओं (शिक्षा, कृषि बुनियादी ढांचा, व्यवसाय और आजीविका) के तहत बैंकों से सब्सिडी-युक्त ऋण उपलब्ध कराता है।
hi.detailed_answer: वित्तीय सेवा विभाग (DFS) के अंतर्गत जनसमर्थ 125 से अधिक बैंकों को जोड़ता है। इस पर मुद्रा ऋण (PMMY), पीएमईजीपी (PMEGP), स्टैंड-अप इंडिया, पीएम स्वनिधि (PM SVANidhi) और केंद्रीय क्षेत्र ब्याज सब्सिडी (CSIS) जैसे प्रमुख ऋणों के लिए डिजिटल आवेदन और सैद्धांतिक मंजूरी प्राप्त की जा सकती है।

hinglish.short_answer: JanSamarth (jansamarth.in) Government of India ka official credit portal hai jahan Mudra, PMEGP, Stand-Up India aur education loans ke liye 125+ banks se direct apply kiya ja sakta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: June 2022 me launch hua JanSamarth portal DFS ke under operate hota hai. Isme 4 categories (Business, Education, Agri Infra, Livelihood) ke 13+ credit-linked schemes hain jahan digital In-Principle Sanction Letter milta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: JanSamarth integrates 13 credit-linked government subsidy schemes across 125+ lenders.

canonical_question: Which is better for a girl child: Public Provident Fund (PPF) or Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)?
alternate_phrasings: PPF vs Sukanya Samriddhi which gives higher interest?
Should I invest in PPF or SSY for daughter?
PPF ya Sukanya me se kaun si yojana acchi hai?
short_answer: For a resident girl child under 10 years of age, Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) is strictly superior to PPF due to a significantly higher interest rate (8.2% vs 7.1%) and complete triple-tax-exempt (EEE) status, though PPF offers greater withdrawal flexibility for broader life goals.
detailed_answer: Comparing both government-backed schemes for a girl child: 1) Interest Rate: SSY currently offers 8.2% per annum compared to 7.1% on PPF (a 110 bps spread); 2) Tax Treatment: Both enjoy EEE status (exempt contribution under 80C, exempt annual interest under Section 10, and exempt maturity proceeds under Section 10(11)/10(11A)); 3) Investment Limits: Both have a ₹1.5 lakh annual ceiling and ₹500 minimum; 4) Tenure and Lock-in: SSY mandates deposits for 15 years and matures when the girl turns 21 or gets married after 18, whereas PPF has a 15-year tenure extendable in 5-year blocks; 5) Liquidity: PPF permits partial withdrawals from year 7 and loans from year 3, whereas SSY restricts withdrawals to up to 50% strictly for higher education after the girl reaches 18 or passes Class 10.

hi.short_answer: 10 वर्ष से कम आयु की बालिका के लिए सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना (SSY) अधिक ब्याज दर (8.2% बनाम 7.1%) के कारण PPF से बेहतर है, हालांकि PPF निकासी और अवधि विस्तार में अधिक लचीलापन प्रदान करता है।
hi.detailed_answer: दोनों योजनाओं में कर छूट (EEE) समान है और अधिकतम सीमा ₹1.5 लाख है। लेकिन सुकन्या योजना में PPF से 1.1% अधिक ब्याज मिलता है। सुकन्या योजना का पैसा बालिका की उच्च शिक्षा (18 वर्ष बाद 50%) या 21 वर्ष में विवाह/परिपक्वता के लिए लॉक रहता है, जबकि PPF 15 वर्ष बाद किसी भी उद्देश्य के लिए निकाला जा सकता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Girl child ke liye Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) higher interest rate (8.2% vs 7.1%) ki wajah se PPF se better return deti hai, halanki PPF me partial withdrawal zyada flexible hota hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: SSY aur PPF dono government-backed EEE tax-exempt schemes hain. SSY me 8.2% interest milta hai jo PPF ke 7.1% se kafi zyada hai. SSY ka lock-in girl child ki higher education (18 years) ya marriage (21 years) tak hota hai, jabki PPF 15 years me mature hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: SSY offers 8.2% interest compared to 7.1% on PPF, both qualifying for EEE tax status under Section 80C and Section 10.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance Quarterly Small Savings Rates & Income Tax Act, 1961

source_title: Comparison of Small Savings Schemes: PPF vs Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
source_publisher: National Savings Institute & Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Both schemes can be operated concurrently for the same girl child within their individual ₹1.5 lakh limits.

canonical_question: What is the difference between Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS) and Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS)?
alternate_phrasings: SCSS quarterly payout vs POMIS monthly payout
Does POMIS have Section 80C tax deduction like SCSS?
Retiree ke liye SCSS accha hai ya Post Office Monthly Income Scheme?
short_answer: The primary differences are eligibility, interest rate, and payout frequency: SCSS is exclusively for citizens aged 60+ offering 8.2% interest paid quarterly with ₹30 lakh max deposit, while POMIS is open to all adults offering 7.4% interest paid monthly with ₹9 lakh individual (₹15 lakh joint) max deposit.
detailed_answer: Key structural distinctions: 1) Eligibility: SCSS requires age 60+ (or 55+ for retired defence/VRS personnel), whereas POMIS can be opened by any resident Indian adult; 2) Payout Frequency: SCSS pays interest strictly on a quarterly basis (first working day of April, July, October, January), whereas POMIS pays interest monthly; 3) Interest Rate: SCSS offers 8.2% per annum versus 7.4% on POMIS; 4) Maximum Deposit: SCSS allows up to ₹30 lakh per individual, whereas POMIS limits deposits to ₹9 lakh (single) and ₹15 lakh (joint); 5) Tax Deduction: SCSS deposits qualify for Section 80C tax deduction (up to ₹1.5 lakh under Old Regime), whereas POMIS deposits enjoy zero 80C deduction.

hi.short_answer: SCSS केवल 60 वर्ष से अधिक उम्र के नागरिकों के लिए है जिसमें 8.2% त्रैमासिक ब्याज और ₹30 लाख की अधिकतम सीमा है; जबकि POMIS सभी वयस्कों के लिए खुला है जिसमें 7.4% मासिक ब्याज और ₹9 लाख (एकल)/₹15 लाख (संयुक्त) की सीमा है।
hi.detailed_answer: वरिष्ठ नागरिक बचत योजना (SCSS) में 8.2% ब्याज मिलता है जो हर 3 महीने में बैंक खाते में आता है और इसमें धारा 80C के तहत टैक्स छूट मिलती है। डाकघर मासिक आय योजना (POMIS) में 7.4% ब्याज हर महीने मिलता है, लेकिन इसमें कोई 80C टैक्स छूट नहीं मिलती।

hinglish.short_answer: SCSS sirf 60+ seniors ke liye hai jo 8.2% quarterly interest deta hai (limit ₹30 lakh), jabki POMIS koi bhi open kar sakta hai aur 7.4% monthly interest deta hai (limit ₹9 lakh single / ₹15 lakh joint).
hinglish.detailed_answer: SCSS me quarterly payout hota hai aur 80C deduction milta hai. POMIS me monthly pension-style payout milta hai lekin 80C tax benefit nahi milta. SCSS me maximum ₹30 lakh deposit allowed hai jabki POMIS me max ₹15 lakh joint account me hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: SCSS offers 8.2% quarterly with 80C benefits up to ₹30 lakh; POMIS offers 7.4% monthly without 80C up to ₹9 lakh/₹15 lakh.
supporting_claims.citation_source: SCSS Rules 2019 & POMIS Scheme Rules 2019, Ministry of Finance

source_title: Post Office Small Savings Scheme Comparison: SCSS vs POMIS
source_publisher: Department of Posts & National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: SCSS deposit limit was enhanced from ₹15 lakh to ₹30 lakh and POMIS from ₹4.5 lakh to ₹9 lakh in Budget 2023.

canonical_question: How do Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB) compare against physical gold and gold ETFs?
alternate_phrasings: Why SGB has 2.5% extra interest over gold price
No making charges in SGB vs physical jewelry
SGB vs Gold ETF tax comparison
short_answer: Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB) provide 2.50% annual interest on nominal value, zero storage or making charges, and complete capital gains tax exemption on 8-year maturity, making them financially superior to physical gold and gold ETFs for long-term holding.
detailed_answer: Evaluating gold investment avenues in India: 1) Additional Yield: SGBs pay a guaranteed statutory 2.50% annual interest credited semi-annually, whereas physical gold and Gold ETFs yield 0% cash flow; 2) Costs: Physical gold incurs 3% GST plus 8% to 25% non-recoverable making charges and locker storage fees; Gold ETFs incur ~0.5% annual expense ratios and brokerage; SGBs have zero issuance fees or storage charges; 3) Tax Treatment: SGB redemption at maturity (8 years) is 100% exempt from capital gains tax under Section 47(viic) of the Income Tax Act; Physical gold and Gold ETFs attract capital gains tax based on holding period.

hi.short_answer: सॉवरेन गोल्ड बॉन्ड (SGB) भौतिक सोने और गोल्ड ईटीएफ से बेहतर हैं क्योंकि वे 2.50% वार्षिक अतिरिक्त ब्याज देते हैं, मेकिंग चार्ज या लॉकर शुल्क से मुक्त हैं, और 8 वर्ष की परिपक्वता पर 100% पूंजीगत लाभ कर (Capital Gains Tax) से मुक्त हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: भौतिक सोने पर 3% जीएसटी और मेकिंग चार्ज का नुकसान होता है, जबकि गोल्ड ईटीएफ में वार्षिक फंड प्रबंधन शुल्क लगता है। SGB सरकार द्वारा समर्थित है, इस पर हर 6 महीने में ब्याज मिलता है, और परिपक्वता पर सोने के बाजार मूल्य के साथ पूरा लाभ पूरी तरह कर-मुक्त मिलता है।

hinglish.short_answer: SGB physical gold aur Gold ETFs se financial terms me superior hai kyunki isme 2.50% annual interest milta hai, zero making charges hain, aur 8 saal maturity par 100% capital gains tax exemption milti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Physical gold me locker charges aur making charges ka loss hota hai. Gold ETFs me expense ratio lagta hai. SGB me zero making charges, semi-annual 2.5% fixed interest, aur maturity par Section 47(viic) ke tehat complete tax-free redemption milti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: SGB offers 2.50% annual interest and complete capital gains tax exemption upon maturity under Section 47(viic).
supporting_claims.citation_source: RBI Sovereign Gold Bond Operational Guidelines & Income Tax Act, 1961

source_title: Reserve Bank of India Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme Master Direction
source_publisher: Reserve Bank of India
reviewer_notes: SGB primary tranches depend on government issuance calendar; existing tranches trade on secondary stock exchanges.

canonical_question: What is the key difference between PMEGP loan and Mudra loan for starting a business?
alternate_phrasings: Does Mudra loan have capital subsidy like PMEGP?
PMEGP vs Mudra loan which is easier to get approved?
Naye business ke liye PMEGP le ya Mudra loan?
short_answer: The fundamental difference is government subsidy: PMEGP provides a non-repayable government capital subsidy (Margin Money) of 15% to 35% on project costs up to ₹50 lakh, whereas Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) provides pure collateral-free credit up to ₹20 lakh with zero subsidy.
detailed_answer: Key distinctions for business entrepreneurs: 1) Capital Subsidy: PMEGP provides a direct non-repayable capital subsidy of 15% to 35% credited to a term-deposit lock-in account; Mudra offers zero capital subsidy; 2) Loan Size: PMEGP finances new manufacturing projects up to ₹50 lakh and service projects up to ₹20 lakh; Mudra offers Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (up to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (up to ₹10 lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 lakh); 3) Training Requirement: PMEGP requires mandatory Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training before subsidy release; Mudra has no mandatory EDP training; 4) Approval Authority: PMEGP applications are scrutinized by District Task Force Committees (DTFC) led by KVIC/DIC before bank processing; Mudra is sanctioned directly by commercial banks.

hi.short_answer: मुख्य अंतर सरकारी सब्सिडी का है: PMEGP में ₹50 लाख तक की परियोजना लागत पर 15% से 35% की गैर-वापसी योग्य पूंजीगत सब्सिडी मिलती है, जबकि मुद्रा योजना में बिना किसी सब्सिडी के केवल ₹20 लाख तक का ऋण मिलता है।
hi.detailed_answer: PMEGP में खादी ग्रामोद्योग और जिला उद्योग केंद्र (DIC) के माध्यम से सब्सिडी और अनिवार्य EDP प्रशिक्षण मिलता है। मुद्रा योजना में कोई सब्सिडी नहीं मिलती; यह केवल छोटे व्यवसायों को संपार्श्विक-मुक्त कार्यशील पूंजी और सावधि ऋण तुरंत उपलब्ध कराने के लिए है।

hinglish.short_answer: Main difference subsidy ka hai: PMEGP me 15% se 35% tak non-refundable government capital subsidy milti hai, jabki Mudra loan me zero subsidy hoti hai aur sirf pure collateral-free credit milta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: PMEGP me manufacturing projects ke liye ₹50 lakh tak loan + up to 35% subsidy milti hai jisme EDP training zaroori hai. Mudra loan me Shishu/Kishore/Tarun/Tarun Plus ke tehat ₹20 lakh tak bina kisi subsidy ke direct bank se sanction hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: PMEGP provides 15% to 35% government capital subsidy, while Mudra provides collateral-free credit without subsidy.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of MSME PMEGP Operational Scheme Guidelines & DFS PMMY Guidelines

source_title: Scheme Comparison Matrix: PMEGP vs Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
source_publisher: Ministry of MSME & Department of Financial Services
reviewer_notes: PMEGP is ideal for capital-heavy greenfield manufacturing units; Mudra is optimal for rapid working capital.

canonical_question: What is the difference between GeM portal and CPPP (eprocure.gov.in) for suppliers?
alternate_phrasings: Difference between GeM direct purchase and CPPP open tenders
Do I need both GeM account and CPPP account for government contracts?
GeM portal aur eprocure me kya antar hai?
short_answer: GeM is an end-to-end e-commerce marketplace for standardized off-the-shelf commercial goods and services, while CPPP (Central Public Procurement Portal) is a national e-tendering gateway for large civil works, complex engineering, and custom turnkey projects.
detailed_answer: Key differences for commercial suppliers: 1) Platform Model: GeM operates like an online marketplace featuring a catalog of listed products and services, enabling direct purchasing (up to ₹50k), L1 comparisons (up to ₹10L), and bidding; CPPP is an e-procurement tender repository where buyers publish RFPs, BOQs, and multi-cover tenders; 2) Scope of Procurement: GeM is legally mandatory for common-use goods and services (IT hardware, office stationery, vehicles, facility management); CPPP is used for specialized capital projects, highways, railway construction, mega civil infrastructure, and customized engineering; 3) Settlement & Payment: GeM enforces automated CRAC generation and integrated online payment with 1% penal interest on buyer delays; CPPP leaves billing and contract disbursement to departmental ERPs.

hi.short_answer: GeM सामान्य उपयोग की मानकीकृत वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के लिए एक ऑनलाइन ई-कॉमर्स बाजार है, जबकि CPPP बड़े नागरिक निर्माण कार्यों, रेलवे परियोजनाओं और जटिल इंजीनियरिंग निविदाओं के लिए एक ई-टेंडरिंग पोर्टल है।
hi.detailed_answer: GeM पर सीधे कैटलॉग से खरीद और तुलना की जाती है तथा इसमें भुगतान के लिए 10 दिनों का CRAC नियम लागू होता है। CPPP पर बड़े इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर टेंडर, दो-कवर बोलियां और विशेष अनुबंध प्रकाशित होते हैं, जिनका भुगतान संबंधित विभाग के आंतरिक बिलिंग सिस्टम से होता है।

hinglish.short_answer: GeM standard goods aur services ke liye online e-commerce platform hai (catalog direct buying/bidding), jabki CPPP large infrastructure tenders, civil works aur complex engineering contracts ke liye e-tendering portal hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: GeM common use items (computers, furniture, security services) ke liye mandatory hai aur 10-day CRAC payment guarantee deta hai. CPPP par mega tenders, highways aur custom construction RFPs upload hote hain jahan BOQ Excel bidding hoti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Rule 149 mandates GeM for common use goods and services; CPPP hosts open e-tenders and major works under Rule 158-163.
supporting_claims.citation_source: General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, Rule 149 vs Rule 158-163

source_title: Comparative Analysis of Public Procurement Portals: GeM vs CPPP
source_publisher: Department of Expenditure & GeM SPV
reviewer_notes: Suppliers can register on both portals with the same Class 3 DSC, PAN, and Udyam credentials.

canonical_question: How does a PPF calculator compute compound interest if deposits are made in installments?
alternate_phrasings: PPF calculator formula F = P [({(1+i)^n}-1)/i]
How to calculate PPF return for 1.5 lakh yearly deposit for 15 years
PPF calculator me interest compounding kaise hoti hai?
short_answer: A PPF calculator calculates monthly interest on the lowest balance between the 5th and the last day of each month, sums these 12 monthly interest amounts, and compounds them into the principal balance on March 31 of each financial year.
detailed_answer: Under the Public Provident Fund Scheme, 2019, interest calculation follows a strict statutory algorithm: 1) Qualifying Monthly Balance: For each calendar month (April to March), the interest-bearing balance is defined as the minimum balance standing to the credit of the account between the close of the fifth day and the end of the month. Deposits credited after the 5th earn zero interest for that month; 2) Monthly Interest Accrual: Monthly Interest = (Lowest Balance * Annual Rate) / (12 * 100); 3) Annual Compounding: The 12 monthly interest calculations are accumulated and added to the principal balance once annually on March 31st. For installment depositors, making contributions on or before the 5th of each month maximizes total annual compounded yield.

hi.short_answer: PPF कैलकुलेटर महीने की 5 तारीख और अंतिम दिन के बीच के न्यूनतम शेष पर मासिक ब्याज की गणना करता है, और पूरे वर्ष के 12 महीनों के ब्याज को जोड़कर 31 मार्च को मूलधन में चक्रवृद्धि (कंपाउंड) करता है।
hi.detailed_answer: PPF नियम 2019 के अनुसार, यदि आप किसी महीने की 5 तारीख के बाद पैसा जमा करते हैं, तो उस महीने उस जमा राशि पर ब्याज नहीं मिलता। प्रत्येक महीने का ब्याज (न्यूनतम शेष * 7.1% / 12) के रूप में निकाला जाता है और वित्तीय वर्ष के अंत (31 मार्च) में खाते में जोड़ दिया जाता है।

hinglish.short_answer: PPF calculator har mahine ki 5th date aur month-end ke lowest balance par monthly interest calculate karta hai aur 31st March ko pore saal ke interest ko principal me compound add karta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: PPF algorithm ke mutabiq har month ka interest = (Lowest balance between 5th and last day * Rate) / 1200 hota hai. Yeh monthly interest book hota rehta hai aur 31st March ko annual compounding ke roop me balance me add ho jata hai.

supporting_claims.claim: PPF interest is calculated on the lowest balance between 5th and end of each month and compounded annually on March 31.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Public Provident Fund Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 8 (Calculation of Interest)

source_title: Public Provident Fund Scheme, 2019: Mathematical Interest Calculation Rules
source_publisher: Ministry of Finance & National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Always advise depositors to set auto-debit on or before the 5th of each month.

canonical_question: How is maturity amount calculated in Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana if deposit is made for 15 years and account matures at 21 years?
alternate_phrasings: Does SSY earn interest between year 15 and 21 without new deposits?
Sukanya Samriddhi calculator 1.5 lakh yearly investment maturity estimate
SSY 21 saal baad kitna milega calculator
short_answer: In Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY), the depositor makes annual contributions for the first 15 years, and during years 16 to 21 (when no fresh deposits are permitted), the accumulated corpus continues to earn compound interest at the applicable annual rate until final maturity at 21 years.
detailed_answer: The SSY calculator computes the maturity value across two distinct temporal phases: 1) Contribution Phase (Years 1 to 15): The subscriber deposits funds (up to ₹1.5 lakh annually). Compounding interest is calculated on the lowest balance between the 5th and the end of each month and credited on March 31st of each year, compounding the principal for 15 years; 2) Growth Phase (Years 16 to 21): No further deposits are allowed (or required). The entire accumulated corpus at the end of year 15 continues to compound at the prevailing notified government rate (currently 8.2%) for an additional 6 years: Maturity Amount = Corpus_Year15 * (1 + r)^6. At completion of 21 years from account opening, the entire sum is disbursed 100% tax-free.

hi.short_answer: सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना में पहले 15 वर्षों तक राशि जमा की जाती है, और 16वें से 21वें वर्ष तक (बिना कोई नया पैसा जमा किए) कुल जमा पूंजी पर अगले 6 वर्षों तक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज जुड़ता रहता है, जो 21 वर्ष पूरे होने पर परिपक्व होता है।
hi.detailed_answer: कैलकुलेटर दो चरणों में गणना करता है: पहले 15 वर्षों में वार्षिक जमा + 8.2% चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज। इसके बाद अगले 6 वर्षों तक कोई जमा नहीं करना होता, लेकिन 15वें वर्ष का कुल फंड अगले 6 साल तक 8.2% की दर से बढ़ता रहता है। 21 वर्ष बाद मिलने वाली पूरी राशि पूरी तरह कर-मुक्त होती है।

hinglish.short_answer: SSY me pehle 15 years tak deposit hota hai, aur 16th se 21st year tak (bina fresh deposit kiye) accumulated balance par 6 years tak compound interest continue rehta hai jab tak 21 saal me account mature na ho.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Calculation 2 phases me hoti hai: Phase 1 (1-15 years) me regular deposit aur compounding hoti hai. Phase 2 (16-21 years) me deposit band ho jata hai par total corpus par prevailing 8.2% rate par 6 saal tak interest compound hota rehta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: SSY deposits are made for 15 years; corpus continues to earn interest without deposits until maturity at 21 years.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 5 & Paragraph 11

source_title: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019: Maturity Compounding Rules
source_publisher: National Savings Institute & Department of Posts
reviewer_notes: Interest continues to accrue even beyond 21 years if the account is not closed, up to formal gazette instructions.

canonical_question: What is the formula to calculate monthly payout under Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS)?
alternate_phrasings: POMIS monthly interest calculation formula P x R / 12
How much monthly income from 9 lakh in post office MIS at 7.4%?
Post Office MIS calculator monthly payout
short_answer: The formula to calculate the monthly interest payout under POMIS is: Monthly Payout = (Principal Deposit * Annual Interest Rate) / 12, yielding exactly ₹5,550 per month on a ₹9 lakh deposit and ₹9,250 per month on a ₹15 lakh deposit at 7.4% per annum.
detailed_answer: Under the Post Office Monthly Income Scheme Rules, 2019, interest is calculated on a simple interest basis on the initial principal deposit and disbursed monthly: Monthly Interest = (P * r) / (12 * 100), where P is the deposited principal and r is the notified annual interest rate (currently 7.4%). Examples: 1) Maximum Single Account (₹9,00,000): Monthly Payout = (9,00,000 * 7.4) / 1,200 = ₹5,550 per month (₹66,600 per year); 2) Maximum Joint Account (₹15,00,000): Monthly Payout = (15,00,000 * 7.4) / 1,200 = ₹9,250 per month (₹1,11,000 per year). If the depositor does not withdraw the monthly interest, it does not earn any extra interest in the POMIS account.

hi.short_answer: POMIS में मासिक ब्याज की गणना का फॉर्मूला है: मासिक आय = (मूलधन * वार्षिक ब्याज दर) / 12। वर्तमान 7.4% दर पर ₹9 लाख पर ₹5,550 प्रतिमाह और ₹15 लाख के संयुक्त खाते पर ₹9,250 प्रतिमाह मिलते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: डाकघर मासिक आय योजना का फॉर्मूला (P * R) / 1200 है। यदि कोई एकल खाते में अधिकतम ₹9 लाख जमा करता है, तो उसे हर महीने ₹5,550 मिलते हैं। ₹15 लाख के संयुक्त खाते पर ₹9,250 मासिक पेंशन की तरह मिलते हैं। यह ब्याज सीधे बचत खाते में ट्रांसफर हो जाता है।

hinglish.short_answer: POMIS monthly payout formula: Monthly Interest = (Principal * Annual Rate) / 1200. At 7.4% interest, ₹9 lakh par ₹5,550/month aur ₹15 lakh joint account par ₹9,250/month milte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: POMIS simple interest basis par monthly credit hota hai. Formula: (P * 7.4) / 1200. ₹9 lakh single deposit par exactly ₹5,550 monthly milta hai aur ₹15 lakh joint par ₹9,250 monthly credited to savings account.

supporting_claims.claim: POMIS monthly interest equals (Principal * Rate) / 12, delivering ₹5,550 on ₹9L and ₹9,250 on ₹15L at 7.4%.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme Rules, 2019, Paragraph 5

source_title: Post Office Monthly Income Account Rules, 2019: Mathematical Payout Formula
source_publisher: Department of Posts & National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Depositors should link their Post Office Savings Account (POSA) for automatic monthly credit.

canonical_question: Why does compound interest produce significantly higher returns than simple interest in multi-year government bonds?
alternate_phrasings: Compound interest calculator formula A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt)
Which government schemes pay simple interest vs compound interest?
Chakravriddhi byaj vs sadharan byaj calculator in savings
short_answer: Compound interest produces significantly higher returns because each year's accrued interest is reinvested and added to the principal base, generating 'interest on interest' that grows exponentially over multi-year tenures.
detailed_answer: The mathematical divergence between Simple Interest and Compound Interest accelerates with time: 1) Simple Interest: Future Value = P * (1 + r * t), where interest remains linear because it is calculated solely on the original principal P; 2) Compound Interest: Future Value = P * (1 + r/n)^(n*t), where previously accrued interest is rolled into principal every compounding cycle (quarterly or annually). In a 15-year instrument like PPF at 7.1%, ₹1,50,000 deposited annually accumulates to ~₹40.68 lakh under compound interest (where interest exceeds ₹18.18 lakh), whereas under simple interest the total return would be only ~₹30.98 lakh—a compounding premium of nearly ₹10 lakh.

hi.short_answer: चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज साधारण ब्याज से कहीं अधिक रिटर्न देता है क्योंकि इसमें हर साल अर्जित ब्याज को मूलधन में जोड़ दिया जाता है, जिससे 'ब्याज पर भी ब्याज' मिलता है और दीर्घकालिक रिटर्न घातीय (Exponential) रूप से बढ़ता है।
hi.detailed_answer: साधारण ब्याज में केवल मूलधन पर लाभ मिलता है (P * R * T)। चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज में हर वर्ष या तिमाही में अर्जित लाभ मूलधन का हिस्सा बन जाता है। 15 वर्षों में PPF में वार्षिक ₹1.5 लाख जमा करने पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के कारण लगभग ₹40.68 लाख बनते हैं, जबकि साधारण ब्याज में यह केवल ₹31 लाख के करीब होता।

hinglish.short_answer: Compound interest significantly higher return deta hai kyunki isme 'interest on interest' generate hota hai: pichle saal ka interest principal me add ho kar exponential growth create karta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Simple interest linear rehta hai (A = P + P*r*t), jabki compound interest exponential hota hai [A = P*(1+r)^t]. 15 saal ke tenure me PPF me ₹1.5L annual deposit karne par compounding ki wajah se ~₹10 lakh extra interest generate hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Compound interest reinvests accrued returns generating exponential wealth accumulation over long tenures.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Financial Mathematics & National Savings Scheme Actuarial Guidelines

source_title: Actuarial Principles of Compounding in Government Small Savings Instruments
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Core educational foundation for SarkarSaathi compound interest comparison tools.

canonical_question: When can an account holder take a loan against their PPF account and what is the maximum loan limit?
alternate_phrasings: How to calculate the maximum loan amount allowed on a PPF account?
PPF account par loan kab aur kitna mil sakta hai?
Can I take a loan against PPF in the 3rd year and how much?
short_answer: A loan against PPF can be availed between the 3rd and 6th financial year of account opening, with a maximum loan ceiling of 25% of the balance at the end of the second preceding financial year.
detailed_answer: Under Paragraph 10 of the PPF Scheme 2019, an account holder can apply for a loan starting from the third financial year up to the end of the sixth financial year from the financial year in which the account was opened. The maximum loan amount is capped at 25% of the credit balance standing at the close of the second financial year immediately preceding the year in which the loan is applied. For example, if applying in FY 2024-25, the loan limit is 25% of the balance as of March 31, 2023. From the 7th financial year onward, the loan facility ceases because partial withdrawal eligibility begins.

hi.short_answer: PPF खाते पर लोन तीसरे वित्तीय वर्ष से छठे वित्तीय वर्ष के बीच लिया जा सकता है। अधिकतम लोन राशि आवेदन वर्ष से 2 वर्ष पूर्व के बैलेंस का 25% होती है।
hi.detailed_answer: PPF स्कीम 2019 के अनुसार, खाताधारक खाता खोलने के तीसरे से छठे वित्तीय वर्ष के अंत तक लोन ले सकता है। लोन की अधिकतम सीमा उस वित्तीय वर्ष से ठीक दो साल पहले के खाते में मौजूद बैलेंस का 25% होती है। सातवें वर्ष से आंशिक निकासी (withdrawal) की सुविधा शुरू हो जाती है, इसलिए लोन की सुविधा बंद हो जाती है।

hinglish.short_answer: PPF par loan 3rd financial year se 6th financial year ke beech mil sakta hai, aur maximum limit 2 saal pehle ke balance ka 25% hoti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Agar aap FY 2024-25 me loan apply kar rahe hain, to March 31, 2023 ke balance ka 25% loan milega. 7th financial year se loan facility band ho jaati hai kyunki partial withdrawal chalu ho jata hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Loan allowed between 3rd and 6th financial year up to 25% of balance at end of second preceding year.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Public Provident Fund Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 10(1)

source_title: PPF Scheme 2019 Loan Against Deposits Provisions
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Only one loan allowed per financial year; second loan allowed only after first is cleared.

canonical_question: What is the interest rate charged on a PPF loan and what penalty applies if it is not repaid within 36 months?
alternate_phrasings: What happens if PPF loan is not repaid within 3 years?
PPF loan repayment time period aur interest rate kya hai?
Is PPF loan interest 1 percent or 6 percent if delayed?
short_answer: A PPF loan carries an interest rate of 1% per annum above the prevailing PPF rate if repaid within 36 months; if delayed beyond 36 months, the interest rate jumps penal to 6% per annum above the PPF rate.
detailed_answer: Under statutory PPF loan rules, the interest rate on a PPF loan is 1% per annum over the prevailing PPF interest rate (e.g., 8.1% when PPF rate is 7.1%), provided the principal and interest are fully repaid within 36 months from the first day of the month following loan disbursement. The principal must be repaid first in lump sum or installments, followed by interest in not more than two monthly installments. If the loan is not fully repaid within 36 months, a penalty interest rate of 6% per annum above the prevailing PPF rate is charged on the outstanding balance from the date of initial disbursement.

hi.short_answer: PPF लोन पर ब्याज दर मौजूदा PPF दर से 1% अधिक होती है (36 महीने के भीतर चुकाने पर)। 36 महीने में न चुकाने पर 6% दंडात्मक ब्याज दर लागू होती है।
hi.detailed_answer: PPF लोन 36 महीने (3 साल) के भीतर चुकाना होता है। समय पर चुकाने पर ब्याज दर PPF दर से केवल 1% अधिक (वर्तमान में 8.1%) होती है। यदि 36 महीने में लोन नहीं चुकाया जाता, तो लोन मिलने की तारीख से पूरे बकाया पर PPF दर से 6% अधिक (यानी 13.1%) दंडात्मक ब्याज वसूला जाता है।

hinglish.short_answer: PPF loan par interest rate PPF rate + 1% hota hai agar 36 months me repay kar diya jaye. 36 months cross hone par 6% penalty interest lagta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Loan 36 months me chukana mandatory hai. Pehle principal repay hota hai fir 2 installments me interest. Agar 36 months me loan clear nahi hota, to disbursement date se hi PPF rate + 6% ka penal interest charge kiya jata hai.

supporting_claims.claim: PPF loan interest is 1% above PPF rate if repaid in 36 months, increasing to 6% above PPF rate if delayed.
supporting_claims.citation_source: PPF Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 10(3) and 10(4)

source_title: PPF Scheme 2019 Loan Interest and Repayment Rules
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Interest rate reduced from 2% to 1% in December 2019 gazette notification.

canonical_question: What options are available upon maturity of a PPF account after 15 years?
alternate_phrasings: Can I extend PPF after 15 years without making further deposits?
PPF 15 saal pura hone ke baad kya kare?
What are the withdrawal rules if PPF is extended with or without contribution?
short_answer: Upon completing 15 years, a subscriber has three options: (1) Withdraw the full balance and close the account; (2) Extend the account in 5-year blocks with fresh contributions; or (3) Extend the account without contributions while earning interest.
detailed_answer: At the end of the mandatory 15-year tenure (calculated from the end of the financial year of opening), an account holder can choose: (1) Complete Closure: Submit Form 3 to withdraw the entire tax-free corpus; (2) Extension with Contribution: Submit Form 4 (formerly Form H) within one year of maturity to extend for a 5-year block with ongoing deposits (up to 60% of balance at start of extension can be withdrawn during the 5 years); (3) Extension without Contribution: If no form is submitted within one year, the account automatically continues indefinitely in 5-year blocks, where the balance continues earning interest and one withdrawal per year of any amount is permitted.

hi.short_answer: 15 साल पूरे होने पर तीन विकल्प हैं: (1) पूरा पैसा निकालकर खाता बंद करना; (2) नई जमा राशि के साथ 5-5 साल के ब्लॉक में बढ़ाना; या (3) बिना जमा किए खाता जारी रखना और ब्याज कमाना।
hi.detailed_answer: 15 वर्ष की परिपक्वता पर ग्राहक: (1) फॉर्म 3 भरकर पूरा पैसा टैक्स-फ्री निकाल सकता है; (2) फॉर्म 4 भरकर 1 साल के भीतर योगदान के साथ 5 साल के लिए खाता बढ़ा सकता है; (3) बिना कोई फॉर्म भरे खाता अपने आप बिना योगदान के जारी रहता है, जिस पर ब्याज मिलता रहता है और साल में एक बार निकासी की जा सकती है।

hinglish.short_answer: 15 years maturity par 3 options hain: (1) Full amount withdraw karke account close karna; (2) Form 4 submit karke fresh deposits ke sath 5 saal extend karna; (3) Bina deposit ke account continue rakhna.
hinglish.detailed_answer: 15 saal complete hone par agar koi action nahi liya jata to account automatically bina contribution ke extend ho jata hai aur interest milta rehta hai. Fresh contribution ke liye 1 saal ke andar Form 4 dena zaroori hai.

supporting_claims.claim: PPF can be closed, extended with contributions, or extended without contributions upon 15-year maturity.
supporting_claims.citation_source: PPF Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 12

source_title: PPF Scheme 2019 Maturity and Extension Options
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Form H replaced by Form 4 under Government Savings Promotion General Rules 2018.

canonical_question: What is the procedure and deadline to extend a PPF account with contributions using Form H or Form 4?
alternate_phrasings: Within how many months must Form H be submitted to extend PPF with deposits?
PPF account extend karne ke liye form h kab jama karna hota hai?
What happens if I deposit money in PPF after 15 years without submitting Form H?
short_answer: To extend a PPF account with fresh contributions, the subscriber must submit Form 4 (formerly Form H) to the bank or post office within one year from the date of 15-year maturity.
detailed_answer: To extend a PPF account with ongoing deposits, the account holder must submit Form 4 to the branch where the account is held within one year of the maturity date. If fresh deposits are made into the account after 15 years without submitting Form 4 within the one-year window, all such deposits are treated as irregular under government rules: they earn zero interest and are ineligible for Section 80C tax deductions, though the pre-existing balance continues to earn interest.

hi.short_answer: PPF खाते को नए योगदान के साथ बढ़ाने के लिए परिपक्वता की तारीख से 1 वर्ष के भीतर फॉर्म 4 (पुराना फॉर्म H) जमा करना अनिवार्य है।
hi.detailed_answer: यदि ग्राहक 15 साल बाद भी पैसे जमा करना चाहता है, तो उसे 1 साल के भीतर बैंक या पोस्ट ऑफिस में फॉर्म 4 जमा करना होगा। यदि बिना फॉर्म जमा किए पैसे डाले जाते हैं, तो उन पैसों पर कोई ब्याज नहीं मिलेगा और न ही टैक्स छूट मिलेगी।

hinglish.short_answer: PPF account ko fresh contribution ke sath extend karne ke liye maturity date se 1 saal ke andar Form 4 (Form H) submit karna mandatory hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Agar 1 saal ke andar Form 4 submit kiye bina paise deposit kiye jate hain, to un deposits par zero interest milta hai aur 80C tax deduction bhi nahi milta.

supporting_claims.claim: Form 4 must be submitted within one year of maturity to extend PPF with deposits.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Government Savings Promotion General Rules, 2018, Form 4 and PPF Scheme 2019

source_title: PPF Extension with Contribution Filing Timeline
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs
reviewer_notes: Crucial compliance rule: deposits without Form 4 earn zero interest.

canonical_question: Under what conditions is premature closure of a Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) account allowed before 21 years?
alternate_phrasings: Can Sukanya Samriddhi account be closed before maturity on medical grounds?
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana account ko premature band kab kar sakte hain?
What is the penalty rate if SSY is closed prematurely after 5 years?
short_answer: Premature closure of an SSY account before 21 years is permitted on the death of the girl child, life-threatening medical emergencies, or upon her marriage after turning 18 years old.
detailed_answer: Under the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme 2019, premature closure before the 21-year maturity is allowed under specific statutory grounds: (1) Death of the girl child: Account is closed immediately upon submission of death certificate, and balance with interest is paid to the guardian; (2) Compassionate grounds: After 5 years of account opening, in cases of life-threatening disease of the girl child or death of the guardian; (3) Marriage of the girl child: After attaining 18 years of age, supported by marriage declaration and age proof, submitted between 1 month prior to and 3 months after the marriage date.

hi.short_answer: सुकन्या समृद्धि खाता 21 वर्ष से पहले बालिका की मृत्यु, जानलेवा बीमारी, अभिभावक की मृत्यु या 18 वर्ष की आयु के बाद विवाह के समय बंद किया जा सकता है।
hi.detailed_answer: SSY खाता 21 वर्ष से पूर्व निम्न परिस्थितियों में बंद हो सकता है: (1) बालिका की असामयिक मृत्यु पर मृत्यु प्रमाण पत्र प्रस्तुत करने पर; (2) 5 वर्ष पूरे होने के बाद बालिका की गंभीर बीमारी या माता-पिता की मृत्यु पर; (3) 18 वर्ष की आयु पूरी होने के बाद बालिका के विवाह के अवसर पर।

hinglish.short_answer: SSY account 21 saal se pehle girl child ki death, critical illness, guardian death ya 18 years ke baad marriage hone par prematurely close kiya ja sakta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Account opening ke 5 saal baad medical emergency ya parents ki demise par compassionate grounds par closure allow hota hai. 18 years age hone par marriage application ke sath account close kiya ja sakta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Premature closure allowed on death, after 5 years on compassionate medical grounds, or on marriage after age 18.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 12

source_title: SSY Scheme 2019 Premature Closure Conditions
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Post Office savings bank interest applies if closed prematurely on non-specified grounds.

canonical_question: When and how much can be partially withdrawn from a Sukanya Samriddhi account for higher education?
alternate_phrasings: Can 50 percent be withdrawn from SSY once girl turns 18 or passes 10th standard?
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana se padhai ke liye paise kab nikal sakte hain?
What documents are needed for SSY partial withdrawal for college admission?
short_answer: Up to 50% of the balance at the end of the preceding financial year can be partially withdrawn once the girl child turns 18 years old or passes the 10th standard, specifically for higher education.
detailed_answer: Under Paragraph 10 of the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme 2019, partial withdrawal is permitted specifically for the higher education expenses of the girl child. The withdrawal is allowed once the girl attains 18 years of age or completes standard 10th (matriculation), whichever is earlier. The maximum withdrawal limit is 50% of the balance standing in the account at the close of the immediately preceding financial year. The funds can be withdrawn in a lump sum or in up to five annual installments, upon presenting confirmed admission documentation and fee structure from an educational institution.

hi.short_answer: बालिका की आयु 18 वर्ष होने या 10वीं कक्षा पास करने पर उच्च शिक्षा के लिए पिछले वित्तीय वर्ष के बैलेंस का अधिकतम 50% निकाला जा सकता है।
hi.detailed_answer: उच्च शिक्षा के लिए बालिका की 18 वर्ष आयु पूरी होने या 10वीं पास करने पर (जो भी पहले हो) निकासी की अनुमति है। अधिकतम 50% राशि निकाली जा सकती है। यह राशि एकमुश्त या 5 वार्षिक किस्तों में कॉलेज के दाखिला पत्र और फीस रसीद के आधार पर प्राप्त की जा सकती है।

hinglish.short_answer: Girl child ki 18 years age hone ya 10th class pass karne par higher education ke liye previous financial year balance ka 50% withdraw kiya ja sakta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Admission letter aur fee slip submit karke 50% balance withdraw ho sakta hai. Yeh amount lump-sum ya maximum 5 yearly installments me withdraw karne ki permission hoti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Partial withdrawal up to 50% permitted after age 18 or passing 10th standard for higher education.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 10

source_title: SSY Scheme Higher Education Withdrawal Guidelines
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Confirmed admission offer required as mandatory evidentiary documentation.

canonical_question: What is the penalty and revival process if the minimum ₹250 annual deposit is missed in a Sukanya Samriddhi account?
alternate_phrasings: How to reactivate a defaulted SSY account?
Sukanya Samriddhi me ₹250 saal ka na jama karne par kya hota hai?
Is interest still credited on a defaulted Sukanya Samriddhi account?
short_answer: If the minimum ₹250 deposit is missed in a financial year, the SSY account is marked in default and can be revived by paying a penalty of ₹50 per default year along with the ₹250 minimum deposit for each missed year.
detailed_answer: A Sukanya Samriddhi account requires a minimum statutory deposit of ₹250 in every financial year. If this minimum deposit is not made, the account is categorized as an 'account in default'. A defaulted account can be regularized at any time before the completion of 15 years from account opening by paying a penalty fee of ₹50 for each defaulted year plus the minimum deposit of ₹250 for each such year. Even if an account remains in default, the existing balance continues to earn interest at the applicable scheme rate until maturity.

hi.short_answer: सालाना न्यूनतम ₹250 जमा न करने पर खाता डिफॉल्ट हो जाता है। इसे प्रति डिफॉल्ट वर्ष ₹50 पेनल्टी और ₹250 न्यूनतम जमा देकर पुनर्जीवित किया जा सकता है।
hi.detailed_answer: यदि किसी वित्तीय वर्ष में ₹250 जमा नहीं होते हैं, तो खाता डिफॉल्ट माना जाता है। इसे 15 वर्ष पूरे होने से पहले कभी भी ₹50 प्रति वर्ष की पेनल्टी और ₹250 का न्यूनतम बकाया जमा करके दोबारा चालू (revive) कराया जा सकता है। डिफॉल्ट अवधि में भी खाते में मौजूद बैलेंस पर ब्याज मिलता रहता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Minimum ₹250 annual deposit miss hone par account default ho jata hai. Har default year ke liye ₹50 penalty + ₹250 deposit dekar account revive ho sakta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Default account ko 15 years complete hone se pehle kabhi bhi revive kiya ja sakta hai. Default rehne par bhi purane balance par government interest rate continue milta rehta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Default fee is ₹50 per year plus minimum deposit of ₹250 per defaulted year; interest continues to accrue.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 4(3) and 4(4)

source_title: SSY Default Account Regularization Rules
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Interest accrual rule updated in 2019: earlier defaulted accounts earned only PO savings interest.

canonical_question: Can an SCSS account be opened jointly with a spouse and what are the individual vs combined deposit limits?
alternate_phrasings: Can husband and wife both invest ₹30 lakh each in SCSS?
SCSS joint account spouse ke sath kholne ke niyam kya hain?
Who owns the deposit in an SCSS joint account if the primary holder passes away?
short_answer: Yes, an SCSS account can be opened jointly with a spouse only. In a joint account, the investment limit is ₹30 lakh, but if both spouses independently qualify, they can invest up to ₹60 lakh across two separate accounts.
detailed_answer: Under SCSS Scheme Rules, joint accounts are permitted exclusively with a spouse; joint holding with children or other relatives is prohibited. The entire deposit in a joint account is legally attributable solely to the primary account holder. The maximum deposit ceiling in a single joint account is ₹30 lakh. However, if both spouses independently fulfill the age criteria (60+ years, or 55+ with retirement benefits), both spouses can open separate individual accounts of ₹30 lakh each, allowing the couple to invest a combined total of ₹60 lakh in SCSS.

hi.short_answer: हां, SCSS खाता केवल पति या पत्नी के साथ संयुक्त रूप से खोला जा सकता है। संयुक्त खाते की सीमा ₹30 लाख है, लेकिन दोनों के पात्र होने पर अलग खातों में कुल ₹60 लाख जमा किए जा सकते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: SCSS में संयुक्त खाता केवल जीवनसाथी (spouse) के साथ ही खोला जा सकता है। संयुक्त खाते में पूरी जमा राशि प्राथमिक खाताधारक की मानी जाती है। यदि पति और पत्नी दोनों पात्र हैं, तो वे अलग-अलग खाते खोलकर कुल ₹60 लाख (₹30 लाख + ₹30 लाख) तक सुरक्षित निवेश कर सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Haan, SCSS joint account sirf spouse ke sath open ho sakta hai. Joint account me limit ₹30 lakh hai, par dono eligible hone par alag-alag accounts me ₹60 lakh invest ho sakte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: SCSS joint account bachho ya relatives ke sath open nahi hota, sirf spouse ke sath hota hai. Joint account ka pura fund primary holder ka maana jata hai. Dono spouse eligible hone par alag accounts me ₹30-₹30 lakh dal sakte hain.

supporting_claims.claim: SCSS joint account allowed only with spouse; primary holder owns funds; spouses can hold separate accounts up to ₹30 lakh each.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme Rules, 2019, Paragraph 3(3) and 4

source_title: SCSS Joint Account and Deposit Ceiling Guidelines
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Secondary holder in joint account does not need to satisfy age criterion.

canonical_question: What penalty is deducted if a Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS) account is closed prematurely before 5 years?
alternate_phrasings: What is the deduction for premature closure of SCSS in year 1 vs year 2?
SCSS account time se pehle band karne par kitna deduction lagta hai?
Can SCSS be closed prematurely after extension period?
short_answer: If an SCSS account is closed after 1 year but before 2 years, a 1.5% deduction of principal applies; between 2 and 5 years, a 1% deduction applies; if closed within 1 year, all paid interest is recovered from principal.
detailed_answer: Under Paragraph 8 of the SCSS Scheme Rules 2019, premature closure is permitted anytime subject to statutory deductions: (1) Closure within 1 year of opening: No interest is payable; any quarterly interest already credited is deducted from the principal balance; (2) Closure after 1 year but before 2 years: An amount equal to 1.5% of the principal deposit is deducted as penalty; (3) Closure after 2 years but before 5 years: An amount equal to 1.0% of the principal deposit is deducted as penalty. In extended accounts (extended by 3 years after the initial 5-year tenure), the account can be closed after 1 year from the date of extension without any deduction.

hi.short_answer: SCSS में 1 से 2 साल के बीच बंद करने पर मूलधन का 1.5% और 2 से 5 साल के बीच बंद करने पर 1% पेनल्टी कटती है। 1 साल के भीतर बंद करने पर पूरा ब्याज वापस ले लिया जाता है।
hi.detailed_answer: SCSS खाता समय पूर्व बंद करने पर: 1 वर्ष के भीतर बंद करने पर कोई ब्याज नहीं मिलता और दिया गया ब्याज मूलधन से काटा जाता है; 1 से 2 वर्ष के बीच 1.5% मूलधन कटता है; 2 से 5 वर्ष के बीच 1% मूलधन कटता है। यदि खाता 5 साल के बाद 3 साल के लिए बढ़ाया गया हो, तो 1 साल बाद बिना किसी कटौती के बंद किया जा सकता है।

hinglish.short_answer: SCSS premature closure par 1-2 saal me 1.5% principal penalty aur 2-5 saal me 1.0% penalty deduct hoti hai. 1 saal se pehle close karne par sara interest recover ho jata hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: First year me close karne par zero interest milta hai. 1-2 years me 1.5% principal deduction hota hai aur 2 years ke baad 1% deduction hota hai. Extended account me 1 year ke baad zero penalty lagti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Premature penalty is recovery of interest in Year 1, 1.5% deduction in Year 2, and 1% deduction between Years 2-5.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme Rules, 2019, Paragraph 8

source_title: SCSS Scheme Rules on Premature Closure and Penalties
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Updated rules in 2023 allow penalty-free closure after 1 year in extended accounts.

canonical_question: Can a National Savings Certificate (NSC) be pledged as security for bank loans and who is authorized to accept the pledge?
alternate_phrasings: How to pledge NSC certificate to bank for availing loan?
NSC ko bank me girvi rakh kar loan kaise le?
Which authorities can accept pledged National Savings Certificates?
short_answer: Yes, an NSC can be pledged as loan security to the President of India, State Governors, Reserve Bank of India, scheduled commercial banks, cooperative banks, government companies, and NHB-approved housing finance companies.
detailed_answer: Under Rule 12 of the Government Savings Promotion General Rules, 2018, and the National Savings Certificates (VIII Issue) Scheme 2019, an NSC can be pledged or transferred as collateral security. Authorized pledgees include: (1) The President of India or Governor of a State in their official capacity; (2) The RBI, scheduled banks, cooperative banks, and cooperative credit societies; (3) Public or private corporations and government companies; (4) Local authorities; (5) Housing finance companies approved by the National Housing Bank. The pledge requires submitting an application in Form 5 at the relevant post office along with an acceptance letter from the pledgee bank.

hi.short_answer: हां, NSC को बैंक लोन के लिए सुरक्षा के रूप में राष्ट्रपति, राज्यपाल, RBI, अनुसूचित बैंकों, सहकारी बैंकों और सरकारी कंपनियों के पास गिरवी रखा जा सकता है।
hi.detailed_answer: राष्ट्रीय बचत पत्र (NSC) को लोन के लिए कोलैटरल सिक्योरिटी के तौर पर गिरवी (pledge) रखा जा सकता है। अधिकृत संस्थानों में कमर्शियल बैंक, कॉपरेटिव बैंक, RBI, हाउसिंग फाइनेंस कंपनियां और सरकारी निगम शामिल हैं। इसके लिए पोस्ट ऑफिस में फॉर्म 5 और बैंक का स्वीकृति पत्र जमा करना होता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Haan, NSC certificate ko bank loan ke liye scheduled commercial banks, cooperative banks, RBI aur government corporations ke pas pledge kiya ja sakta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Post Office me Form 5 submit karke aur bank ka sanction letter dekar NSC ko pledge karwaya ja sakta hai. Loan default hone par bank official procedure se certificate encash karwa sakta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: NSC can be pledged to banks, RBI, government bodies, and housing finance companies under prescribed rules.
supporting_claims.citation_source: National Savings Certificates (VIII Issue) Scheme 2019, Paragraph 11

source_title: NSC Pledging and Transfer as Security Rules
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Pledge fee may be charged by post office per certificate.

canonical_question: How is interest on National Savings Certificate (NSC) taxed annually and does accrued interest qualify for Section 80C deduction?
alternate_phrasings: Is NSC interest taxable on accrual basis or maturity under Old vs New Tax Regime?
NSC ke byaj par income tax kaise lagta hai?
Why is the 5th year interest on NSC not eligible for 80C reinvestment benefit?
