short_answer: NSC interest is taxable on an accrual basis annually under 'Income from Other Sources'. For the first 4 years, accrued interest is deemed reinvested and qualifies for Section 80C deduction; fifth-year interest is fully taxable.
detailed_answer: Although NSC interest is compounded annually and paid as a lump sum at 5-year maturity, income tax laws treat the interest as accrued income in each respective financial year. Under the Old Tax Regime: (1) Interest accrued during years 1 to 4 is considered automatically reinvested in the certificate and qualifies for tax deduction under Section 80C within the overall ₹1.5 lakh ceiling; (2) Interest accrued in the 5th and final year cannot be reinvested and is fully taxable at the investor's tax slab; (3) Under the New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC), Section 80C deductions are unavailable, making all accrued annual interest fully taxable.

hi.short_answer: NSC का ब्याज हर साल उपार्जित (accrual) आधार पर कर योग्य होता है। शुरुआती 4 वर्षों का ब्याज पुनर्निवेशित मानकर धारा 80C में छूट योग्य होता है, जबकि 5वें वर्ष का ब्याज पूर्णतः कर योग्य होता है।
hi.detailed_answer: पुरानी कर व्यवस्था में NSC के पहले 4 वर्षों का संचित ब्याज धारा 80C के तहत ₹1.5 लाख की सीमा में कर छूट का हकदार होता है क्योंकि वह पुनर्निवेशित माना जाता है। 5वें वर्ष का ब्याज परिपक्व हो जाने के कारण 80C में नहीं आता और पूरी तरह टैक्स योग्य होता है। नई कर व्यवस्था में 80C छूट न होने के कारण सभी 5 वर्षों का ब्याज पूरी तरह टैक्स स्लैब अनुसार कर योग्य है।

hinglish.short_answer: NSC interest annual accrual basis par taxable hota hai. Pehle 4 saal ka accrued interest 80C me reinvested maana jata hai aur deduction milta hai, 5th year ka interest fully taxable hota hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Old Tax Regime me saal 1 se 4 tak ka interest Section 80C me claim ho sakta hai. 5th year ka interest maturity year hone ki wajah se 80C me eligible nahi hota. New Tax Regime me koi 80C deduction nahi milta aur sara interest taxable hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Accrued interest in first 4 years qualifies for 80C deduction as reinvestment; fifth year interest is fully taxable.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Income Tax Department Circular & Section 80C of Income Tax Act, 1961

source_title: Tax Treatment of Accrued Interest on National Savings Certificates
source_publisher: Income Tax Department of India
reviewer_notes: Crucial tax reporting detail: taxpayers must declare annual accrued interest in ITR.

canonical_question: How many months does it take for Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) to double at the current 7.5% interest rate?
alternate_phrasings: What is the exact doubling tenure of KVP in months and years?
Kisan Vikas Patra me paisa kitne samay me double hota hai?
Does KVP doubling period change for existing certificates if interest rate is revised?
short_answer: At the current interest rate of 7.5% compounded annually, Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) doubles the invested amount in exactly 115 months (9 years and 7 months).
detailed_answer: Under the Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme 2019, the tenure of the certificate is defined by the time required for the principal to double based on the prevailing interest rate. At the current government-notified interest rate of 7.5% per annum compounded annually, an investment doubles in 115 months (9 years and 7 months). Crucially, the doubling period is locked in at the time of certificate issuance and remains unchanged for that certificate even if interest rates are subsequently revised for new issues.

hi.short_answer: वर्तमान 7.5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर पर किसान विकास पत्र (KVP) में जमा राशि ठीक 115 महीने (9 वर्ष 7 माह) में दोगुनी हो जाती है।
hi.detailed_answer: KVP योजना के तहत परिपक्वता अवधि पैसा दोगुना होने के समय पर निर्भर करती है। 7.5% की वर्तमान दर पर यह अवधि 115 महीने तय की गई है। एक बार सर्टिफिकेट जारी होने के बाद उस पर तय की गई परिपक्वता अवधि अपरिवर्तित रहती है, भले ही भविष्य में सरकार द्वारा नई दरों में बदलाव किया जाए।

hinglish.short_answer: Current 7.5% interest rate par Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) me invested amount exactly 115 months (9 years 7 months) me double hota hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: KVP me doubling tenure purchase ke time lock ho jata hai. Agar aapne 115 months wale period me purchase kiya hai to future rate cuts se aapka maturity period affect nahi hoga aur paisa 115 months me hi double hoga.

supporting_claims.claim: KVP doubles in 115 months at 7.5% interest compounded annually.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance Notification on Small Savings Interest Rates

source_title: Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme Maturity Schedule
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Tenure reduced from 120 to 115 months when rate was hiked to 7.5%.

canonical_question: What is the mandatory lock-in period before which Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) cannot be prematurely encashed?
alternate_phrasings: Can KVP be withdrawn before 2.5 years (30 months)?
KVP premature withdrawal lock-in period kitna hota hai?
Under what exceptional grounds can KVP be cashed before 30 months?
short_answer: Kisan Vikas Patra has a mandatory lock-in period of 2 years and 6 months (30 months) from the date of purchase, before which premature encashment is prohibited under normal circumstances.
detailed_answer: Under Paragraph 7 of the Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme 2019, premature withdrawal is not permitted before the expiry of 2 years and 6 months (30 months) from the date of deposit. Exceptions to this lock-in apply only on the death of the holder (or any joint holder), on forfeiture by an authorized pledgee (such as a bank gazetted officer), or upon an explicit court order. If encashed after 30 months but before the 115-month maturity, the redemption value is paid according to a pre-defined statutory table at a lower effective yield.

hi.short_answer: किसान विकास पत्र (KVP) में 2 वर्ष 6 माह (30 महीने) का अनिवार्य लॉक-इन पीरियड होता है, जिससे पहले सामान्य स्थिति में पैसा नहीं निकाला जा सकता।
hi.detailed_answer: KVP नियमों के अनुसार, जमा की तारीख से 30 महीने पूरे होने के बाद ही समय पूर्व निकासी (premature withdrawal) की जा सकती है। 30 महीने से पहले निकासी केवल खाताधारक की मृत्यु या न्यायालय के आदेश पर ही संभव है। 30 महीने के बाद निकासी पर सरकारी तालिका के अनुसार निर्धारित ब्याज दर पर भुगतान किया जाता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) me 2.5 saal (30 months) ka mandatory lock-in period hota hai. Isse pehle premature encashment allow nahi hota.
hinglish.detailed_answer: 30 months complete hone ke baad KVP ko post office se prematurely encash karwaya ja sakta hai, par return pre-fixed table ke mutabiq kam milta hai. Death ya court order ke alawa 30 months se pehle withdrawal strictly prohibited hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Premature closure permitted after 2 years and 6 months from deposit date.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme, 2019, Paragraph 7(1)

source_title: Kisan Vikas Patra Premature Encashment Table and Rules
source_publisher: National Savings Institute
reviewer_notes: Provides liquidity advantage over 5-year locked NSC.

canonical_question: When and how much can be partially withdrawn from a Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC) account?
alternate_phrasings: Can a woman withdraw up to 40% from MSSC after 1 year?
Mahila Samman Bachat Patra se 1 saal baad kitna paisa nikal sakte hain?
What is the partial withdrawal rule for MSSC opened for a minor girl?
short_answer: A partial withdrawal of up to 40% of the eligible balance is permitted once after completing one year from the date of account opening.
detailed_answer: Under Paragraph 8 of the Mahila Samman Savings Certificate Scheme, 2023, the account holder is entitled to execute a single partial withdrawal after the expiry of one year from the date of opening the account. The maximum permissible partial withdrawal amount is 40% of the balance standing in the account at the time of application. In the case of an account opened on behalf of a minor girl, the guardian can execute the withdrawal for the benefit of the minor by submitting Form 3 to the post office or bank.

hi.short_answer: खाता खोलने के 1 वर्ष पूरे होने के बाद खाते में जमा राशि का अधिकतम 40% एक बार आंशिक रूप से निकाला जा सकता है।
hi.detailed_answer: महिला सम्मान बचत प्रमाणपत्र योजना, 2023 के तहत खाताधारक 1 साल पूरा होने पर अपने खाते के बैलेंस का अधिकतम 40% निकाल सकती है। यह सुविधा पूरी 2 साल की अवधि में केवल एक बार उपलब्ध होती है। नाबालिग लड़की के खाते से अभिभावक बच्ची की भलाई के लिए फॉर्म 3 भरकर यह निकासी कर सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: MSSC account open hone ke 1 saal baad eligible balance ka maximum 40% partial withdrawal allow hota hai (sirf ek baar).
hinglish.detailed_answer: 1 year complete hone par account holder Form 3 submit karke up to 40% balance withdraw kar sakti hai. 2-year tenure me yeh partial withdrawal facility sirf ek baar milti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Partial withdrawal up to 40% of balance permitted once after 1 year from account opening.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate Scheme, 2023, Paragraph 8

source_title: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate Partial Withdrawal Regulations
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Remaining 60% continues to earn 7.5% quarterly compounded interest until 2-year maturity.

canonical_question: Is TDS deducted on interest earned from Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC) and is the interest taxable?
alternate_phrasings: Does MSSC have Section 80C tax deduction or TDS exemption?
Mahila Samman Savings Certificate ke byaj par tax lagta hai kya?
What is the TDS threshold under Section 194A for MSSC post office deposits?
short_answer: Interest earned on MSSC is fully taxable according to the investor's income tax slab, but no TDS is deducted at source because the maximum annual interest is well below the statutory Section 194A TDS threshold.
detailed_answer: The tax treatment of Mahila Samman Savings Certificate involves two rules: (1) Taxability: The scheme does not offer any tax deduction under Section 80C, and the 7.5% interest earned is fully taxable under 'Income from Other Sources' at the investor's applicable slab rate; (2) TDS Exemption: Under Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) Circular No. 4/2023, no Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) is deducted on MSSC interest. Even on the maximum investment of ₹2,00,000, the total annual interest is approximately ₹15,400, which is far below the statutory Section 194A TDS threshold of ₹40,000 (or ₹50,000 for senior citizens).

hi.short_answer: MSSC का ब्याज निवेशक के टैक्स स्लैब अनुसार कर योग्य है, लेकिन इस पर TDS नहीं काटा जाता क्योंकि सालाना ब्याज ₹40,000 की TDS सीमा से काफी कम होता है।
hi.detailed_answer: महिला सम्मान बचत प्रमाणपत्र में धारा 80C के तहत कोई कर छूट नहीं मिलती। इस पर मिलने वाला 7.5% ब्याज आयकर स्लैब के अनुसार टैक्स योग्य है। हालांकि, ₹2 लाख के अधिकतम निवेश पर भी 1 साल का ब्याज लगभग ₹15,400 बनता है, जो टीडीएस सीमा (₹40,000) से बहुत कम है, इसलिए पोस्ट ऑफिस या बैंक द्वारा कोई TDS नहीं काटा जाता।

hinglish.short_answer: MSSC par interest income tax slab ke hisab se fully taxable hai, par TDS nahi katta kyunki total interest ₹40,000 threshold se kaafi kam hota hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: MSSC me Section 80C deduction nahi milta. Interest taxable hota hai aur ITR me Other Sources me declare karna hota hai. Maximum ₹2 lakh deposit par bhi annual interest ₹15,400 banta hai, isliye Section 194A ke tehat koi TDS deduct nahi hota.

supporting_claims.claim: Interest on MSSC is taxable at slab rate; no TDS deducted as interest does not exceed Section 194A threshold.
supporting_claims.citation_source: CBDT Circular No. 4/2023 & Section 194A Income Tax Act

source_title: CBDT Clarification on TDS Applicability to Mahila Samman Savings Certificate
source_publisher: Central Board of Direct Taxes, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Confirmed by CBDT Notification No. 27/2023.

canonical_question: Can an existing PMEGP beneficiary apply for a second loan for enterprise upgrading and what is the maximum ceiling?
alternate_phrasings: What is the eligibility for PMEGP second loan for expansion?
PMEGP me dusra loan (second loan) kaise milta hai?
Can I get up to ₹1 crore for manufacturing expansion under PMEGP 2nd loan?
short_answer: Yes, an existing PMEGP/Mudra unit can apply for a second loan for upgrading: the maximum project cost is ₹1 crore for manufacturing units and ₹25 lakh for service units.
detailed_answer: Under the PMEGP 2nd Loan for Upgradation scheme, well-performing micro-enterprises can expand and modernize their operations. The maximum project cost eligible for financing is ₹1.00 crore for manufacturing enterprises and ₹25.00 lakh for service/trading enterprises. To qualify, the unit must have fully repaid the first PMEGP/REGP/Mudra loan, been operational and profitable for at least the last three consecutive financial years, maintained proper books of accounts, possess Udyam Registration, and create additional employment.

hi.short_answer: हां, सफल PMEGP इकाइयां अपग्रेडेशन के लिए दूसरे लोन के तहत मैन्युफैक्चरिंग के लिए अधिकतम ₹1 करोड़ और सर्विस सेक्टर के लिए ₹25 लाख तक आवेदन कर सकती हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: PMEGP 2nd Loan योजना के तहत मौजूदा इकाइयां अपने व्यवसाय का आधुनिकीकरण कर सकती हैं। अधिकतम प्रोजेक्ट लागत विनिर्माण के लिए ₹1 करोड़ और सेवा क्षेत्र के लिए ₹25 लाख है। इसके लिए पहला लोन समय पर चुकता होना और पिछले 3 वर्षों से इकाई का लगातार लाभ में चलना आवश्यक है।

hinglish.short_answer: Haan, existing PMEGP units expansion ke liye second loan le sakti hain: Manufacturing me maximum ₹1 crore aur service me maximum ₹25 lakh project cost allow hoti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Second loan ke liye first loan completely repay hona chahiye, unit last 3 years se continuous profit me honi chahiye, aur Udyam registration hona mandatory hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Second loan ceiling is ₹1 crore for manufacturing and ₹25 lakh for services under PMEGP upgradation scheme.
supporting_claims.citation_source: KVIC Operational Guidelines for 2nd Loan under PMEGP

source_title: Guidelines for 2nd Loan for Upgradation of Existing PMEGP/REGP/Mudra Units
source_publisher: Khadi and Village Industries Commission
reviewer_notes: Applied online through dedicated 2nd loan link on PMEGP e-portal.

canonical_question: What is the margin money subsidy percentage for the PMEGP second loan for upgrading manufacturing vs service units?
alternate_phrasings: What is the subsidy rate on PMEGP second loan for general vs hill states?
PMEGP second loan me margin money subsidy kitni milti hai?
Is the maximum subsidy capped at ₹15 lakh or ₹20 lakh for PMEGP second loan?
short_answer: The margin money subsidy on the PMEGP second loan is 15% of the project cost for normal states (max ₹15 lakh for manufacturing, ₹3.75 lakh for services) and 20% for NER and Hill States.
detailed_answer: Unlike the first PMEGP loan where subsidies range up to 35%, the PMEGP Second Loan for Upgradation provides a standardized subsidy structure: (1) In Non-NER and Non-Hill States, the Margin Money subsidy is 15% of the eligible project cost, capped at ₹15.00 lakh for manufacturing units and ₹3.75 lakh for service units; (2) In North Eastern Region (NER) and Hill States (Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, J&K, Ladakh), the subsidy is 20% of the project cost, capped at ₹20.00 lakh for manufacturing and ₹5.00 lakh for service units. The applicant must contribute 10% own equity, and the remaining 70-75% is sanctioned as a bank term loan.

hi.short_answer: PMEGP दूसरे लोन पर सामान्य राज्यों में 15% सब्सिडी (अधिकतम ₹15 लाख) और पूर्वोत्तर/पहाड़ी राज्यों में 20% सब्सिडी (अधिकतम ₹20 लाख) मिलती है।
hi.detailed_answer: दूसरे लोन के लिए सब्सिडी की दरें: सामान्य राज्यों में प्रोजेक्ट लागत का 15% (मैन्युफैक्चरिंग पर अधिकतम ₹15 लाख, सर्विस पर ₹3.75 लाख); पूर्वोत्तर राज्यों और पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में 20% (मैन्युफैक्चरिंग पर अधिकतम ₹20 लाख, सर्विस पर ₹5 लाख) सब्सिडी दी जाती है।

hinglish.short_answer: PMEGP second loan par normal states me 15% subsidy (max ₹15 lakh) aur NER/Hill states me 20% subsidy (max ₹20 lakh) milti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Second loan me 1st loan jitni 35% subsidy nahi milti. Flat 15% subsidy general areas me aur 20% hill/NER areas me milti hai. Beneficiary ko 10% own contribution lagana hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Margin money subsidy is 15% in general areas and 20% in NER/Hill areas on PMEGP second loan.
supporting_claims.citation_source: KVIC PMEGP 2nd Loan Policy Circular

source_title: Subsidy Computation Matrix for PMEGP Second Loan for Upgradation
source_publisher: Ministry of MSME
reviewer_notes: Subsidy held in TDR for 3 years before final adjustment by financing bank.

canonical_question: Which activities and businesses are included in the negative list and prohibited from receiving PMEGP financing?
alternate_phrasings: What businesses cannot get subsidy under PMEGP scheme?
PMEGP negative list me kaun kaun se business aate hain?
Can meat, alcohol, tobacco, or crop cultivation get PMEGP loans?
short_answer: Prohibited businesses under PMEGP include meat/slaughter processing, intoxicants/tobacco, crop cultivation/plantations, polythene carry bags below 120 microns, and rural transport vehicles exceeding 25 seats.
detailed_answer: The Negative List of activities strictly excluded from PMEGP financing comprises: (1) Businesses connected with meat processing, slaughterhouses, serving/selling intoxicants, alcohol, tobacco products (bidi, pan masala, cigarettes); (2) Agricultural production such as cultivation of crops, plantations, floriculture, sericulture (though agro-processing and post-harvest food processing units are permitted); (3) Manufacturing of non-biodegradable polythene carry bags of thickness less than 120 microns and single-use plastic items banned by environmental law; (4) Rural transport vehicles exceeding the permissible rural passenger carrier cap (transport vehicles must follow specified seating limits).

hi.short_answer: PMEGP की निषिद्ध (Negative) सूची में मांस/बूचड़खाना, शराब, तंबाकू उत्पाद, फसल की खेती/बागवानी, 120 माइक्रोन से कम की पॉलीथिन और बड़े यात्री वाहन शामिल हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: PMEGP के तहत इन गतिविधियों पर लोन नहीं मिलता: (1) मांस का प्रसंस्करण या वधशाला; (2) शराब, बीड़ी, सिगरेट और तंबाकू उत्पाद; (3) सीधी कृषि फसल की खेती या वृक्षारोपण (हालांकि खाद्य प्रसंस्करण इकाइयां पात्र हैं); (4) 120 माइक्रोन से पतले प्लास्टिक कैरी बैग; (5) तय सीमा से अधिक यात्री क्षमता वाले ग्रामीण वाहन।

hinglish.short_answer: PMEGP negative list me meat shops, alcohol, bidi/tobacco, direct farming/crop cultivation, thin polythene aur large passenger vehicles prohibited hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Agriculture crop cultivation par PMEGP loan nahi milta (food processing allowed hai). Meat, liquor aur tobacco units ko PMEGP subsidy nahi di ja sakti. Restricted plastic carry bags banana bhi banned hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Meat processing, intoxicants, crop cultivation, thin plastics are barred under PMEGP Negative List.
supporting_claims.citation_source: KVIC PMEGP Scheme Negative List of Activities, Annexure-I

source_title: Negative List of Activities under PMEGP
source_publisher: Khadi and Village Industries Commission
reviewer_notes: Food processing of agricultural produce is permitted; direct crop cultivation is barred.

canonical_question: What is the Tarun Plus category under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana and who qualifies for loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹20 lakh?
alternate_phrasings: How to get Mudra loan up to ₹20 lakh under Union Budget 2024 announcement?
Mudra loan me 20 lakh ka Tarun Plus loan kisko milta hai?
Can first-time borrowers apply directly for Tarun Plus Mudra loan?
short_answer: Tarun Plus is a newly notified PMMY category providing collateral-free loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹20 lakh exclusively to entrepreneurs who have previously availed and successfully repaid Tarun category loans.
detailed_answer: Announced in Union Budget 2024-25 and officially notified by the Ministry of Finance on October 24, 2024, the Tarun Plus category enhances the maximum Mudra loan ceiling from ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh. To qualify for Tarun Plus: (1) The applicant must be a repeat borrower who has previously availed a loan under the 'Tarun' category (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh); (2) The earlier Tarun loan must have been fully repaid with a flawless track record without any default; (3) First-time borrowers cannot jump directly to Tarun Plus; (4) The credit guarantee coverage under CGFMU has been simultaneously extended to cover loans up to ₹20 lakh.

hi.short_answer: तरुण प्लस मुद्रा योजना की नई श्रेणी है जो उन उद्यमियों को ₹10 लाख से ₹20 लाख तक का लोन देती है जिन्होंने पूर्व में तरुण लोन लेकर उसे समय पर पूरी तरह चुका दिया है।
hi.detailed_answer: केंद्रीय बजट 2024 के तहत 24 अक्टूबर 2024 को अधिसूचित, 'तरुण प्लस' श्रेणी मुद्रा लोन की सीमा को ₹10 लाख से बढ़ाकर ₹20 लाख करती है। यह सुविधा केवल उन्हीं उद्यमियों के लिए है जिन्होंने पहले 'तरुण' श्रेणी का लोन लिया था और उसका समय पर पूरा भुगतान कर दिया है। नए आवेदक सीधे तरुण प्लस के लिए आवेदन नहीं कर सकते।

hinglish.short_answer: Tarun Plus PMMY ki new category hai jo ₹10 lakh se ₹20 lakh tak loan provide karti hai un borrowers ko jinhone pehle Tarun loan successfully repay kiya ho.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Budget 2024 me Mudra limit badhakar ₹20 lakh ki gayi thi jo October 2024 se लागू ho gayi hai. First-time borrowers directly ₹20 lakh nahi le sakte; unka pehla Tarun loan track record clean hona mandatory hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Tarun Plus enhances Mudra limit to ₹20 lakh for repeat borrowers who repaid Tarun category loans.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance PIB Press Release PRID 2067713 dated 25th October 2024

source_title: Notification of Enhanced Mudra Loan Limit under Tarun Plus Category
source_publisher: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Operationalized across all Member Lending Institutions in October 2024.

canonical_question: Are processing fees and upfront charges exempted for Mudra loans under the Shishu category?
alternate_phrasings: Can banks charge processing fee on Mudra loan up to ₹50,000?
Mudra Shishu loan par processing fee lagti hai kya?
What are the processing charges for Kishor and Tarun Mudra categories?
short_answer: Yes, under RBI guidelines, banks and financial institutions are strictly prohibited from charging any processing fee or upfront charges for Mudra loans under the Shishu category (up to ₹50,000).
detailed_answer: As per Reserve Bank of India lending directions and MUDRA operational guidelines: (1) Shishu Loans (up to ₹50,000): Zero processing fees and zero upfront charges can be levied by any commercial bank, regional rural bank, or microfinance institution; (2) Kishor and Tarun Loans (above ₹50,000 up to ₹20,000): Lenders may charge nominal processing fees as per their internal board-approved lending policies, usually capped at 0.50% of the loan amount, but many public sector banks frequently waive these fees during promotional MSME outreach drives.

hi.short_answer: हां, RBI के नियमों के अनुसार शिशु श्रेणी (₹50,000 तक) के मुद्रा लोन पर कोई प्रोसेसिंग फीस या अपफ्रंट चार्ज नहीं लिया जा सकता।
hi.detailed_answer: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) और मुद्रा दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार, ₹50,000 तक के शिशु लोन पर कोई भी बैंक या वित्तीय संस्थान प्रोसेसिंग फीस नहीं ले सकता। किशोर और तरुण ऋणों (₹50,000 से अधिक) पर बैंक अपने आंतरिक नियमों के अनुसार अधिकतम 0.50% तक प्रोसेसिंग शुल्क ले सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Haan, Mudra Shishu loans (upto ₹50,000) par banks koi processing fee ya upfront charges nahi le sakte, yeh 100% free hota hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Shishu loans par zero processing fee rule RBI mandated hai. Kishor aur Tarun loans me banks nominal processing fee charge kar sakte hain, par aksar public sector banks special drives me use bhi waive off kar dete hain.

supporting_claims.claim: No processing fee is charged for Shishu loans up to ₹50,000 under PMMY guidelines.
supporting_claims.citation_source: MUDRA Ltd FAQ on Processing Fees and Charges

source_title: MUDRA Master Guidelines on Processing Fees and Loan Pricing
source_publisher: Department of Financial Services
reviewer_notes: Statutory exemption protects micro-borrowers from hidden upfront loan costs.

canonical_question: What is the Mudra Card and how does it provide working capital cash credit and ATM overdraft access?
alternate_phrasings: How to use Mudra debit card for working capital expenses?
Mudra card kya hota hai aur iska use kaise kare?
Is interest charged only on the withdrawn amount using Mudra Card?
short_answer: The Mudra Card is a RuPay debit card linked to a cash credit/overdraft account, allowing entrepreneurs to withdraw working capital funds via ATMs and POS terminals as and when needed, paying interest only on drawn funds.
detailed_answer: The Mudra Card is an innovative digital credit mechanism designed to minimize interest costs for micro-entrepreneurs. It operates as a pre-approved RuPay debit card linked to the borrower's Cash Credit (CC) or Overdraft (OD) loan account. Instead of disbursing the entire working capital component as a lump sum term loan, funds remain in the CC limit. The entrepreneur can withdraw cash from ATMs or make POS/e-commerce purchases for business raw materials as needed. Interest is calculated strictly on the daily outstanding debit balance rather than the total sanctioned credit limit.

hi.short_answer: मुद्रा कार्ड एक रुपे डेबिट कार्ड है जो कैश क्रेडिट/ओवरड्राफ्ट खाते से जुड़ा होता है। इससे व्यापारी एटीएम और पीओएस से जरूरत के समय पैसा निकाल सकते हैं और ब्याज केवल निकाली गई राशि पर लगता है।
hi.detailed_answer: मुद्रा कार्ड व्यापारियों को वर्किंग कैपिटल (कार्यशील पूंजी) की सुविधा देता है। यह एक RuPay कार्ड होता है। पूरा लोन एकमुश्त लेने की बजाय कारोबारी जरूरत के अनुसार एटीएम से कैश निकाल सकते हैं या स्वाइप कर सकते हैं। ब्याज केवल उस रकम पर लगता है जिसका वास्तव में उपयोग किया गया हो, जिससे ब्याज का बोझ कम होता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Mudra Card ek RuPay debit card hai jo CC/OD account se link hota hai. Isse ATM se working capital withdraw kar sakte hain aur interest sirf used amount par lagta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Mudra card se business owners ko pura working capital lump-sum lene ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Jitna paisa ATM ya swipe karke use karte hain, daily basis par sirf usi outstanding amount par interest charge hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Mudra Card is a RuPay debit card providing working capital with interest charged only on drawn balance.
supporting_claims.citation_source: MUDRA Card Operational Manual, MUDRA Ltd

source_title: MUDRA Card Operational Guidelines and Benefits
source_publisher: MUDRA Ltd
reviewer_notes: Issued by all commercial and regional rural banks sanctioning PMMY limits.

canonical_question: What is the mandatory 51% shareholding requirement for non-individual enterprises under the Stand-Up India scheme?
alternate_phrasings: Can a partnership firm or private limited company apply for Stand-Up India?
Stand-Up India me company ke shareholding rules kya hain?
Must SC/ST or woman entrepreneur hold majority controlling stake in Stand-Up India company?
short_answer: In partnership firms, LLPs, or private limited companies applying for Stand-Up India, at least 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake must be held by an SC, ST, or Woman entrepreneur.
detailed_answer: While individual entrepreneurs applying for Stand-Up India must simply be SC/ST or female, the scheme also accommodates corporate entities and partnerships. Under the official Stand-Up India guidelines issued by SIDBI and DFS, in case of non-individual enterprises (such as Private Limited companies, Limited Liability Partnerships, or registered partnership firms), a minimum of 51% of the equity shareholding and management control must be continuously held by an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur throughout the tenure of the loan.

hi.short_answer: स्टैंड-अप इंडिया में पार्टनरशिप फर्म या प्राइवेट लिमिटेड कंपनी के लिए अनिवार्य है कि कम से कम 51% शेयरधारिता और नियंत्रण SC, ST या महिला उद्यमी के पास हो।
hi.detailed_answer: यदि कोई कंपनी या पार्टनरशिप फर्म स्टैंड-अप इंडिया के तहत ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ के लोन के लिए आवेदन करती है, तो उसमें कम से कम 51% की बहुलांश हिस्सेदारी (equity ownership) और नियंत्रण किसी महिला या अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति के उद्यमी के पास होना अनिवार्य है।

hinglish.short_answer: Stand-Up India me partnership firm ya Pvt Ltd company hone par minimum 51% shareholding aur control SC/ST ya woman entrepreneur ke pas hona compulsory hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Non-individual enterprises me majority stake (51%+) target beneficiary (SC, ST ya Woman) ke pas hona mandatory rule hai, warna bank Stand-Up India scheme ke tehat concession sanction nahi kar sakta.

supporting_claims.claim: At least 51% shareholding and controlling stake must be held by SC/ST or woman in non-individual enterprises.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Stand-Up India Scheme Guidelines, Clause 2(iii)

source_title: Stand-Up India Guidelines on Corporate and Partnership Eligibility
source_publisher: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
reviewer_notes: Prevents dilution of target-group benefits by majority non-eligible partners.

canonical_question: What is the minimum margin money contribution required from the borrower under the Stand-Up India scheme?
alternate_phrasings: How much self-contribution is required for Stand-Up India loan up to ₹1 crore?
Stand-Up India loan me borrower ko kitna margin money lagana padta hai?
Can state subsidy schemes meet the 15% margin money in Stand-Up India?
short_answer: The borrower must contribute a minimum of 15% of the total project cost as margin money, which can also be converged with eligible Central or State government subsidy schemes.
detailed_answer: Under Stand-Up India scheme provisions revised in 2021, the borrower's mandatory margin money contribution was reduced from 25% to up to 15% of the project cost. The scheme explicitly permits convergence: the borrower is required to bring in a minimum of 10% of project cost from their own funds, and the balance margin money can be covered through eligible central or state subsidy schemes. The bank then sanctions up to 85% of the project cost as a composite loan (term loan plus working capital).

hi.short_answer: स्टैंड-अप इंडिया योजना में उधारकर्ता को परियोजना लागत का न्यूनतम 15% मार्जिन मनी (स्वयं का अंशदान) देना होता है, जिसे सरकारी सब्सिडी के साथ भी पूरा किया जा सकता है।
hi.detailed_answer: वर्ष 2021 में संशोधित नियमों के अनुसार, मार्जिन मनी की आवश्यकता को 25% से घटाकर 15% कर दिया गया था। उद्यमी को अपने पास से कम से कम 10% लगाना होता है और बाकी 5% राज्य या केंद्र सरकार की सब्सिडी से समायोजित किया जा सकता है। बैंक प्रोजेक्ट लागत का 85% तक लोन स्वीकृत करता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Stand-Up India me minimum margin money 15% project cost hoti hai. Isme se 10% own funds aur baaki 5% state/central subsidy se converge ho sakti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Revised rules ke mutabiq margin money 15% hai aur bank composite loan 85% tak deta hai. Borrower ko minimum 10% own equity lagana compulsory hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Margin money requirement reduced to up to 15% of project cost with convergence allowed.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance Stand-Up India Revision Notification 2021

source_title: Stand-Up India Margin Money Convergence Guidelines
source_publisher: Department of Financial Services
reviewer_notes: Reduced from original 25% in Union Budget 2021-22.

canonical_question: What is the ₹15,000 toolkit incentive under PM Vishwakarma Yojana and how is the e-voucher issued?
alternate_phrasings: How can traditional artisans claim the 15000 rupees toolkit grant in PM Vishwakarma?
PM Vishwakarma me 15000 ka toolkit voucher kaise milta hai?
When is the toolkit incentive credited after basic training?
short_answer: The ₹15,000 toolkit incentive is a one-time grant issued as a digital e-voucher or DBT to enable verified artisans to procure modern, certified trade tools after skill verification.
detailed_answer: Under the PM Vishwakarma scheme, upon successful completion of the 5-7 days basic skill training and skill assessment, artisans receive a financial toolkit incentive of up to ₹15,000. This incentive is provided in digital format as an e-RUPI / e-voucher credited to the beneficiary's registered mobile number or directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to their Aadhaar-linked bank account. The voucher is redeemable specifically at authorized vendor outlets and digital portals to purchase government-approved, customized modern toolkits aligned with their specific trade.

hi.short_answer: ₹15,000 का टूलकिट प्रोत्साहन एकमुश्त अनुदान है जो बेसिक ट्रेनिंग पूरी करने पर कारीगरों को आधुनिक औजार खरीदने के लिए डिजिटल ई-वाउचर (e-RUPI) के रूप में मिलता है।
hi.detailed_answer: पीएम विश्वकर्मा योजना में 5-7 दिनों की बेसिक ट्रेनिंग और कौशल सत्यापन पूरा करने के बाद लाभार्थी को ₹15,000 तक का ई-वाउचर प्रदान किया जाता है। इस वाउचर से कारीगर अपने व्यवसाय से संबंधित आधुनिक और गुणवत्तापूर्ण औजार खरीद सकते हैं ताकि उनके काम की गुणवत्ता और उत्पादकता बढ़ सके।

hinglish.short_answer: PM Vishwakarma me ₹15,000 ka toolkit incentive e-RUPI voucher ke form me milta hai jisse artisans basic training ke baad modern tools khareed sakte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: 5-7 days basic skill training complete karne ke baad registered phone par ₹15,000 ka digital voucher credit hota hai, jise authorized toolkit vendor ke pas redeem karke approved tools liye ja sakte hain.

supporting_claims.claim: Toolkit incentive of up to ₹15,000 provided through e-vouchers upon basic skill training completion.
supporting_claims.citation_source: PM Vishwakarma Guidelines, Section 6.3 Toolkit Incentive

source_title: PM Vishwakarma Operational Guidelines on Toolkit Incentives
source_publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
reviewer_notes: e-RUPI digital voucher ensures funds are used strictly for trade equipment.

canonical_question: How much daily stipend is paid during basic and advanced training under PM Vishwakarma Yojana?
alternate_phrasings: Is ₹500 per day stipend paid during 5-7 days PM Vishwakarma training?
PM Vishwakarma training ke dauran kitna paisa stipend milta hai?
How is training stipend transferred to artisan Aadhaar bank account?
short_answer: Artisans undergo skill training under PM Vishwakarma receive a daily stipend of ₹500 per day credited directly to their bank accounts via DBT for both basic and advanced training.
detailed_answer: To compensate artisans for lost daily wages during skill upgradation, PM Vishwakarma Yojana provides a training stipend of ₹500 per day throughout the training period: (1) Basic Skill Training: 5 to 7 days (40 hours) with a total stipend payout of ₹2,500 to ₹3,500; (2) Advanced Skill Training: 15 days (120 hours) for interested certified artisans, with a total stipend payout of ₹7,500. The stipend is credited directly to the beneficiary's Aadhaar-seeded bank account through the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) upon biometric attendance verification.

hi.short_answer: पीएम विश्वकर्मा योजना के तहत बेसिक और एडवांस ट्रेनिंग के दौरान कारीगरों को ₹500 प्रतिदिन का वजीफा (stipend) सीधे बैंक खाते में DBT के माध्यम से मिलता है।
hi.detailed_answer: कारीगरों को दैनिक मजदूरी की भरपाई के लिए सरकार 5 से 7 दिन की बेसिक ट्रेनिंग और 15 दिन की एडवांस ट्रेनिंग के दौरान ₹500 प्रति दिन का स्टाइपेंड देती है। यह राशि बायोमेट्रिक उपस्थिति के आधार पर सीधे आधार से जुड़े बैंक खाते में भेजी जाती है।

hinglish.short_answer: PM Vishwakarma me training ke dauran ₹500 per day stipend milta hai jo biometric attendance verify hone par directly bank account me transfer hota hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Basic training (5-7 days) me total ₹2,500-₹3,500 aur advanced training (15 days) me ₹7,500 stipend direct DBT se milta hai taaki artisans ki daily wage loss na ho.

supporting_claims.claim: Training stipend of ₹500 per day provided for basic and advanced skill training via DBT.
supporting_claims.citation_source: PM Vishwakarma Scheme Guidelines, Section 6.2 Skill Upgradation

canonical_question: What are the loan amounts, repayment tenures, and concessional interest rate for Tranche 1 and Tranche 2 under PM Vishwakarma?
alternate_phrasings: Can artisans get ₹1 lakh first tranche and ₹2 lakh second tranche at 5% interest?
PM Vishwakarma me 1 lakh aur 2 lakh ka loan kaise milta hai?
Is collateral security needed for PM Vishwakarma loan?
short_answer: PM Vishwakarma offers Tranche 1 loan up to ₹1,00,000 (18 months tenure) and Tranche 2 up to ₹2,00,000 (30 months tenure) at a concessional 5% interest rate with zero collateral.
detailed_answer: Credit support under PM Vishwakarma is structured across two progressive tranches: (1) First Tranche: Collateral-free enterprise loan of up to ₹1,00,000 with an 18-month repayment tenure, available after completing basic skill training; (2) Second Tranche: Enhanced loan of up to ₹2,00,000 with a 30-month repayment tenure, available to artisans who maintain standard account status, repay Tranche 1 on time, and adopt digital transactions. Both tranches carry a concessional interest rate of 5% charged to the borrower, while the Ministry of MSME provides an interest subvention of up to 8% directly to financing banks.

hi.short_answer: पीएम विश्वकर्मा में पहली किस्त में ₹1 लाख (18 माह अवधि) और दूसरी किस्त में ₹2 लाख (30 माह अवधि) का बिना गारंटी लोन मात्र 5% रियायती ब्याज दर पर मिलता है।
hi.detailed_answer: योजना में कुल ₹3 लाख तक का लोन मिलता है: पहली बार में ₹1 लाख तक (18 महीने में चुकाने योग्य) और समय पर भुगतान करने पर दूसरी किस्त में ₹2 लाख (30 महीने में चुकाने योग्य)। कारीगर से केवल 5% ब्याज लिया जाता है, जबकि शेष 8% तक की ब्याज सब्सिडी सरकार बैंकों को देती है।

hinglish.short_answer: PM Vishwakarma me Tranche 1 me ₹1 lakh (18 months) aur Tranche 2 me ₹2 lakh (30 months) ka loan milta hai sirf 5% interest par bina kisi collateral ke.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Beneficiary ko sirf 5% interest pay karna hota hai, baaki 8% interest subsidy central government bank ko pay karti hai. Tranche 1 repay karne ke baad Tranche 2 ka ₹2 lakh loan sanction hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Loans up to ₹1 lakh (18 months) in Tranche 1 and ₹2 lakh (30 months) in Tranche 2 at 5% interest with up to 8% subvention.

canonical_question: What is the funding limit for proof-of-concept grants versus commercialization debt under Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)?
subcategory: Startup India Seed Fund & Credit Guarantee
alternate_phrasings: Can DPIIT recognized startups get up to ₹20 lakh grant and ₹50 lakh convertible debentures?
Startup India Seed Fund me grant aur loan kitna milta hai?
How to apply for SISFS through approved incubators?
short_answer: Under Startup India Seed Fund Scheme, DPIIT-recognized startups can receive grants up to ₹20 lakh for proof of concept and prototype development, and debt/convertible debentures up to ₹50 lakh for commercialization.
detailed_answer: The Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) provides financial assistance to DPIIT-recognized early-stage startups channeled through approved incubators: (1) Proof of Concept (PoC) / Prototyping: Grants up to ₹20,000,000 (₹20 lakh) for proof of concept, prototype development, or product trials, disbursed in milestone-linked tranches; (2) Commercialization & Scale: Up to ₹50,00,000 (₹50 lakh) through debt, convertible debentures, or debt-linked instruments for market entry, commercialization, and scale-up, carrying a maximum interest rate pegged to the prevailing repo rate and a tenure of up to 5 years.

hi.short_answer: स्टार्टअप इंडिया सीड फंड योजना में प्रूफ ऑफ कॉन्सेप्ट और प्रोटोटाइप के लिए ₹20 लाख तक का अनुदान (grant) और व्यवसायीकरण के लिए ₹50 लाख तक का ऋण या डिबेंचर मिलता है।
hi.detailed_answer: डीपीआईआईटी (DPIIT) द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त स्टार्टअप्स को अनुमोदित इनक्यूबेटर्स के माध्यम से फंडिंग मिलती है: प्रोटोटाइप बनाने और ट्रायल के लिए ₹20 लाख तक की 100% ग्रांट; और बाजार में उत्पाद उतारने (commercialization) के लिए ₹50 लाख तक का सॉफ्ट लोन या कन्वर्टिबल डिबेंचर दिया जाता है।

hinglish.short_answer: SISFS me DPIIT startups ko prototype aur PoC ke liye up to ₹20 lakh grant milti hai aur commercialization/scaling ke liye up to ₹50 lakh debt/convertible debentures milte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Startups approved incubators ke through apply karte hain. PoC grant non-repayable hoti hai (₹20 lakh max), jabki commercialization funding (₹50 lakh max) debt ya convertible debenture ke form me hoti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Grants up to ₹20 lakh for prototype/PoC and debt up to ₹50 lakh for commercialization under SISFS.

canonical_question: Why are income-tax payers ineligible to join Atal Pension Yojana (APY) from October 1, 2022 onwards?
alternate_phrasings: Can income tax payee open Atal Pension Yojana account after 2022 rule change?
Income tax bharne wale Atal Pension Yojana me khata khol sakte hain kya?
What happens to an APY account if the subscriber subsequently becomes an income taxpayer?
short_answer: Effective October 1, 2022, the Ministry of Finance barred income-tax payers from enrolling in Atal Pension Yojana to ensure government pension subsidies target low-income and unorganized sector workers.
detailed_answer: Under Ministry of Finance Gazette Notification GSR 623(E), any citizen who is or has been an income-tax payer under the Income Tax Act, 1961 is ineligible to join Atal Pension Yojana on or after October 1, 2022. If a subscriber who joined on or after October 1, 2022 is subsequently found to have been an income-tax payer on or before the application date, the APY account is closed, government co-contribution and accrued interest are forfeited, and only the subscriber's net contributions are refunded. Subscribers who enrolled prior to October 1, 2022 remain unaffected.

hi.short_answer: 1 अक्टूबर 2022 से आयकर दाताओं को अटल पेंशन योजना (APY) में शामिल होने से रोक दिया गया है ताकि सरकारी सब्सिडी का लाभ केवल असंगठित और गरीब वर्ग को मिल सके।
hi.detailed_answer: वित्त मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना के अनुसार, 1 अक्टूबर 2022 के बाद कोई भी व्यक्ति जो आयकर दाता है या रहा है, वह APY खाता नहीं खोल सकता। यदि कोई करदाता गलती से खाता खोल लेता है, तो खाता बंद कर दिया जाता है और केवल उसका जमा पैसा वापस मिलता है, कोई सरकारी लाभ नहीं मिलता। 1 अक्टूबर 2022 से पहले खुले खातों पर इसका प्रभाव नहीं पड़ेगा।

hinglish.short_answer: 1 October 2022 se income-tax payers Atal Pension Yojana (APY) join nahi kar sakte taaki government pension support unorganized workers tak restrict rahe.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Finance Ministry notification ke mutabiq agar koi taxpayer 1 Oct 2022 ke baad APY account kholta hai to account terminate karke sirf subscriber contribution refund kar diya jata hai. 1 Oct 2022 se pehle join karne wale taxpayers par yeh rule apply nahi hota.

supporting_claims.claim: Income-tax payers barred from joining APY from October 1, 2022 under Gazette Notification GSR 623(E).
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance Notification GSR 623(E) dated 10th August 2022

source_publisher: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
reviewer_notes: Enforced via automated PAN-Income Tax database integration during bank onboarding.

canonical_question: What is the rooftop solar subsidy rate for Group Housing Societies (GHS) and Resident Welfare Associations (RWA) under PM Surya Ghar?
subcategory: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar)
alternate_phrasings: Can housing societies get ₹18,000 per kW subsidy up to 500 kW under PM Surya Ghar?
Society aur apartment ke common meter par solar subsidy kitni milti hai?
What is the maximum subsidy cap of ₹90 lakh for housing society solar installations?
short_answer: Group Housing Societies (GHS) and RWAs receive a rooftop solar subsidy of ₹18,000 per kilowatt (kW) for common facilities and EV charging, up to a maximum capacity of 500 kW (up to ₹90 lakh total subsidy).
detailed_answer: Under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana guidelines, Group Housing Societies (GHS) and Resident Welfare Associations (RWA) are eligible for Central Financial Assistance to power common utility services (lifts, water pumps, common lighting, and EV charging infrastructure). The subsidy is fixed at ₹18,000 per kW. The maximum capacity eligible for central subsidy is 500 kW per society (inclusive of individual rooftop setups calculated at 3 kW per household). A residential society installing a 500 kW solar plant can receive a direct government subsidy of up to ₹90,00,000 (₹90 lakh), significantly reducing community common maintenance bills.

hi.short_answer: हाउसिंग सोसायटियों (GHS/RWA) को कॉमन मीटर और ईवी चार्जिंग के लिए ₹18,000 प्रति किलोवाट की दर से अधिकतम 500 kW तक (अधिकतम ₹90 लाख) सब्सिडी मिलती है।
hi.detailed_answer: पीएम सूर्य घर योजना में अपार्टमेंट और सोसायटियों के कॉमन एरिया (लिफ्ट, पानी की मोटर, स्ट्रीट लाइट) के लिए सोलर लगवाने पर ₹18,000 प्रति kW की सब्सिडी दी जाती है। एक सोसायटी के लिए अधिकतम क्षमता 500 kW तय है, जिससे सोसायटी को अधिकतम ₹90 लाख तक की सरकारी सब्सिडी मिल सकती है।

hinglish.short_answer: Housing Societies aur RWAs ko common facilities ke liye ₹18,000 per kW subsidy milti hai up to 500 kW capacity (max ₹90 lakh subsidy).
hinglish.detailed_answer: Apartment complexes common meter ke liye PM Surya Ghar portal par apply kar sakte hain. ₹18k/kW ke hisab se 500 kW tak subsidy allow hoti hai jisse community electricity cost drastically reduce ho jati hai.

supporting_claims.claim: GHS/RWA common facility solar subsidy is ₹18,000 per kW up to maximum 500 kW capacity.
supporting_claims.citation_source: MNRE PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Guidelines, Section 4.2 Group Housing Societies

source_title: PM Surya Ghar Guidelines for Group Housing Societies and RWAs
