reviewer_notes: Subject to net metering permission from the respective state DISCOM.

canonical_question: What are the mandatory DISCOM technical feasibility and net-metering approval steps on pmsuryaghar.gov.in?
subcategory: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar)
alternate_phrasings: How to get DISCOM feasibility approval for PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar?
Solar rooftop lagwane ke liye DISCOM net meter apply kaise kare?
Within how many days does DISCOM conduct net meter inspection for solar subsidy?
short_answer: The process requires: (1) Registering on pmsuryaghar.gov.in with consumer account number; (2) Applying for technical feasibility approval from DISCOM; (3) Installing via registered vendor; (4) Applying for net-metering; (5) Commissioning and inspection for DBT subsidy release.
detailed_answer: To claim PM Surya Ghar subsidy, consumers must strictly adhere to the six-stage national workflow: (1) Portal Registration: Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in by choosing State, Distribution Company (DISCOM), and entering Electricity Consumer Account Number, mobile, and email; (2) Feasibility Application: Submit rooftop solar application; the local DISCOM reviews distribution transformer load and grants technical feasibility approval; (3) Installation: Procure and install panels through a DISCOM-registered vendor; (4) Work Completion Submission: Vendor and consumer upload plant specifications, module serial numbers, and invoice; (5) Net-Meter Installation: DISCOM inspects the plant, replaces the existing meter with a bidirectional net-meter, and generates the Commissioning Certificate; (6) DBT Disbursement: Consumer uploads bank details and canceled cheque; subsidy is directly credited to bank account within 30 days.

hi.short_answer: प्रक्रिया: (1) पोर्टल पर रजिस्ट्रेशन; (2) डिस्कॉम से फिजिबिलिटी अप्रूवल; (3) रजिस्टर्ड वेंडर से इंस्टॉलेशन; (4) नेट-मीटरिंग आवेदन और इंस्पेक्शन; (5) कमीशनिंग सर्टिफिकेट जारी होने पर बैंक खाते में DBT सब्सिडी।
hi.detailed_answer: पीएम सूर्य घर सब्सिडी पाने के चरण: pmsuryaghar.gov.in पर बिजली बिल नंबर से रजिस्टर करें। डिस्कॉम से तकनीकी व्यवहार्यता (feasibility) मंजूरी मिलने के बाद ही रजिस्टर्ड वेंडर से सोलर पैनल लगवाएं। काम पूरा होने पर डिस्कॉम नेट-मीटर लगाएगी और कमीशनिंग सर्टिफिकेट जारी करेगी, जिसके बाद सब्सिडी सीधे बैंक खाते में आएगी।

hinglish.short_answer: Steps: (1) Portal registration with Consumer ID; (2) DISCOM feasibility approval; (3) Registered vendor installation; (4) Net-metering setup; (5) Inspection ke baad direct bank account me DBT subsidy.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Pehle pmsuryaghar.gov.in par consumer number se apply karna hota hai. DISCOM approval aane ke baad hi registered vendor se kaam karwaya jata hai. Net meter lagte hi commissioning certificate generate hota hai aur subsidy 30 days me credit ho jati hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Six-step digital workflow: Registration, Feasibility, Installation, Net-metering, Commissioning, and DBT payout.
supporting_claims.citation_source: National Portal for Rooftop Solar Step-by-Step User Manual

source_title: PM Surya Ghar Consumer Application and DISCOM Feasibility Manual
source_publisher: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
reviewer_notes: Feasibility approval is time-bound by state electricity regulatory commission norms.

canonical_question: Why must rooftop solar systems be installed exclusively through registered DISCOM vendors to qualify for PM Surya Ghar subsidy?
subcategory: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar)
alternate_phrasings: Can I buy solar panels from any market vendor and claim government subsidy?
PM Surya Ghar me registered vendor se panel lagwana zaroori kyu hai?
Where to find the list of approved solar vendors on the national portal?
short_answer: Installation through registered vendors is mandatory to ensure technical grid safety, ALMM-compliant domestic solar panels, valid warranties, and authorized digital sign-off on the national portal for subsidy disbursement.
detailed_answer: Under statutory MNRE guidelines, Central Financial Assistance is released exclusively if the rooftop solar plant is executed by an empanelled vendor registered on the national portal with the respective DISCOM. The rationale comprises four statutory controls: (1) Quality & ALMM Compliance: Solar modules must be manufactured domestically and listed on the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) with Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification; (2) Grid Synchronization Safety: Registered vendors ensure inverters meet anti-islanding and grid protection protocols to prevent electrocuting line workers during grid power outages; (3) Comprehensive 5-Year Maintenance: Registered vendors are contractually bound to provide a 5-year comprehensive maintenance warranty; (4) Digital Verification: Only registered vendors have portal credentials to upload serial numbers and trigger commissioning inspections.

hi.short_answer: सब्सिडी के लिए रजिस्टर्ड वेंडर अनिवार्य है ताकि ग्रिड सुरक्षा, 'मेड इन इंडिया' (ALMM) पैनल की गुणवत्ता, 5 साल की वारंटी और पोर्टल पर कमीशनिंग की आधिकारिक पुष्टि हो सके।
hi.detailed_answer: सरकार की शर्त है कि सोलर सिस्टम केवल डिस्कॉम-पंजीकृत वेंडर से ही लगवाया जाए। ऐसा इसलिए है क्योंकि: (1) पैनल ALMM सूची के अनुसार भारत में बने होने चाहिए; (2) ग्रिड सुरक्षा के नियम पूरे होने चाहिए ताकि लाइनमैन को करंट न लगे; (3) वेंडर 5 साल तक मुफ्त मेंटेनेंस देने के लिए कानूनी रूप से बाध्य होता है; (4) केवल पंजीकृत वेंडर ही पोर्टल पर काम पूरा होने का सर्टिफिकेट अपलोड कर सकता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Registered vendor se lagwana mandatory hai taaki ALMM approved Indian solar panels, grid safety, 5-year warranty aur portal par digital verification ensure ho sake.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Market ke unauthorized vendor se khareedne par government subsidy release nahi karti. Registered vendor hone par hi BIS approved panels lagte hain aur DISCOM net-meter inspection approve karti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Rooftop solar must use ALMM compliant modules installed by registered vendors with 5-year maintenance warranty.
supporting_claims.citation_source: MNRE Order on Implementation of ALMM and Empanelled Vendors

source_title: Vendor Empanelment and ALMM Compliance Guidelines for PM Surya Ghar
source_publisher: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
reviewer_notes: Unregistered vendor installations cannot be processed for central subsidy.

canonical_question: How can a registered farmer resolve the 'Land Seeding: No' status to resume PM-KISAN installment payments?
alternate_phrasings: Why is PM-KISAN installment stopped due to land seeding issue and how to fix it?
PM KISAN me Land Seeding No ko Yes kaise kare?
What documents must be submitted to the local Patwari for PM-KISAN land record verification?
short_answer: To resolve 'Land Seeding: No', the farmer must submit physical land records (Khatauni/Jamabandi, Aadhaar, and PM-KISAN ID) to the local Patwari, Lekhpal, or Block Agriculture Officer for portal record verification.
detailed_answer: When a beneficiary's PM-KISAN status displays 'Land Seeding: No', installments are halted because state revenue records have not verified lawful land ownership against the applicant's Aadhaar. To correct this: (1) Obtain an updated copy of land ownership records (Khatauni, Jamabandi, or RoR) containing the farmer's name; (2) Take the land document, Aadhaar card copy, bank passbook, and PM-KISAN registration number to the local area Lekhpal/Patwari or the Block Agriculture Office; (3) The revenue officer conducts physical verification and approves the land parcel on the state revenue portal; (4) Once approved, the state portal feeds the verified flag to the central PM-KISAN database, updating the status to 'Land Seeding: Yes' and releasing withheld installments in the subsequent cycle.

hi.short_answer: 'Land Seeding: No' ठीक करने के लिए किसान को अपनी खतौनी/जमाबंदी, आधार कार्ड और रजिस्ट्रेशन नंबर अपने स्थानीय पटवारी/लेखपाल या कृषि अधिकारी को जमा कर सत्यापन कराना होता है।
hi.detailed_answer: यदि स्टेटस में 'Land Seeding: No' आ रहा है, तो इसका मतलब है कि भू-अभिलेखों में जमीन का सत्यापन नहीं हुआ है। इसे ठीक कराने के लिए किसान को अपनी अद्यतन खतौनी (भूलेख नकल), आधार और बैंक पासबुक लेकर अपने हल्के के लेखपाल/पटवारी या ब्लॉक कृषि कार्यालय जाना होगा। लेखपाल द्वारा पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन सत्यापन करते ही लैंड सीडिंग 'Yes' हो जाएगी और रुकी हुई किस्तें जारी हो जाएंगी।

hinglish.short_answer: Land Seeding No ko Yes karne ke liye Khatauni/Jamabandi, Aadhaar card aur PM Kisan registration copy local Patwari ya Block Agriculture Office me physical verify karwani hoti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: State revenue portal par land details match hone ke baad revenue officer portal par update karta hai. Verification complete hote hi status 'Yes' ho jata hai aur pending installments release ho jati hain.

supporting_claims.claim: Land seeding resolution requires physical revenue verification by Patwari/Agriculture department.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Agriculture PM-KISAN Land Seeding Standard Operating Procedure

source_title: PM-KISAN Standard Operating Procedure on Land Record Verification
source_publisher: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
reviewer_notes: Withheld backlog installments are automatically credited once verified.

canonical_question: Why must a farmer's bank account be NPCI Aadhaar-seeded to receive PM-KISAN Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) credits?
alternate_phrasings: How to check if bank account is linked to NPCI Aadhaar mapper for PM-KISAN?
PM KISAN ka paisa aane ke liye bank me Aadhaar DBT kaise chalu kare?
Can opening an India Post Payments Bank account resolve PM-KISAN Aadhaar seeding failure?
short_answer: Government payments are routed via the Aadhaar Payment Bridge System (APBS); if an account is merely linked to Aadhaar but not seeded in the NPCI mapper for DBT, installments bounce and fail to credit.
detailed_answer: Under central DBT mandate, PM-KISAN installments are disbursed using the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) Aadhaar Payment Bridge System (APBS) rather than account number/IFSC routing. There is a vital distinction between Aadhaar-linking (submitting Aadhaar for KYC) and Aadhaar-seeding (registering the bank account on the NPCI mapper as the designated recipient account for government DBT benefits). If an account is not seeded, the DBT transaction is rejected with error 'Aadhaar not mapped to NPCI'. Farmers can verify their seeding status on the UIDAI portal, or open a DBT-enabled zero-balance savings account at India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) to establish NPCI seeding instantly.

hi.short_answer: सरकारी किस्तें NPCI आधार पेमेंट ब्रिज (APBS) से भेजी जाती हैं। यदि बैंक खाता केवल लिंक है लेकिन NPCI मैपर पर सीड (DBT सक्षम) नहीं है, तो किस्तें खाते में नहीं आती हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: पीएम-किसान का पैसा सीधे बैंक खाते में भेजने के लिए बैंक का NPCI मैपर में आधार से सीड होना अनिवार्य है। बैंक में केवल आधार देना (KYC) काफी नहीं है, बल्कि उस खाते में सरकारी सब्सिडी (DBT) चालू होना जरूरी है। किसान इसे UIDAI वेबसाइट पर 'Bank Seeding Status' में जाकर चेक कर सकते हैं या पोस्ट ऑफिस (IPPB) में खाता खुलवाकर इसे तुरंत चालू करा सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: PM Kisan installments NPCI Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APBS) ke through aati hain. Agar bank account NPCI mapper par DBT ke liye seeded nahi hai to payment bounce ho jati hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Aadhaar linking (KYC) aur Aadhaar seeding (DBT mandate) alag cheezein hain. Farmers bank me jakar 'Aadhaar DBT Mandate Form' submit kar sakte hain ya India Post Payments Bank me account kholkar 48 hours me seeding activate kar sakte hain.

supporting_claims.claim: DBT benefits require active Aadhaar seeding on the NPCI mapper via Aadhaar Payment Bridge System.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Cabinet Secretariat DBT Mission & NPCI APBS Guidelines

source_title: DBT Mission and NPCI Guidelines on Aadhaar Seeding for PM-KISAN
source_publisher: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Mission, Cabinet Secretariat
reviewer_notes: Common cause of payment failures; resolved via IPPB account opening.

canonical_question: How can farmers complete biometric eKYC using the PM-KISAN mobile app's facial authentication feature?
alternate_phrasings: Can PM-KISAN eKYC be completed through face scanning on phone without OTP?
PM KISAN app me Face Authentication se eKYC kaise kare?
What to do if OTP is not received for PM-KISAN Aadhaar eKYC?
short_answer: Farmers can download the official PM-KISAN Mobile App and AadhaarFaceRD App from Google Play Store, log in via registration number, scan their face using the phone camera, and complete eKYC without OTP or fingerprints.
detailed_answer: To eliminate dependency on OTP (when mobile is not linked to Aadhaar) and fingerprint biometric machines at CSCs, the Ministry of Agriculture launched the Face Authentication feature in the official PM-KISAN app: (1) Download 'PM-KISAN Mobile App' and UIDAI's 'AadhaarFaceRD' app from Google Play Store; (2) Log in to the PM-KISAN app using Farmer Registration Number and MPIN/OTP; (3) Navigate to the 'eKYC' section; (4) The app activates the front camera via AadhaarFaceRD to scan the beneficiary's face against UIDAI biometric archives; (5) Upon successful facial match, eKYC status is confirmed instantly on the spot; (6) Farmers can also complete eKYC for up to 100 neighboring farmers using this mobile app.

hi.short_answer: किसान 'PM-KISAN मोबाइल ऐप' और 'AadhaarFaceRD ऐप' डाउनलोड करके, कैमरे से चेहरा स्कैन करके बिना किसी ओटीपी या फिंगरप्रिंट मशीन के घर बैठे eKYC पूरी कर सकते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: फेस ऑथेंटिकेशन से eKYC करने की प्रक्रिया: गूगल प्ले स्टोर से 'PM-KISAN' और UIDAI का 'AadhaarFaceRD' ऐप इंस्टॉल करें। रजिस्ट्रेशन नंबर से लॉग इन करके 'eKYC' विकल्प चुनें। ऐप मोबाइल कैमरे से चेहरे को स्कैन करेगा और आधार डेटा से मिलान होते ही तुरंत eKYC सफलतापूर्वक पूरी हो जाएगी। इसके माध्यम से किसान अपने साथी किसानों की भी eKYC कर सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Farmers PM-KISAN mobile app aur AadhaarFaceRD app download karke bina OTP ya fingerprint ke mobile camera se face scan karke instant eKYC kar sakte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Google Play Store se PM-KISAN aur AadhaarFaceRD apps install karein. Registration number se login karke camera ke samne face scan karein, UIDAI biometric match hote hi eKYC status 'Yes' ho jata hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Face Authentication eKYC enabled on PM-KISAN mobile app integrated with UIDAI FaceRD service.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Agriculture Press Release on PM-KISAN Mobile App Face Authentication

source_title: PM-KISAN Face Authentication Mobile App User Manual
source_publisher: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
reviewer_notes: Solves OTP failure issue for rural elderly beneficiaries.

canonical_question: Which categories of landowners, institutional holders, and retired pensioners are strictly excluded from PM-KISAN eligibility?
alternate_phrasings: Are income tax paying farmers or government servants eligible for PM-KISAN?
PM KISAN me kaun kaun se log apatra (ineligible) hain?
Can pensioners receiving more than ₹10,000 per month receive PM-KISAN benefits?
short_answer: Excluded categories include institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, current/former MPs/MLAs, serving/retired government employees, pensioners receiving ₹10,000+/month, income taxpayers, and registered professionals.
detailed_answer: Paragraph 2 of PM-KISAN scheme operational guidelines defines the exclusion criteria: (1) All Institutional Landholders; (2) Former and present holders of constitutional posts; (3) Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors, and District Panchayat Chairpersons; (4) All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries, Departments, PSEs, and Autonomous Bodies (excluding Class IV/Multi-Tasking/Group D staff); (5) All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is ₹10,000 or more (excluding Group D staff); (6) All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year; (7) Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and undertaking active practice.

hi.short_answer: अपात्र श्रेणियों में संस्थागत जमीन मालिक, सांसद/विधायक, सेवारत/सेवानिवृत्त सरकारी कर्मचारी, ₹10,000 से अधिक मासिक पेंशन पाने वाले, आयकर दाता और डॉक्टर, वकील, सीए शामिल हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: PM-KISAN से बाहर रखे गए लोग: (1) संस्थागत भूधारक; (2) वर्तमान या पूर्व सांसद, विधायक और मंत्री; (3) केंद्र और राज्य सरकार के कर्मचारी (ग्रुप डी/सफाईकर्मी को छोड़कर); (4) ₹10,000 या अधिक मासिक पेंशन पाने वाले सेवानिवृत्त कर्मी; (5) पिछले वर्ष आयकर भरने वाले किसान; (6) डॉक्टर, वकील, सीए और इंजीनियर जैसे पेशेवर।

hinglish.short_answer: PM Kisan me institutional landholders, MPs/MLAs, government employees, ₹10,000+ monthly pensioners, income tax pay karne wale aur doctors/engineers/CAs excluded hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Agar kisi family member ne last assessment year me Income Tax pay kiya hai ya monthly pension ₹10,000 se zyada hai to PM-KISAN ke ₹6,000 annual installment ke liye ineligible hote hain.

supporting_claims.claim: Exclusion criteria bar constitutional post holders, government staff, ₹10k+ pensioners, and income taxpayers from PM-KISAN.
supporting_claims.citation_source: PM-KISAN Scheme Guidelines, Section 2 Beneficiary Exclusions

source_title: PM-KISAN Beneficiary Ineligibility and Exclusion Framework
source_publisher: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
reviewer_notes: Class IV / Group D / MTS employees are explicitly exempt from exclusion.

canonical_question: What are the household income criteria and interest subsidy terms under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)?
subcategory: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY Urban & Gramin)
alternate_phrasings: What is the annual income limit for EWS and LIG under PMAY Urban 2.0?
PMAY Urban 2.0 me home loan subsidy ke naye niyam kya hain?
How is the 4% interest subsidy credited for home loans up to ₹25 lakh?
short_answer: PMAY-U 2.0 categorizes households into EWS (up to ₹3L), LIG (₹3-6L), and MIG (₹6-9L), offering an interest subsidy of 4% per annum on home loans up to ₹8 lakh for up to 5 years (maximum ₹1.80 lakh benefit).
detailed_answer: Under PMAY-Urban 2.0 guidelines approved for FY 2024-25 through 2028-29: (1) Income Slabs: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) up to ₹3,00,000 annually; Low Income Group (LIG) ₹3,00,001 to ₹6,00,000 annually; Middle Income Group (MIG) ₹6,00,001 to ₹9,00,000 annually; (2) House Cost and Loan Ceilings: House valuation cannot exceed ₹35 lakh and maximum home loan amount cannot exceed ₹25 lakh; (3) Interest Subsidy Terms: An interest subvention of 4.0% per annum is applied to the first ₹8.00 lakh of the loan for a maximum 5-year tenure; (4) Release Mechanism: Up to ₹1.80 lakh net present value benefit is disbursed in 5 equal yearly installments credited directly into the borrower's home loan account.

hi.short_answer: PMAY-U 2.0 में आय सीमा EWS (₹3 लाख तक), LIG (₹3-6 लाख) और MIG (₹6-9 लाख) है। इसमें ₹8 लाख तक के लोन पर 5 साल के लिए 4% ब्याज सब्सिडी (अधिकतम ₹1.80 लाख) मिलती है।
hi.detailed_answer: PMAY अर्बन 2.0 की शर्तें: ₹35 लाख तक के मकान पर ₹25 लाख तक का लोन लिया जा सकता है। सरकार पहले ₹8 लाख के लोन पर 4% की दर से सालाना ब्याज सब्सिडी देती है, जिसका कुल लाभ ₹1.80 लाख तक होता है। यह लाभ 5 वर्षों में समान किस्तों में बैंक लोन खाते में जमा किया जाता है।

hinglish.short_answer: PMAY-U 2.0 me income brackets EWS (upto ₹3L), LIG (₹3-6L), MIG (₹6-9L) hain. ₹8 lakh loan par 4% interest subsidy milti hai 5 years ke liye (max ₹1.8 lakh benefit).
hinglish.detailed_answer: House cost max ₹35 lakh aur home loan max ₹25 lakh hona chahiye. ₹8 lakh tak ke loan amount par 4% subsidy milti hai jo 5 annual installments me home loan account me credit hoti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: PMAY-U 2.0 covers EWS, LIG, MIG with 4% interest subvention up to ₹8 lakh loan for 5 years.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs PMAY-U 2.0 Operational Guidelines

source_title: Operational Guidelines for Interest Subsidy Scheme under PMAY-U 2.0
source_publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
reviewer_notes: Beneficiary must maintain active repayment track record to receive subsequent annual installments.

canonical_question: Why is female head ownership or co-ownership mandatory for house sanction under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)?
subcategory: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY Urban & Gramin)
alternate_phrasings: Is it compulsory to include a woman's name in property title for PMAY subsidy?
PMAY me mahila ke naam par makan hona kyu zaroori hai?
Under what exceptional cases is male sole ownership permitted under PMAY?
short_answer: Female ownership or co-ownership is mandatory under PMAY to empower women, secure asset titles in women's names, and prevent male-only distress sales of subsidized family housing.
detailed_answer: Under the core guidelines of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (both Gramin and Urban verticals), houses constructed or acquired with central financial assistance must be registered in the name of the female head of the household or in joint ownership with the male spouse. The only statutory exception is when there is no adult female member in the family (e.g., unmarried males, widowers, or single fathers). This policy ensures legal land and property title security for women, enhances women's socioeconomic standing, and protects families against arbitrary liquidation of the housing asset.

hi.short_answer: PMAY में मकान का पंजीकरण महिला मुखिया के नाम या संयुक्त नाम पर होना अनिवार्य है ताकि महिलाओं का सशक्तिकरण हो और संपत्ति पर उनका कानूनी मालिकाना हक सुरक्षित रहे।
hi.detailed_answer: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना की अनिवार्य शर्त है कि स्वीकृत मकान परिवार की वयस्क महिला मुखिया के नाम पर या पति-पत्नी के संयुक्त नाम पर ही पंजीकृत होना चाहिए। केवल उन्हीं मामलों में जहां परिवार में कोई वयस्क महिला सदस्य नहीं है, मकान अकेले पुरुष के नाम पर स्वीकृत किया जा सकता है। इसका उद्देश्य महिलाओं को संपत्ति का मालिकाना हक देना है।

hinglish.short_answer: PMAY me house title female head ke naam par ya joint ownership me hona mandatory hai taaki women empowerment aur property security ensure ho sake.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Subsidy approve hone ke liye registry me mahila ka naam hona compulsory condition hai. Sirf unhi households me male sole ownership allow hoti hai jahan family me koi adult female member exist nahi karti.

supporting_claims.claim: Houses under PMAY must be in the name of female head or joint ownership with spouse.
supporting_claims.citation_source: MoHUA PMAY Operational Guidelines, Mandatory Conditions

source_title: PMAY Guidelines on Mandatory Female Title Ownership
source_publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
reviewer_notes: Enforced strictly by registry departments and primary lending institutions.

canonical_question: What percentage premium is paid by farmers for Kharif, Rabi, and commercial crops under PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)?
alternate_phrasings: Is PMFBY premium 2% for Kharif crops and 1.5% for Rabi crops?
PM Fasal Bima Yojana me kisan ko kitna premium dena padta hai?
Who pays the remaining premium subsidy above the farmer's share in PMFBY?
short_answer: Under PMFBY, farmers pay a uniform maximum premium of 2.0% for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5.0% for annual commercial/horticultural crops, with all remaining actuarial premium funded by government subsidy.
detailed_answer: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) shields farmers from weather and calamity risks at highly subsidized premium rates: (1) Kharif Crops (paddy, maize, pulses, oilseeds): Farmers pay a maximum premium of 2.0% of the sum insured; (2) Rabi Crops (wheat, barley, mustard, gram): Farmers pay a maximum premium of 1.5% of the sum insured; (3) Commercial and Horticultural Crops (cotton, sugarcane, fruits, vegetables): Farmers pay a maximum premium of 5.0% of the sum insured. The entire balance of the actuarial premium (which frequently exceeds 15-25%) is paid as premium subsidy shared equally (50:50) between the Central Government and State Governments (90:10 in North Eastern States).

hi.short_answer: PMFBY में किसानों को खरीफ फसलों पर 2.0%, रबी फसलों पर 1.5% और वाणिज्यिक/बागवानी फसलों पर अधिकतम 5.0% का मामूली प्रीमियम देना होता है। शेष प्रीमियम सरकार देती है।
hi.detailed_answer: पीएम फसल बीमा योजना में किसान का प्रीमियम अंशदान बहुत कम तय किया गया है: खरीफ फसलों (धान, मक्का आदि) पर 2.0%; रबी फसलों (गेहूं, सरसों आदि) पर 1.5%; और बागवानी/वाणिज्यिक फसलों (कपास, गन्ना, सब्जियां) पर 5.0%। बाकी का पूरा भारी प्रीमियम केंद्र और राज्य सरकार मिलकर बीमा कंपनी को सब्सिडी के रूप में देती हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: PMFBY me farmers Kharif crops ke liye 2.0%, Rabi crops ke liye 1.5% aur commercial/horticultural crops ke liye 5.0% premium pay karte hain. Baaki pura premium government deti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Sum insured par farmer ka share fixed hai: 2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% commercial. Balance actuarial premium central aur state governments 50:50 share karti hain subsidy ke taur par.

supporting_claims.claim: Farmer premium share is 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops under PMFBY.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Agriculture PMFBY Revised Operational Guidelines, Section 8

source_title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana Operational Guidelines
source_publisher: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
reviewer_notes: Crop insurance enrollment is voluntary for both loanee and non-loanee farmers.

canonical_question: Within how many hours must localized crop loss or post-harvest damage be reported to claim PMFBY insurance compensation?
alternate_phrasings: Must crop damage be intimated within 72 hours under PM Fasal Bima Yojana?
Fasal kharab hone par PMFBY claim ke liye kitne ghante me report karni hoti hai?
How to file crop damage intimation through the Crop Insurance App or toll-free number?
short_answer: Localized crop losses (hailstorm, landslide, inundation) or post-harvest damages must be reported within 72 hours of the calamity through the Crop Insurance App, toll-free helpline, or local agriculture office.
detailed_answer: Under PMFBY Operational Guidelines, for localized risks (such as hailstorm, landslide, cloudburst, natural fire, and inundation) and post-harvest losses (cut and spread crops drying in the field damaged within 14 days of harvest by unseasonal cyclonic rains), the affected farmer must report the crop loss within 72 hours of the event occurrence. Intimation can be lodged via: (1) Crop Insurance App (uploading geotagged photo of damaged field); (2) National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in); (3) Kisan Call Centre toll-free number (14447); or (4) Written notification to the local bank branch or revenue/agriculture officer. Failure to report within 72 hours can lead to rejection of individual assessment claims.

hi.short_answer: ओलावृष्टि, जलभराव या कटाई के बाद फसल नुकसान की स्थिति में घटना के 72 घंटे के भीतर 'क्रॉप इंश्योरेंस ऐप' या टोल-फ्री नंबर पर सूचना देना अनिवार्य है।
hi.detailed_answer: पीएम फसल बीमा योजना के तहत स्थानीय आपदाओं (ओलावृष्टि, बादल फटना, भूस्खलन, बाढ़) या खेत में सूखने के लिए कटी पड़ी फसल के नुकसान पर किसान को 72 घंटे के भीतर सूचना देनी होती है। यह सूचना 'Crop Insurance App' पर फोटो अपलोड करके, टोल-फ्री हेल्पलाइन (14447) पर कॉल करके या बैंक/कृषि अधिकारी को लिखित में दी जा सकती है। 72 घंटे बाद दावा खारिज हो सकता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Crop loss ya post-harvest damage hone par 72 hours ke andar Crop Insurance App ya helpline 14447 par intimation dena mandatory hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Hailstorm, flooding ya cut crop damage hone par 72 ghante ke andar report karna compulsory rule hai. Geotagged photo ke sath app par claim lodge karne par surveyor aakar physical loss assessment karta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Crop loss must be reported within 72 hours for localized calamities and post-harvest losses under PMFBY.
supporting_claims.citation_source: PMFBY Revised Operational Guidelines, Section 15 Post-Harvest and Localized Risk Claims

source_title: PMFBY Claim Settlement Procedure for Localized Calamities and Post-Harvest Loss
source_publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
reviewer_notes: 72-hour cut-off is strictly enforced across all general insurance companies.

canonical_question: What is the total capital expenditure target and funding model of the National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP)?
alternate_phrasings: How is NIP funding shared between Centre (39%), States (39%), and Private sector (22%)?
National Infrastructure Pipeline ka total budget aur target kya hai?
Which sectors account for the largest share of NIP infrastructure investments?
short_answer: The National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) envisages an aggregate capital expenditure exceeding ₹111 lakh crore ($1.4 trillion), funded through a joint partnership of the Central Government (39%), State Governments (39%), and the Private Sector (22%).
detailed_answer: Launched following the Task Force Report led by the Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance, the NIP covers FY 2020 to FY 2025 (extended onwards) across energy, roads, railways, urban development, and digital communications. The funding framework is structured on a shared tripartite model: the Centre contributes 39%, States contribute 39%, and private investments account for 22%. Financing mechanisms include budgetary allocations, National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID), external multilateral development bank (MDB) loans, and asset monetization under the National Monetisation Pipeline (NMP).

hi.short_answer: राष्ट्रीय अवसंरचना पाइपलाइन (NIP) का कुल पूंजीगत व्यय लक्ष्य ₹111 लाख करोड़ से अधिक है, जिसका वित्तपोषण केंद्र सरकार (39%), राज्य सरकारों (39%) और निजी क्षेत्र (22%) द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से किया जाता है।
hi.detailed_answer: वित्त मंत्रालय के आर्थिक मामलों के विभाग (DEA) द्वारा संचालित NIP ऊर्जा, सड़क, रेलवे और शहरी विकास क्षेत्रों में विश्व स्तरीय बुनियादी ढांचे के लिए तैयार किया गया है। इसमें 39% केंद्र, 39% राज्य और 22% निजी क्षेत्र की भागीदारी का वित्तीय ढांचा निर्धारित है।

hinglish.short_answer: National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) ka total capex target ₹111 lakh crore+ hai, jisme Centre (39%), States (39%) aur Private sector (22%) ki funding share hoti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Ministry of Finance ke DEA task force ke mutabiq NIP ka total capex ₹111 lakh crore target kiya gaya hai. Isme major sectors Energy, Roads aur Railways hain jisme NaBFID aur National Monetisation Pipeline se funding support milta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: NIP envisages capital expenditure of ₹111 lakh crore with Centre (39%), State (39%), and Private Sector (22%) funding.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Report of the Task Force on National Infrastructure Pipeline, Ministry of Finance (DEA)

source_title: Report of the Task Force on National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) 2020-2025
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Statutory 39-39-22 ratio is the foundational benchmark for NIP capex distribution.

canonical_question: How does the National Infrastructure Pipeline classify greenfield vs brownfield infrastructure projects?
alternate_phrasings: What is the difference between greenfield and brownfield projects on NIP?
NIP portal par greenfield aur brownfield projects kaise identify kare?
Which project stage represents highest private investment opportunity on NIP?
short_answer: The National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) classifies new projects built from scratch on undeveloped land as Greenfield, and expansion, modernization, or capacity-augmentation of existing assets as Brownfield.
detailed_answer: Under NIP guidelines, Greenfield infrastructure projects involve creating brand-new physical assets from conception (e.g., dedicated freight corridors, new greenfield expressways, or new solar parks). These carry higher land acquisition and regulatory clearance risks but offer complete architectural autonomy. Conversely, Brownfield projects involve upgrading, widening, electrifying, or digitizing existing operational facilities (e.g., 6-laning existing 4-lane highways, port terminal mechanization, or airport terminal expansions). Brownfield projects typically have established revenue histories and lower initial gestation periods.

hi.short_answer: राष्ट्रीय अवसंरचना पाइपलाइन में अविकसित भूमि पर नए सिरे से बनाई जाने वाली परियोजनाओं को ग्रीनफील्ड और मौजूदा संपत्तियों के विस्तार या आधुनिकीकरण को ब्राउनफील्ड के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है।
hi.detailed_answer: ग्रीनफील्ड परियोजनाओं में नई भूमि अधिग्रहण और पर्यावरण मंजूरी की आवश्यकता होती है, जैसे नए एक्सप्रेसवे या हवाई अड्डे। ब्राउनफील्ड में मौजूदा परिसंपत्तियों का उन्नयन या क्षमता विस्तार (जैसे 4-लेन राजमार्ग को 6-लेन बनाना) शामिल होता है।

hinglish.short_answer: NIP me nayi zameen par scratch se banne wali projects ko Greenfield kehte hain, aur existing infrastructure ke expansion/upgradation ko Brownfield kehte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Greenfield projects me zero previous construction hoti hai aur fresh land acquisition chahiye hoti hai. Brownfield projects me already operational asset ko modernize ya expand kiya jata hai, jaise railway line doubling ya highway widening.

supporting_claims.claim: Greenfield involves creation of entirely new assets; Brownfield involves expansion or modernization of existing facilities.
supporting_claims.citation_source: NIP Task Force Report, Vol. 1, Chapter 2 (Classification Framework)

source_title: National Infrastructure Pipeline Project Guidelines & Taxonomy
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Crucial for financial structuring and risk underwriting by domestic and institutional lenders.

canonical_question: How can domestic and foreign investors register expressions of interest on the India Investment Grid (IIG) portal?
alternate_phrasings: How to search and track infrastructure projects on India Investment Grid?
India Investment Grid (IIG) portal par investor registration kaise kare?
What services does Invest India offer to prospective project investors?
short_answer: Investors can register free of charge on indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in by completing an investor profile, specifying investment focus sectors and ticket sizes, and submitting a direct Expression of Interest (EOI) to project promoters.
detailed_answer: To submit an Expression of Interest (EOI) on IIG, institutional and private investors must: 1) Navigate to indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in and click 'Register as Investor'; 2) Complete identity verification (incorporation details, country of origin, CIN/GSTIN for Indian entities, or statutory registry details for foreign entities); 3) Specify asset class preferences, geographies, and ticket size ranges; 4) Browse project dossiers and click 'Express Interest'; 5) Submit structured queries directly routed to the designated nodal officer or PSU project promoter, with support from Invest India's dedicated sector desk.

hi.short_answer: घरेलू और विदेशी निवेशक indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in पर निःशुल्क पंजीकरण करके, अपनी निवेश प्राथमिकताओं को दर्ज करके सीधे परियोजना प्रमोटरों को रुचि की अभिव्यक्ति (EOI) प्रस्तुत कर सकते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: IIG पोर्टल पर निवेशक के रूप में खाता बनाकर, कंपनी विवरण और निवेश क्षमता दर्ज की जाती है। इसके बाद विभिन्न क्षेत्रों की परियोजनाओं की विस्तृत जानकारी देखकर सीधे नोडल अधिकारियों और इन्वेस्ट इंडिया के माध्यम से EOI सबमिट किया जा सकता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Investors indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in par free account banakar, apna ticket size aur sector preferences set karke project promoters ko directly EOI send kar sakte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: IIG portal par 'Register as Investor' par click karein, entity verify karein, aur shortlisted project dossier par jakar 'Express Interest' button se nodal officer ko query aur intent submit karein.

supporting_claims.claim: IIG provides direct online Expression of Interest workflow connecting investors with project nodal authorities.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Invest India & DPIIT User Guide for Investors

source_title: India Investment Grid Investor Engagement Manual
source_publisher: Invest India & DPIIT
reviewer_notes: Foreign investors also receive facilitation through the National Single Window System (NSWS) and Project Development Cells (PDCs).

canonical_question: What constitutes a mega project versus major project in MoSPI PAIMANA monthly infrastructure monitoring flash reports?
alternate_phrasings: Are projects costing ₹1,000 crore and above classified as mega projects by MoSPI?
MoSPI flash report me ₹150 crore se upar ke projects kaise monitor hote hain?
What is the difference between OCMS and the PAIMANA monitoring portal?
short_answer: Under MoSPI monitoring norms, a 'Mega Project' is a central sector infrastructure project with an original or revised cost of ₹1,000 crore and above, while a 'Major Project' has a cost between ₹150 crore and ₹999.99 crore.
detailed_answer: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) categorizes ongoing central infrastructure projects into two monitoring tiers: 1) Mega Projects: Projects costing ₹1,000 crore and above, which undergo intensive inter-ministerial review and monthly milestone-level scrutiny due to their systemic economic impact; and 2) Major Projects: Projects costing from ₹150 crore up to ₹1,000 crore. Projects costing less than ₹150 crore are monitored directly by the respective administrative line ministries and are excluded from MoSPI's Monthly Flash Reports.

hi.short_answer: MoSPI की मासिक फ्लैश रिपोर्ट में ₹1,000 करोड़ और उससे अधिक लागत वाली परियोजनाओं को 'मेगा प्रोजेक्ट' और ₹150 करोड़ से ₹1,000 करोड़ के बीच की परियोजनाओं को 'मेजर प्रोजेक्ट' कहा जाता है।
hi.detailed_answer: MoSPI केंद्रीय बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं को दो श्रेणियों में बांटता है: मेगा परियोजनाएं (₹1,000 करोड़ या अधिक) और प्रमुख परियोजनाएं (₹150 करोड़ से ₹1,000 करोड़)। ₹150 करोड़ से कम लागत की परियोजनाओं की निगरानी संबंधित मंत्रालय स्वयं करते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: MoSPI norms ke mutabiq ₹1,000 crore+ cost wali projects ko 'Mega Project' aur ₹150 crore se ₹1,000 crore wali projects ko 'Major Project' classify kiya jata hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: MoSPI ki Monthly Flash Report me Mega projects (₹1000 crore+) aur Major projects (₹150 crore se ₹999.99 crore) ka cost aur time overrun monitor hota hai. ₹150 crore se neeche ki projects MoSPI report me nahi aati.

supporting_claims.claim: MoSPI classifies projects costing ₹1,000 crore and above as Mega Projects and ₹150 to ₹1,000 crore as Major Projects.
supporting_claims.citation_source: MoSPI Monthly Flash Report on Central Sector Projects, Classification Section

source_title: MoSPI IPMD Classification Criteria for Central Sector Projects
source_publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
reviewer_notes: Statutory thresholds verified against official MoSPI monthly flash publication standards.

canonical_question: How does the PAIMANA portal calculate physical vs financial completion and track infrastructure project delays?
alternate_phrasings: How are cost overruns and time overruns measured in central sector infrastructure projects?
PAIMANA portal par project delay aur cost escalation kaise check kare?
What percentage of projects have completed over 80% physical progress according to MoSPI?
short_answer: The PAIMANA portal calculates physical progress as the weighted percentage of contracted engineering milestones completed, while financial progress is the ratio of cumulative capital expended against sanctioned cost.
detailed_answer: MoSPI's PAIMANA system distinguishes between physical achievement and fund utilization. Physical progress is measured across project-specific work breakdown structures (WBS) such as earthwork, structural fabrication, track laying, or equipment commissioning, weighted by technical importance. Financial progress equals (Cumulative Expenditure / Sanctioned Cost) * 100. Project delay is computed by comparing the original commissioning date against the anticipated date reported by the project enterprise, generating metrics on months of slippage and resulting cost overruns.

hi.short_answer: पैमाना पोर्टल भौतिक प्रगति की गणना पूर्ण किए गए इंजीनियरिंग मील के पत्थरों के प्रतिशत के रूप में करता है, जबकि वित्तीय प्रगति स्वीकृत बजट के मुकाबले खर्च की गई राशि का अनुपात है।
hi.detailed_answer: PAIMANA प्रणाली भौतिक प्रगति को तकनीकी कार्यों (जैसे अर्थवर्क, कंक्रीटिंग, ट्रैक बिछाना) के पूरा होने के आधार पर मापती है, जबकि वित्तीय प्रगति कुल संचित व्यय और स्वीकृत लागत का अनुपात होती है। समय-सीमा में देरी की गणना मूल और संशोधित पूर्णता तिथियों की तुलना करके की जाती है।

hinglish.short_answer: PAIMANA me physical progress completed engineering milestones ke weighted percentage se hoti hai, aur financial progress sanctioned cost ke against cumulative expenditure se hoti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Physical progress engineering milestones (jaise civil work, equipment erection) par depend karti hai, jabki financial progress total spend / sanctioned cost * 100 se calculate hoti hai. Delays original commissioning date versus current expected date se calculate hote hain.

supporting_claims.claim: Physical progress is based on milestone achievement while financial progress is cumulative expenditure against sanctioned cost.
supporting_claims.citation_source: MoSPI IPMD Methodology for Monitoring Central Infrastructure Projects

source_title: Methodology and Indicators of Infrastructure Project Monitoring
source_publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
reviewer_notes: A project can have 80% financial spend but only 50% physical completion, highlighting cost overrun risk.

canonical_question: What is PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan and how does it integrate spatial GIS data layers across infrastructure ministries?
alternate_phrasings: How does PM Gati Shakti coordinate multi-modal logistics and connectivity?
PM Gati Shakti portal ka use karke infrastructure projects ki planning kaise hoti hai?
Can private investors access Gati Shakti data for logistics corridor evaluation?
short_answer: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan is a multi-modal digital GIS platform developed by BISAG-N that integrates over 1,400 geospatial data layers across 27+ central ministries and state governments to coordinate infrastructure planning.
detailed_answer: Launched in October 2021 and driven by the Logistics Division of DPIIT, PM Gati Shakti breaks departmental silos by hosting all existing and planned infrastructure on a unified digital geospatial map developed by the Bhaskaracharya National Institute for Space Applications and Geo-informatics (BISAG-N). Layers include national highways, railway tracks, gas pipelines, transmission lines, optical fiber networks, forest boundaries, and industrial clusters. Ministries planning new connectivity projects utilize this spatial overlay to detect land conflicts, optimize multi-modal logistics, and obtain coordinated clearances.

hi.short_answer: पीएम गति शक्ति राष्ट्रीय मास्टर प्लान एक डिजिटल जीआईएस प्लेटफॉर्म है, जो बुनियादी ढांचा नियोजन के समन्वय के लिए 27 से अधिक केंद्रीय मंत्रालयों और राज्यों के 1,400 से अधिक भू-स्थानिक डेटा परतों को एकीकृत करता है।
hi.detailed_answer: अक्टूबर 2021 में शुरू किया गया पीएम गति शक्ति प्लेटफॉर्म BISAG-N द्वारा विकसित किया गया है। यह राजमार्गों, रेलवे, गैस पाइपलाइनों और वन सीमाओं जैसे डेटा को एक एकीकृत जीआईएस मानचित्र पर लाकर बहु-मॉडल कनेक्टिविटी की योजना बनाने और भूमि संघर्षों को रोकने में मदद करता है।

hinglish.short_answer: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan BISAG-N dwara developed ek multi-modal GIS platform hai jo 27+ ministries ke 1,400 se zyada geospatial data layers ko integrate karta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: PM Gati Shakti DPIIT ke Logistics Division ke under operate hota hai. Isme roads, railways, gas pipelines aur industrial parks ka spatial GIS data map par visible hota hai jisse ministries bina inter-departmental delay ke coordinated infrastructure build kar sakein.

supporting_claims.claim: PM Gati Shakti integrates over 1,400 spatial GIS layers across 27 central ministries developed by BISAG-N.
supporting_claims.citation_source: DPIIT Logistics Division & PM Gati Shakti Framework Document

source_title: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan Institutional Framework
source_publisher: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
reviewer_notes: Empowered Group of Secretaries (EGoS) oversees multi-modal synchronization under Gati Shakti.

canonical_question: How can industrial investors locate vacant plots and plug-and-play facilities using the Industrial Information System (IIS)?
alternate_phrasings: How to search government industrial land banks online in India?
Industrial Information System (IIS) par factory lagane ke liye plot kaise khoje?
Does IIS show GIS mapped industrial corridors with road and power connectivity?
short_answer: Industrial investors can use the GIS-enabled Industrial Information System (IIS) on the India Investment Grid portal to view over 4,000 industrial parks and find vacant industrial land and plug-and-play facilities in real time.
detailed_answer: The Industrial Information System (IIS / GIS Land Bank), managed by DPIIT in coordination with state industrial development corporations (such as RIICO, MIDC, GIDC, UPSIDA), provides a GIS-mapped inventory of industrial parks across India. Investors can search by state, district, plot size, connectivity (distance to highway, railway, seaport, airport), utilities (power, water, CETP), and vacant plot availability. The system enables users to view boundary coordinates and initiate plot allocation requests directly on respective state single window portals.

hi.short_answer: औद्योगिक निवेशक इंडिया इन्वेस्टमेंट ग्रिड पर जीआईएस-सक्षम औद्योगिक सूचना प्रणाली (IIS) का उपयोग करके देश भर के 4,000 से अधिक औद्योगिक पार्कों में खाली प्लॉट और तैयार सुविधाएं खोज सकते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: डीपीआईआईटी और राज्य औद्योगिक विकास निगमों द्वारा संचालित IIS लैंड बैंक निवेशकों को राज्य, जिला, प्लॉट आकार, बंदरगाह/राजमार्ग कनेक्टिविटी और बुनियादी सुविधाओं के आधार पर खाली औद्योगिक भूखंडों की वास्तविक स्थिति देखने की सुविधा देता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Investors IIG portal par Industrial Information System (IIS GIS Land Bank) use karke 4,000+ industrial parks me vacant plots aur plug-and-play sheds khoj sakte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: IIS system DPIIT aur State Industrial Development Corporations (MIDC, GIDC, etc.) ka GIS map hai. Yahan plot size, power, water availability aur highway connectivity ke filter laga kar real-time vacant land dekh sakte hain.

supporting_claims.claim: IIS provides GIS-mapped inventory of over 4,000 industrial parks with real-time vacant plot visibility.
supporting_claims.citation_source: DPIIT Industrial Information System (IIS) Release Note

source_title: Industrial Information System (IIS GIS Land Bank) User Guidelines
source_publisher: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
