canonical_question: What is the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) concession framework and how are concession periods determined for highway and port assets?
alternate_phrasings: What are Model Concession Agreements (MCA) used by NHAI and Major Port Authorities?
PPP infrastructure projects me concession period kaise tay hota hai?
What are the risk sharing guidelines between concessionaire and contracting authority?
short_answer: The PPP concession framework is a statutory long-term contract between a public authority and a private concessionaire, with concession periods typically set at 15 to 30 years based on capital outlay and asset payback periods.
detailed_answer: Under guidelines issued by the Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance, PPP models in India include Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT-Toll), BOT-Annuity, and Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM). The concession period is determined through detailed project reports (DPR) and financial modeling to enable the concessionaire to recover capital expenditure, service debt, and achieve a reasonable equity internal rate of return (IRR). Standard concession periods are 15 to 20 years for HAM highway projects, up to 30 years for BOT toll highways, and 30 years for major port terminals under the Major Port Authorities Act, 2021.

hi.short_answer: पीपीपी रियायत ढांचा सार्वजनिक प्राधिकरण और निजी रियायतग्राही के बीच एक दीर्घकालिक अनुबंध है, जिसमें राजमार्ग और बंदरगाह संपत्तियों के लिए रियायत अवधि आमतौर पर पूंजीगत लागत के आधार पर 15 से 30 वर्ष तय की जाती है।
hi.detailed_answer: आर्थिक मामलों के विभाग (DEA) के दिशा-निर्देशों के तहत, BOT (टोल), BOT (वार्षिकी), और हाइब्रिड वार्षिकी मॉडल (HAM) लागू होते हैं। रियायत अवधि वित्तीय व्यवहार्यता और ऋण चुकौती अवधि के आधार पर निर्धारित की जाती है—राजमार्गों के लिए सामान्यतः 15-30 वर्ष और प्रमुख बंदरगाह टर्मिनलों के लिए 30 वर्ष तक।

hinglish.short_answer: PPP concession framework government aur private developer ke beech long-term contractual agreement hai, jisme concession period capex recovery ke hisaab se 15 se 30 saal decide hota hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: DEA guidelines ke mutabiq BOT-Toll, BOT-Annuity aur HAM models follow hote hain. NHAI highway projects me concession period generally 15-20 saal (HAM) ya 30 saal (BOT) hota hai, aur major ports me Major Port Authorities Act 2021 ke tehat 30 saal tak diya jata hai.

supporting_claims.claim: PPP concessions typically range between 15 and 30 years based on project capex, debt repayment, and revenue models.
supporting_claims.citation_source: DEA Model Concession Agreements (MCA) for Highways and Ports

source_title: Model Concession Agreements & Guidelines for Public Private Partnerships in India
source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Statutory Model Concession Agreement (MCA) templates govern standard clauses and dispute resolution under SAROD.

canonical_question: What are the value limits for Direct Purchase (up to ₹50,000) and L1 Comparison (up to ₹10,00,000) on Government e-Marketplace (GeM)?
alternate_phrasings: Can buyers on GeM directly buy products without tender up to ₹50,000?
GeM portal par direct khareedari (direct purchase) ki limit kya hai?
When is comparison of 3 different OEMs mandatory on GeM?
short_answer: On GeM, government buyers can make a Direct Purchase without comparison up to ₹50,000, while purchases from ₹50,001 up to ₹10,00,000 require an online comparison across at least three distinct OEMs to select L1.
detailed_answer: Under Rule 149 of GFR 2017 and GeM Procurement Guidelines: 1) Direct Purchase (up to ₹50,000): The buyer can procure any listed good or service that meets required quality, specification, and delivery period from any available seller without conducting comparative price analysis; 2) L1 Comparison (₹50,001 to ₹10,00,000): The buyer must compare at least three distinct manufacturers/OEMs meeting specifications and purchase from the lowest evaluated bidder (L1); 3) Above ₹10,00,000: Mandatory online bidding or Reverse Auction (RA) must be conducted on GeM.

hi.short_answer: GeM पर सरकारी खरीदार ₹50,000 तक की सीधी खरीद (Direct Purchase) बिना तुलना के कर सकते हैं, जबकि ₹50,001 से ₹10,00,000 तक कम से कम तीन अलग-अलग निर्माताओं के उत्पादों की तुलना करके L1 चुनना अनिवार्य है।
hi.detailed_answer: GFR नियम 149 के अनुसार GeM पर तीन खरीद स्लैब हैं: ₹50,000 तक सीधे किसी भी विक्रेता से खरीद; ₹50,000 से ₹10 लाख तक कम से कम 3 OEMs की ऑनलाइन तुलना करके सबसे कम दर (L1) पर खरीद; और ₹10 लाख से ऊपर अनिवार्य ई-बिडिंग या रिवर्स ऑक्शन।

hinglish.short_answer: GeM par ₹50,000 tak Direct Purchase bina comparison ke allowed hai, aur ₹50,001 se ₹10 lakh tak minimum 3 OEMs compare karke L1 select karna mandatory hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: GFR Rule 149 ke tehat: ₹50,000 tak direct buy; ₹50k se ₹10 lakh tak 3 different OEMs ka comparison karke L1 lena padta hai; aur ₹10 lakh se zyada order value par mandatory bidding ya reverse auction karni hoti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: GeM allows direct purchase up to ₹50,000 and requires 3-OEM comparison between ₹50,000 and ₹10,00,000.
supporting_claims.citation_source: General Financial Rules 2017, Rule 149 & GeM Procurement Manual

source_title: General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, Rule 149: Government e-Marketplace
source_publisher: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance & GeM SPV
reviewer_notes: The comparison ceiling was revised from ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh to accelerate procurement velocity.

canonical_question: What is the Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate (CRAC) timeline on GeM and how does it guarantee seller payments within 10 days?
alternate_phrasings: What happens if buyer does not generate CRAC within 10 days on GeM?
GeM portal par CRAC kya hota hai aur payment kab release hoti hai?
Is auto-generation of CRAC enabled if buyer delays material inspection?
short_answer: On GeM, the buyer must issue a Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate (CRAC) within 10 calendar days of goods delivery, and upon CRAC generation, the system mandates final payment release within 10 calendar days.
detailed_answer: Under GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), upon physical delivery of goods, the consignee has up to 10 calendar days to inspect the consignment and generate CRAC. If the consignee neither accepts nor rejects the consignment within 10 days, the portal triggers Auto-CRAC (deemed acceptance). Once CRAC is generated, the buyer's paying authority is legally required under Ministry of Finance instructions to release 100% payment within 10 calendar days. Delays beyond this attract statutory penal interest of 1% per month on the overdue amount payable directly to the seller.

hi.short_answer: GeM पर माल की डिलीवरी के 10 दिनों के भीतर कंसाइनी को CRAC (स्वीकृति प्रमाण पत्र) जारी करना होता है, और CRAC बनने के 10 दिनों के भीतर विक्रेता को भुगतान करना अनिवार्य है।
hi.detailed_answer: GeM के नियमों के अनुसार 10 दिनों में माल का निरीक्षण कर CRAC जारी किया जाता है। यदि खरीदार 10 दिनों में कोई कार्रवाई नहीं करता, तो पोर्टल ऑटो-सीआरएसी (Auto-CRAC) बना देता है। CRAC जारी होने के 10 दिनों के भीतर भुगतान न करने पर खरीदार पर 1% प्रति माह की दर से दंडात्मक ब्याज लगता है।

hinglish.short_answer: GeM par delivery ke baad buyer ko 10 din ke andar CRAC generate karna hota hai, aur CRAC aane ke 10 calendar days ke andar seller ka payment release karna mandatory hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Buyer ko 10 din me inspection karke CRAC dena padta hai, warna system Auto-CRAC generate kar deta hai. CRAC generate hone ke baad 10 days me payment na karne par buyer par 1% per month penal interest lagta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: CRAC must be generated within 10 days of delivery, and payment released within 10 days of CRAC generation.
supporting_claims.citation_source: GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC) Clause on Payment Terms & OM F.6/18/2019-PPD

source_title: GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC) & Timely Payment Mandate
source_publisher: GeM SPV & Department of Expenditure
reviewer_notes: Penal interest mechanism was instituted to eliminate MSME working capital blockages.

canonical_question: How does the GeM Incident Management Policy 2025 handle buyer and seller complaints, Show Cause Notices, and moratorium penalties?
alternate_phrasings: What is the severity grading (Mild, Serious, Severe, Grave) for incidents on GeM?
GeM portal par incident raise hone par account block hone se kaise bache?
How to appeal against an administrative suspension on the GeM Incident dashboard?
short_answer: The GeM Incident Management Policy provides an automated digital dispute framework where logged incidents trigger automated Show Cause Notices (SCNs) with 5 to 7 days to respond, failing which graded moratoriums (suspensions) are imposed.
detailed_answer: Under GeM's updated Incident Management Policy, buyers or sellers can log incidents regarding catalog misdeclarations, bid deviations, non-delivery, payment delays, or counterfeit goods. Upon incident creation: 1) An automated Show Cause Notice (SCN) is dispatched to the defaulting party, allowing 5 days (extendable to 7 days) to submit a formal defense; 2) If the explanation is rejected or not provided, an incident manager assigns penalty points; 3) Graded moratoriums are triggered: Level 1 suspension (temporary disablement from bidding for 30 to 90 days), up to de-registration and permanent blacklisting across GeM for severe fraudulent defaults.

hi.short_answer: GeM की इंसिडेंट मैनेजमेंट पॉलिसी एक पारदर्शी विवाद समाधान प्रणाली है, जिसके तहत शिकायत दर्ज होने पर 5-7 दिनों का कारण बताओ नोटिस (SCN) जारी होता है, और संतोषजनक जवाब न मिलने पर खाता निलंबित (Moratorium) कर दिया जाता है।
hi.detailed_answer: भुगतान में देरी, घटिया सामान या गैर-डिलीवरी पर पोर्टल पर इंसिडेंट दर्ज होता है। संबंधित पक्ष को 5 दिनों में जवाब देना होता है। उल्लंघन की गंभीरता के आधार पर 30 दिन से 90 दिन का बोली प्रतिबंध या स्थायी डी-रजिस्ट्रेशन (काली सूची) की सजा दी जाती है।

hinglish.short_answer: GeM Incident Management Policy ke tehat complaint create hone par 5 se 7 days ka automated Show Cause Notice (SCN) milta hai, aur default prove hone par bidding moratorium (suspension) lagti hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Catalog deviation ya payment delay par incident raise hota hai. Defaulter ko 5-7 din me reply submit karna padta hai. Proper reply na dene par account par temporary moratorium (30-90 days) ya permanent de-registration impose ho jata hai.

supporting_claims.claim: GeM Incident Management Policy enforces standardized SCNs with 5-7 day response windows and tiered moratorium penalties.
supporting_claims.citation_source: GeM Incident Management Policy Document & Standard Operating Procedure

source_title: Government e-Marketplace Incident Management Policy & SOP
source_publisher: Government e-Marketplace (GeM SPV)
reviewer_notes: Applies symmetrically to both sellers (for quality/delivery defaults) and buyers (for deliberate payment stalling).

canonical_question: What is the statutory 25% annual procurement mandate from MSEs by Central Ministries and CPSEs under Public Procurement Policy 2012?
alternate_phrasings: Are government departments mandated to procure at least 25% of annual purchases from micro and small enterprises?
Central government tenders me MSEs ke liye 25% quota kya hai?
How is Sambandh portal used to monitor CPSE procurement from MSEs?
short_answer: The Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order 2012 legally mandates that every Central Ministry, Department, and Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) must procure a minimum of 25% of their total annual procurement value from Micro and Small Enterprises.
detailed_answer: Notified under Section 11 of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (MSMED) Act, 2006, the Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order, 2012 (amended in 2018) makes it compulsory for all central government procuring entities to achieve at least 25% annual procurement from MSEs. Entities must publish their annual procurement plans, list items exclusively reserved for MSE manufacturing (358 reserved items), and submit quarterly compliance reports on the MSME Sambandh monitoring portal. Non-compliance is audited and presented before Parliamentary standing committees.

hi.short_answer: सार्वजनिक खरीद नीति 2012 के तहत प्रत्येक केंद्रीय मंत्रालय, विभाग और केंद्रीय सार्वजनिक उपक्रम (CPSE) के लिए अपनी कुल वार्षिक खरीद का न्यूनतम 25% सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यमों (MSEs) से करना कानूनी रूप से अनिवार्य है।
hi.detailed_answer: MSMED अधिनियम 2006 की धारा 11 के तहत यह आदेश सभी केंद्रीय खरीदारों पर लागू है। इसमें 358 वस्तुएं विशेष रूप से MSEs के लिए आरक्षित हैं। मंत्रालयों की इस खरीद की वास्तविक स्थिति को 'एमएसएमई संबंध' (MSME Sambandh) पोर्टल पर सार्वजनिक रूप से ट्रैक किया जाता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Public Procurement Policy 2012 ke mutabiq har Central Ministry aur CPSE ko apne total annual procurement ka minimum 25% MSEs se procure karna statutory mandate hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Section 11 MSMED Act 2006 ke tehat 25% procurement MSEs se compulsory hai. Is compliance ko MSME Sambandh portal par monitor kiya jata hai jisme 358 items exclusive MSE reservation list me hain.

supporting_claims.claim: Central Ministries and CPSEs must achieve a minimum of 25% annual procurement from Micro and Small Enterprises.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 (Gazette Notification S.O. 581(E))

source_title: Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 & Amendments
source_publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
reviewer_notes: Live department procurement fulfillment percentages are published publicly on sambandh.msme.gov.in.

canonical_question: What are the specific sub-targets reserved for SC/ST-owned MSEs (4%) and Women-owned MSEs (3%) in government tenders?
alternate_phrasings: Is there a 4% quota for SC/ST entrepreneurs and 3% quota for women MSEs in public procurement?
Tender me SC ST aur Women MSE ke liye alag reservation hota hai kya?
How can women-owned MSEs prove eligible ownership criteria on GeM?
short_answer: Within the overall 25% MSE procurement mandate, 4% is statutory earmarked for procurement from MSEs owned by Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) entrepreneurs, and 3% is earmarked for MSEs owned by Women entrepreneurs.
detailed_answer: Under the amended Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order 2012: 1) SC/ST MSE Sub-target: A minimum of 4% out of the 25% target must be procured from enterprises owned by SC/ST entrepreneurs (where an SC/ST individual holds 100% of a proprietorship or at least 51% equity in a partnership/private company); 2) Women MSE Sub-target: A minimum of 3% out of the 25% target must be procured from enterprises owned by Women entrepreneurs (holding at least 51% stake). If these sub-targets cannot be fulfilled due to lack of participating bidders, the shortfall cannot be diverted to general large suppliers without recorded justification.

hi.short_answer: कुल 25% MSE खरीद लक्ष्य के भीतर, 4% खरीद अनुसूचित जाति/अनुसूचित जनजाति (SC/ST) उद्यमियों के स्वामित्व वाले उद्यमों के लिए और 3% महिला उद्यमियों के स्वामित्व वाले उद्यमों के लिए आरक्षित है।
hi.detailed_answer: संशोधित सार्वजनिक खरीद नीति के तहत SC/ST उद्यमियों के लिए 4% और महिला उद्यमियों के लिए 3% का अनिवार्य उप-लक्ष्य है। इसके लिए उद्यम पंजीकरण में मालिक का SC/ST वर्ग या महिला होना और उद्यम में कम से कम 51% हिस्सेदारी होना आवश्यक है।

hinglish.short_answer: Overall 25% MSE procurement mandate ke andar 4% SC/ST owned enterprises ke liye aur 3% Women entrepreneurs ke liye specially reserved sub-target hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Government guidelines ke tehat 25% quota me se 4% SC/ST MSEs aur 3% Women MSEs ke liye earmarked hai. Entity me SC/ST ya woman entrepreneur ka minimum 51% equity holding hona mandatory hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Out of 25% annual MSE procurement, 4% is reserved for SC/ST-owned MSEs and 3% for Women-owned MSEs.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of MSME Gazette Notification S.O. 5621(E) & Public Procurement Policy Order

source_title: Reservation Sub-targets under Public Procurement Policy for MSEs
source_publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
reviewer_notes: Tracked at central level by the National SC/ST Hub (NSSH) and MSME Sambandh.

canonical_question: What is the two-cover system in government tendering and why are technical and financial bids opened sequentially?
alternate_phrasings: How does two envelope bidding work on Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP)?
Tender me technical bid aur financial bid alag alag kyu jama hoti hain?
What happens if price details are accidentally disclosed in the technical cover document?
short_answer: The two-cover (two-envelope) system segregates bid submission into a Technical Cover and a Financial Cover, ensuring that financial bids are evaluated only after technical qualifications are fully validated, preventing commercial bias.
detailed_answer: Under Rule 163 of GFR 2017, government tenders exceeding specified complexity or value are conducted using the Two-Cover System: 1) Cover 1 (Technical Bid): Contains bidder eligibility credentials, technical compliance sheets, OEM authorizations, past experience, audited balance sheets, and EMD/exemption declarations. The technical evaluation committee reviews these independently; 2) Cover 2 (Financial Bid / BOQ): Contains unit prices and total commercial quotes. The financial cover remains cryptographically sealed and locked in the portal vault. Only bids that achieve full technical qualification have their Cover 2 opened; disqualified technical bids are returned unopened or rejected digitally, ensuring price quotes cannot prejudice technical evaluations.

hi.short_answer: दो-कवर प्रणाली में निविदा को तकनीकी कवर और वित्तीय कवर में विभाजित किया जाता है, जिससे यह सुनिश्चित होता है कि वित्तीय बोलियां केवल तकनीकी रूप से योग्य बोलीदाताओं की ही खोली जाएं।
hi.detailed_answer: GFR नियम 163 के तहत पहले कवर (तकनीकी बोली) में पात्रता, अनुभव और गुणवत्ता का निष्पक्ष मूल्यांकन किया जाता है। वित्तीय बोली (BOQ) डिजिटल रूप से एन्क्रिप्ट रहती है। तकनीकी रूप से अयोग्य पाए गए बोलीदाताओं की वित्तीय बोली कभी नहीं खोली जाती, जिससे किसी भी प्रकार के पक्षपात को रोका जा सके।

hinglish.short_answer: Two-cover system me Technical Bid aur Financial Bid (BOQ) alag-alag submit hoti hain, taaki price evaluation sirf technically qualified bidders ka hi ho aur bias avoid ho sake.
hinglish.detailed_answer: GFR Rule 163 ke mutabiq Cover 1 me technical credentials check hote hain. Cover 2 (Financial quote) securely locked rehta hai. Jab Technical Evaluation Committee Cover 1 pass karti hai, tabhi Cover 2 open hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Two-cover system requires sequential opening: technical evaluation occurs first; financial bids are opened only for technically responsive bidders.
supporting_claims.citation_source: General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, Rule 163 & Manual for Procurement of Goods

source_title: General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, Rule 163: Two Bid System
source_publisher: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Universal standard across CPPP, IREPS, DefProc, and State e-procurement portals.

canonical_question: What are the most common technical errors and compliance failures that cause technical bid rejection on CPPP?
alternate_phrasings: Why was my technical bid rejected in e-tendering?
CPPP portal par technical bid reject hone ke mukhya kaaran kya hain?
Does uploading quotation prices in technical cover cause immediate disqualification?
short_answer: The most common causes of technical bid rejection on CPPP are missing or expired DSC signatures, incorrect BOQ format modifications, invalid EMD instruments, expired CA net worth certificates, and failure to upload manufacturer authorization forms.
detailed_answer: Analysis of e-procurement tender audits shows the top reasons for technical disqualification: 1) Altering the structure, formulas, or headers of the official BOQ Excel sheet, causing automated ingestion failure; 2) Submitting general trader Udyam certificates for tenders requiring manufacturing MSE status; 3) Uploading non-compliant EMD bank guarantees lacking mandatory claim period extensions or BG verification codes; 4) Failure to provide documentary proof of meeting similar past work completion criteria; 5) Not submitting the Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) in the exact tender-prescribed format; and 6) Missing signed acceptance of latest tender corrigenda.

hi.short_answer: CPPP पर तकनीकी बोली खारिज होने के प्रमुख कारण BOQ एक्सेल फाइल में अनधिकृत बदलाव, अमान्य EMD दस्तावेज, एक्सपायर्ड सीए प्रमाण पत्र, और निर्माता प्राधिकरण (MAF) फॉर्म का अभाव हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: ई-प्रोक्योरमेंट में बोलियां रद्द होने के मुख्य कारण: BOQ स्प्रेडशीट के फॉर्मूले बदलना, ईएमडी में आवश्यक क्लॉज न होना, निविदा में मांगे गए समान कार्य अनुभव का अधूरा प्रमाण, और नवीनतम शुद्धिपत्र (Corrigendum) पर हस्ताक्षर न करना शामिल हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: CPPP par technical rejection ke sabse common reasons hain: BOQ Excel sheet ke formulas modify karna, invalid EMD, expired CA certificate, aur tender format me OEM authorization na dena.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Technical bid rejection se bachne ke liye bidders ko BOQ structure bilkul nahi chhedna chahiye, Udyam me manufacturing activity check karni chahiye, aur latest corrigendum ko sign karke upload karna zaroori hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Altering BOQ files, incomplete EMD, or unverified experience certificates cause automated and technical bid disqualification.
supporting_claims.citation_source: NIC Central Public Procurement Portal Bidder Rejection Analysis & FAQ

source_title: CPPP Bidder Compliance & Rejection Prevention Guide
source_publisher: National Informatics Centre (NIC) & Department of Expenditure
reviewer_notes: Always upload original system-generated BOQ without unprotecting or modifying formulas.

canonical_question: Why do defence, railways, and major civil tenders require a Class 3 Combo (Signing plus Encryption) Digital Signature Certificate?
alternate_phrasings: What is the difference between signing-only and combo signing-encryption DSC for e-procurement?
Tender bharne ke liye Class 3 Signing aur Encryption DSC kyu zaroori hota hai?
How does document encryption protect financial bid secrecy before commercial bid opening?
short_answer: Defence, railways, and civil tenders require a Class 3 Combo DSC because the Signing certificate legally authenticates the bidder's identity on bid documents, while the Encryption certificate secures the financial bid until opening.
detailed_answer: High-value and sensitive tenders hosted on portals such as IREPS (Railways), DefProc (Defence Procurement), and CPPP demand a dual-certificate Class 3 USB token containing both a Signing Key and an Encryption (Key Encipherment) Key. While the Signing certificate creates a cryptographic hash confirming the document has not been altered since submission, the Encryption certificate utilizes the procurement portal's public key infrastructure (PKI) to encipher the bidder's proprietary financial rates. This dual layer protects national infrastructure integrity and proprietary supplier pricing from unauthorized digital interception.

hi.short_answer: रक्षा, रेलवे और प्रमुख नागरिक निविदाओं के लिए क्लास 3 कॉम्बो डीएससी अनिवार्य है क्योंकि 'हस्ताक्षर' (Signing) प्रमाण पत्र बोलीदाता की कानूनी पहचान प्रमाणित करता है और 'एन्क्रिप्शन' प्रमाण पत्र वित्तीय दरों को सुरक्षित रखता है।
hi.detailed_answer: IREPS, DefProc और CPPP पर दोहरी सुरक्षा की आवश्यकता होती है। साइनिंग सर्टिफिकेट यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि दस्तावेज से छेड़छाड़ नहीं हुई है, जबकि एन्क्रिप्शन सर्टिफिकेट वित्तीय बोली (BOQ) को डिजिटल लॉक करता है ताकि कोई भी अधिकृत समय से पहले बोली की कीमत न जान सके।

hinglish.short_answer: Defence, Railways aur civil tenders me Class 3 Combo DSC zaroori hai kyunki Signing certificate bidder identity verify karta hai aur Encryption certificate financial bid ko securely lock karta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: IREPS aur DefProc par dual-key DSC lagta hai. Signing key bid submission ko legal binding banati hai aur Encryption key financial rates ko cryptographically encipher karti hai taaki opening date se pehle rates confidential rahein.

supporting_claims.claim: High-security e-tenders mandate Class 3 Combo DSC containing both digital signature and key encipherment certificates.
supporting_claims.citation_source: IREPS & DefProc DSC Specifications, Ministry of Railways & Ministry of Defence

source_title: IREPS & DefProc Digital Signature Guidelines
source_publisher: Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS) & Ministry of Defence
reviewer_notes: Single signing-only DSC will fail at the stage of commercial bid encryption on IREPS and DefProc.

canonical_question: What is the standard percentage for Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) and what is its mandatory validity period under GFR 2017?
alternate_phrasings: Is Performance Security 3% to 5% of contract value and valid for 60 days beyond completion?
Government tender me Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) kitne percent lagti hai?
Can an MSE get exemption from Performance Security or only EMD?
short_answer: Under Rule 171 of GFR 2017, the standard Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG / Performance Security) is 5% to 10% of the total contract value (temporarily lowered to 3% during COVID reliefs and restored to 5-10%), valid for 60 days beyond all contractual warranty obligations.
detailed_answer: Rule 171 of General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017 mandates that successful bidders must furnish Performance Security to guarantee faithful execution of the contract. The standard statutory range is between 5% and 10% of the total awarded contract value. The PBG must remain legally valid for an additional period of 60 days beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations, including comprehensive warranty, defect liability, and Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) commitments. The security can be furnished via Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt pledged to the authority, Bank Guarantee, or online bank transfer.

hi.short_answer: GFR 2017 के नियम 171 के तहत परफॉर्मेंस बैंक गारंटी (PBG) कुल अनुबंध मूल्य का 5% से 10% होती है, जो सभी अनुबंध और वारंटी दायित्वों के पूरा होने के बाद 60 दिनों तक वैध रहनी चाहिए।
hi.detailed_answer: सफल बोलीदाता को अनुबंध निष्पादन की गारंटी के रूप में अनुबंध मूल्य का 5% से 10% PBG के रूप में जमा करना होता है। इसकी वैधता वारंटी और डिफेक्ट लायबिलिटी पीरियड पूरा होने के 60 दिन बाद तक होनी अनिवार्य है। कार्य संतोषजनक ढंग से पूरा होने पर यह राशि वापस कर दी जाती है।

hinglish.short_answer: GFR 2017 Rule 171 ke mutabiq Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) total contract value ka 5% se 10% hoti hai, aur yeh warranty khatam hone ke 60 din baad tak valid honi chahiye.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Successful contractor ko 5% to 10% PBG deni hoti hai. Iska mandatory validity period contract ke saare completion obligations aur warranty period ke 60 days baad tak hota hai. Satisfactory completion ke baad PBG release hoti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Performance Security is 5% to 10% of contract value and must remain valid for 60 days beyond completion of all contractual and warranty obligations.
supporting_claims.citation_source: General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, Rule 171 & Department of Expenditure Procurement Manual

source_title: General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, Rule 171: Performance Security
source_publisher: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: The COVID-era 3% concession ended on 31 March 2023; standard 5-10% regime is currently operative.

canonical_question: What are the mandatory registration prerequisites and vendor approval procedures on Indian Railways IREPS portal?
alternate_phrasings: How to participate in Indian Railway e-tenders on ireps.gov.in?
Railway IREPS portal par vendor registration kaise kare?
Is RDSO approval mandatory for participating in specialized railway component tenders?
short_answer: To bid on the Indian Railways IREPS portal (ireps.gov.in), vendors must possess a valid Class 3 Combo DSC, an active IREPS vendor user account, and specialized vendor approval from RDSO or railway production units for safety and critical items.
detailed_answer: The Indian Railways E-Procurement System (IREPS) is operated by the Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS). Registration requires: 1) A Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate with both signing and encryption keys; 2) Vendor registration on ireps.gov.in with company PAN, GSTIN, and bank verification; 3) For specialized, safety, or critical railway components (track fittings, signaling, rolling stock spares), vendors must secure pre-qualification or Developmental/Approved Vendor status from the Research Designs and Standards Organisation (RDSO) or relevant Production Units (e.g., BLW, ICF, CLW) via the Unified Vendor Approval Module (UVAM). Non-safety standard items are open to general registered commercial bidders.

hi.short_answer: भारतीय रेलवे IREPS पोर्टल पर बोली लगाने के लिए विक्रेताओं के पास क्लास 3 कॉम्बो डीएससी, IREPS खाता, और सुरक्षा व महत्वपूर्ण वस्तुओं के लिए आरडीएसओ (RDSO) से विक्रेता अनुमोदन अनिवार्य है।
hi.detailed_answer: रेलवे सूचना प्रणाली केंद्र (CRIS) द्वारा संचालित IREPS पर पंजीकरण के लिए पैन, जीएसटी और क्लास 3 साइनिंग व एन्क्रिप्शन डीएससी चाहिए। रेलवे के सुरक्षा और सिग्नलिंग घटकों के लिए RDSO के एकीकृत विक्रेता अनुमोदन मॉड्यूल (UVAM) से पूर्व-अनुमोदन लेना आवश्यक होता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Indian Railways IREPS portal par bidding ke liye Class 3 Combo DSC, valid IREPS vendor profile, aur safety items ke liye RDSO/UVAM vendor approval zaroori hota hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: CRIS dwara managed IREPS par bid karne ke liye GSTIN, PAN aur dual-key DSC chahiye. Safety aur critical rolling stock items supply karne ke liye RDSO UVAM portal se approved vendor status hona compulsory hai.

supporting_claims.claim: IREPS requires Class 3 Combo DSC and RDSO/UVAM pre-approval for critical and safety railway components.
supporting_claims.citation_source: IREPS User Manual for Vendors & RDSO Vendor Approval Guidelines

source_title: Indian Railways E-Procurement System (IREPS) Vendor Registration & UVAM Manual
source_publisher: Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS) & RDSO, Ministry of Railways
reviewer_notes: UVAM (Unified Vendor Approval Module) digitizes all zonal railway vendor approvals onto a single window.

canonical_question: How do vendors obtain security clearance and register to bid on Defence Public Procurement portals (DefProc)?
alternate_phrasings: What are the security vetting requirements for military and ordnance factory tenders?
Defence tender DefProc portal par registration karne ke niyam kya hain?
Can foreign owned companies bid on classified defence procurement tenders?
short_answer: To bid on Defence Public Procurement portals (defproc.gov.in), vendors must register with a Class 3 Combo DSC, complete statutory company profile verification, and undergo mandatory security vetting and industrial license clearance for classified defence equipment.
detailed_answer: The Defence e-Procurement Portal (defproc.gov.in), hosted on the NIC e-procurement platform for the Ministry of Defence, covers procurement across the Army, Navy, Air Force, Coast Guard, and Ordnance/DPSUs. Registration involves: 1) Enrolling with a valid Class 3 Signing and Encryption DSC; 2) Submitting incorporation documents, GSTIN, PAN, and technical manufacturing facility profiles; 3) For classified, weapon, ordnance, or restricted defense equipment, obtaining an Industrial Defence License from DPIIT and security clearance/vetting from the Department of Defence Production (DDP) and Ministry of Home Affairs. Unclassified commercial supplies (rations, uniforms, general hardware) require standard commercial compliance without defense security vetting.

hi.short_answer: रक्षा ई-खरीद पोर्टल (defproc.gov.in) पर बोली लगाने के लिए विक्रेताओं को क्लास 3 कॉम्बो डीएससी से पंजीकरण करना होता है, और वर्गीकृत रक्षा उपकरणों के लिए डीपीआईआईटी और गृह मंत्रालय से सुरक्षा मंजूरी लेनी होती है।
hi.detailed_answer: रक्षा मंत्रालय के defproc पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण के लिए पैन, जीएसटी और क्लास 3 साइनिंग व एन्क्रिप्शन डीएससी आवश्यक है। सैन्य और गोला-बारूद की आपूर्ति के लिए रक्षा उत्पादन विभाग (DDP) और गृह मंत्रालय से सुरक्षा सत्यापन (Security Clearance) और औद्योगिक रक्षा लाइसेंस प्राप्त करना अनिवार्य होता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Defence Public Procurement (defproc.gov.in) par bid karne ke liye Class 3 Combo DSC zaroori hai, aur classified defence items ke liye DPIIT industrial license aur MHA security clearance chahiye.
hinglish.detailed_answer: DefProc portal par Army, Navy aur Air Force tenders hote hain. General non-lethal supplies ke liye standard registration chalta hai, lekin arms aur tactical equipment ke liye Department of Defence Production se security vetting mandatory hoti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: DefProc requires Class 3 Combo DSC, with security vetting and DPIIT industrial defense license for classified equipment.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) & DefProc Portal Bidder Guidelines

source_title: Defence e-Procurement Portal Guidelines & Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP)
source_publisher: Ministry of Defence & National Informatics Centre (NIC)
reviewer_notes: Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) governs capital acquisitions; DefProc primarily handles revenue procurement.

canonical_question: How does the Shyamala Gopinath Committee formula link small savings interest rate revisions to benchmark G-Sec yields?
alternate_phrasings: What formula does the Ministry of Finance use to reset PPF and small savings rates every quarter?
Government post office byaj dar kis formula se tay karti hai?
Why does government keep PPF interest at 7.1% despite higher formula benchmark rates?
short_answer: The Shyamala Gopinath Committee formula links small savings scheme interest rates to the secondary market yields of central government securities (G-Secs) of comparable residual maturities, calculated over a preceding reference observation period.
detailed_answer: In 2011, the Shyamala Gopinath Committee appointed by the Reserve Bank of India recommended linking administered small savings interest rates dynamically to market yields on Government of India securities (G-Secs). Under the formula: 1) A reference basket of G-Sec yields of matching tenures (e.g., 5-year G-Sec for NSC, 10-year G-Sec for PPF) is tracked over the preceding quarter/three months; 2) Pre-defined spreads (ranging from 0 bps to 100 bps) are added to the benchmark G-Sec yield; 3) The Ministry of Finance evaluates this mathematical output when setting quarterly rates, balancing monetary transmission against the social welfare objective of protecting retail savers.

hi.short_answer: श्यामला गोपीनाथ समिति का फॉर्मूला लघु बचत योजनाओं की ब्याज दरों को समान परिपक्वता वाली केंद्र सरकार की प्रतिभूतियों (G-Sec) के द्वितीयक बाजार प्रतिफल (Yield) से जोड़ता है।
hi.detailed_answer: आरबीआई द्वारा गठित श्यामला गोपीनाथ समिति की सिफारिशों के अनुसार, पिछली तिमाही के दौरान सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों (G-Secs) के औसत प्रतिफल के आधार पर आधार दर तय की जाती है, और उसमें योजना-विशिष्ट वैधानिक स्प्रेड (0 से 100 आधार अंक) जोड़कर त्रैमासिक ब्याज दरें निर्धारित की जाती हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Shyamala Gopinath Committee formula small savings interest rates ko matching maturity wale Government Securities (G-Sec) yields ke secondary market average se link karta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Is formula ke tehat pichle 3 months ke average G-Sec yields track hote hain. Un yields me statutory spread (jaise PPF me +25 bps, SCSS me +100 bps) add karke Ministry of Finance quarterly rate determine karti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Small savings rates are linked to secondary market yields of comparable G-Secs with statutory scheme spreads.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Report of the Committee on Comprehensive Review of National Small Savings Fund (Shyamala Gopinath Committee, 2011)

source_title: Report of the Committee on Comprehensive Review of National Small Savings Fund
source_publisher: Reserve Bank of India & Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Government formally operationalized the quarterly revision mechanism in February 2016.

canonical_question: What are the statutory spreads added over benchmark G-Sec yields for PPF (25 bps), SSY (75 bps), and SCSS (100 bps)?
alternate_phrasings: Why does Sukanya Samriddhi get 75 basis points extra interest over government bond yields?
SCSS aur PPF par G-Sec yield se kitna zyada spread milta hai?
Which small savings schemes have zero spread over benchmark government securities?
short_answer: Under the Shyamala Gopinath formula, the statutory spreads added over comparable benchmark G-Sec yields are: 25 basis points (0.25%) for PPF, 75 basis points (0.75%) for Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY), and 100 basis points (1.00%) for Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS).
detailed_answer: To provide targeted social security incentives, the government established specific positive markups (spreads) over the benchmark government security yields of comparable maturity: 1) PPF: +25 bps (0.25%) over the 10-year G-Sec yield; 2) Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY): +75 bps (0.75%) over the 10-year G-Sec yield, prioritizing girl child welfare; 3) Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS): +100 bps (1.00%) over the 5-year G-Sec yield, recognizing retirement income dependence; 4) 5-Year NSC: +25 bps; 5) Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS): 0 bps (parity with benchmark). While actual notified rates may temporarily diverge based on fiscal discretion, these spreads constitute the formal policy benchmark.

hi.short_answer: श्यामला गोपीनाथ फॉर्मूले के तहत बेंचमार्क जी-सेक प्रतिफल पर वैधानिक स्प्रेड हैं: PPF के लिए 25 आधार अंक (0.25%), सुकन्या समृद्धि के लिए 75 आधार अंक (0.75%), और वरिष्ठ नागरिक योजना (SCSS) के लिए 100 आधार अंक (1.00%)।
hi.detailed_answer: सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों के मुकाबले सामाजिक सुरक्षा योजनाओं को आकर्षक बनाने के लिए यह मार्कअप जोड़ा जाता है: 10-वर्षीय जी-सेक पर PPF के लिए +25 bps और SSY के लिए +75 bps; तथा 5-वर्षीय जी-सेक पर वरिष्ठ नागरिकों (SCSS) के लिए +100 bps (1%) अतिरिक्त ब्याज का वैधानिक फॉर्मूला है।

hinglish.short_answer: Benchmark G-Sec yield par statutory spreads hain: PPF me +25 bps (0.25%), Sukanya Samriddhi me +75 bps (0.75%), aur SCSS me +100 bps (1.00%).
hinglish.detailed_answer: Social security ko protect karne ke liye government matching G-Sec yield par spreads deti hai: 10-year G-sec par PPF (+0.25%) aur SSY (+0.75%), aur 5-year G-Sec par Senior Citizen Savings Scheme ko +1.00% extra markup milta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Statutory spreads over G-Sec yields are 25 bps for PPF, 75 bps for SSY, and 100 bps for SCSS.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance Press Release on Small Savings Scheme Interest Rate Framework (February 2016)

source_title: Framework for Interest Rates on Small Savings Schemes
source_publisher: Ministry of Finance & Press Information Bureau
reviewer_notes: Formulas provide the theoretical target rate; actual declared rates are notified by DEA quarterly.

canonical_question: Are maturity proceeds of PPF and Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana still 100% tax-free under the New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC)?
alternate_phrasings: Is PPF maturity taxable if I choose New Tax Regime without 80C deductions?
New Tax Regime lene par PPF aur Sukanya Samriddhi ke maturity paise par tax lagega kya?
Does Section 10(11) and 10(11A) tax exemption continue under 115BAC?
short_answer: Yes, maturity proceeds and annual accrued interest of both Public Provident Fund (PPF) and Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) remain 100% tax-free under Section 10(11) and Section 10(11A) of the Income Tax Act, even under the New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC).
detailed_answer: Under the New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC of the Income Tax Act, 1961), upfront deposit deductions under Chapter VI-A (such as Section 80C) are disallowed. However, Section 10 exemptions remain fully operational: 1) PPF interest and maturity proceeds are exempt under Section 10(11); 2) Sukanya Samriddhi interest and maturity proceeds are exempt under Section 10(11A). Therefore, taxpayers opting for the New Tax Regime cannot claim the initial ₹1.5 lakh deduction on contributions, but the compounding interest and entire maturity proceeds remain completely exempt from income tax.

hi.short_answer: हाँ, नई कर व्यवस्था (धारा 115BAC) के तहत भी पब्लिक प्रोविडेंट फंड (PPF) और सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना (SSY) का ब्याज और परिपक्वता राशि धारा 10(11) और 10(11A) के तहत 100% कर-मुक्त है।
hi.detailed_answer: नई कर व्यवस्था में केवल धारा 80C के तहत जमा पर मिलने वाली ₹1.5 लाख की छूट नहीं मिलती है। लेकिन धारा 10 के तहत अर्जित ब्याज और परिपक्वता (Maturity) पर मिलने वाला पूरा पैसा पूरी तरह टैक्स-फ्री रहता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Haan, New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC) me bhi PPF aur Sukanya Samriddhi ka interest aur maturity amount Section 10(11) aur 10(11A) ke tehat 100% tax-free rehta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: New Tax Regime me Section 80C deposit deduction nahi milta, lekin Section 10 exemptions intact hain. Isliye PPF aur SSY par earn hone wala annual interest aur final maturity payout bilkul tax-free rehta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Maturity proceeds and interest of PPF and SSY are exempt under Section 10(11) and 10(11A) under both old and new tax regimes.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Income Tax Act, 1961, Section 10(11), Section 10(11A), and Section 115BAC

source_title: Income Tax Act, 1961: Exemptions under Section 10 & Provisions of Section 115BAC
source_publisher: Income Tax Department & Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT)
reviewer_notes: Crucial tax distinction: only Chapter VI-A deductions are removed under Section 115BAC, not Section 10 exemptions.

canonical_question: How does Section 80TTB provide up to ₹50,000 tax deduction on post office and bank savings interest for senior citizens?
alternate_phrasings: Can senior citizens claim ₹50,000 exemption on SCSS and POMIS interest income?
Section 80TTB me senior citizen ko post office byaj par kitni chhoot milti hai?
What is the difference between Section 80TTA and 80TTB for interest income?
short_answer: Under Section 80TTB of the Income Tax Act, a resident senior citizen (aged 60 years or above) can claim a deduction of up to ₹50,000 per financial year on interest income earned from savings accounts, fixed deposits, and recurring deposits in banks or post offices.
detailed_answer: Introduced via Finance Act 2018, Section 80TTB applies exclusively to resident individuals aged 60 or above during the relevant financial year under the Old Tax Regime. The ₹50,000 deduction covers interest earned on: 1) Post Office Savings Accounts; 2) Post Office Time Deposits (POTD); 3) Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS); 4) Bank savings accounts and Fixed Deposits (FDs). Additionally, Section 194A specifies that banks and post offices shall not deduct TDS on interest paid to senior citizens unless aggregate interest exceeds ₹50,000 in a financial year.

hi.short_answer: आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 80TTB के तहत 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिक बैंक और डाकघर की बचत, एफडी और आरडी पर एक वित्तीय वर्ष में ₹50,000 तक की ब्याज आय पर कर कटौती का दावा कर सकते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: पुरानी कर व्यवस्था के तहत वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को बैंकों और डाकघर (SCSS, Time Deposit, बचत खाता) से मिलने वाले कुल ब्याज पर ₹50,000 तक की कटौती मिलती है। धारा 194A के तहत जब तक कुल ब्याज ₹50,000 से अधिक न हो, तब तक टीडीएस भी नहीं काटा जाता।

hinglish.short_answer: Section 80TTB ke tehat resident senior citizens (60+ years) ko bank aur post office interest income par financial year me ₹50,000 tak ka tax deduction milta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Old Tax Regime me Senior Citizens ko SCSS, Post Office Time Deposit aur bank FDs ke interest par ₹50,000 tak deduction milta hai. Section 194A ke tehat ₹50,000 tak ke interest par TDS bhi deduct nahi hota.

supporting_claims.claim: Section 80TTB provides up to ₹50,000 deduction on deposit interest for resident senior citizens.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Income Tax Act, 1961, Section 80TTB & Section 194A

source_title: Income Tax Act, 1961: Section 80TTB Deduction for Senior Citizens
source_publisher: Income Tax Department & Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT)
reviewer_notes: Applies under Old Tax Regime; senior citizens can submit Form 15H to prevent TDS if estimated total income is below taxable threshold.

canonical_question: How can citizens verify viral WhatsApp and YouTube messages regarding fake government subsidy schemes via PIB Fact Check?
alternate_phrasings: How to report fake government loan and subsidy schemes to PIB Fact Check?
PIB Fact Check WhatsApp helpline number par fake scheme check kaise kare?
What are the official contact channels to confirm government financial announcements?
short_answer: Citizens can report and verify suspected fake schemes by sending the viral message, screenshot, or YouTube URL to PIB Fact Check via WhatsApp at +91 8799711259 or by emailing pibfactcheck@gmail.com.
detailed_answer: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check Unit, under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, is the nodal authority for countering misinformation regarding Government of India policies. The verification workflow operates as follows: 1) Save the viral message text, video link, or image; 2) Send it to the verified WhatsApp hotline +91 8799711259 or email pibfactcheck@gmail.com; 3) The PIB team coordinates with the concerned line ministry to confirm whether any such policy or circular exists; 4) PIB publishes public debunks on its official Twitter/X handle (@PIBFactCheck) and on factcheck.pib.gov.in, labeling the claim as FAKE, MISLEADING, or GENUINE.

hi.short_answer: नागरिक संदिग्ध संदेशों, स्क्रीनशॉट या यूट्यूब लिंक को व्हाट्सएप पर +91 8799711259 या ईमेल pibfactcheck@gmail.com पर पीआईबी फैक्ट चेक को भेजकर सत्यापन कर सकते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: सूचना और प्रसारण मंत्रालय के तहत पीआईबी फैक्ट चेक इकाई सरकारी योजनाओं से जुड़े भ्रामक दावों की जांच करती है। नागरिक सामग्री को उनके आधिकारिक नंबर या ईमेल पर भेजते हैं, जिसके बाद संबंधित मंत्रालय से जांच कर पीआईबी अपने पोर्टल और सोशल मीडिया पर स्पष्टीकरण जारी करता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Viral fake schemes ko verify karne ke liye citizens WhatsApp (+91 8799711259) ya email (pibfactcheck@gmail.com) par message forward karke PIB Fact Check se authenticate kar sakte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: PIB Fact Check Unit suspect forwarded messages ko concerned ministry se cross-verify karti hai aur apne official website factcheck.pib.gov.in aur @PIBFactCheck handle par FAKE ya GENUINE alert publish karti hai.

supporting_claims.claim: PIB Fact Check accepts viral media via WhatsApp (+91 8799711259) and email (pibfactcheck@gmail.com).
supporting_claims.citation_source: PIB Fact Check Portal & Ministry of Information and Broadcasting Advisory

canonical_question: What warning signs indicate fraudulent loan and tender portals impersonating central ministries and charging bogus fees?
alternate_phrasings: How to identify fake government portals offering PM loans or subsidy approvals?
Farzi sarkari yojana website ko kaise pehchane?
Why do genuine government portals never use third-party UPI or personal QR codes for fees?
short_answer: Primary warning signs include commercial non-government domain extensions (.com, .org, .in, .xyz), demands for upfront 'registration' or 'approval' fees via personal UPI QR codes, and fake sanction letters issued on copied ministry letterheads.
detailed_answer: Fraudulent portals impersonating schemes like Mudra, PMEGP, or PM Surya Ghar display distinct indicators of fraud: 1) Domain spoofing: The URL does not end in '.gov.in' or '.nic.in' (e.g., using mudraloan-online.com or pmegp-registration.org); 2) Upfront Fee Demands: Official portals (like Udyam and JanSamarth) never charge registration fees or 'file processing charges' upfront; 3) Personal Payment Gateways: Scammers request transfers to private savings accounts or personal UPI VPA handles; 4) WhatsApp-only communication: Fake agents issue forged 'approval certificates' and demand immediate deposit of GST or security amounts before loan disbursement.

hi.short_answer: प्रमुख चेतावनी संकेत हैं: गैर-सरकारी डोमेन (.com, .org, .xyz), व्यक्तिगत यूपीआई क्यूआर कोड के माध्यम से अग्रिम 'पंजीकरण शुल्क' या 'फाइल चार्ज' की मांग, और मंत्रालय के फर्जी लेटरहेड पर जारी पत्र।
hi.detailed_answer: मुद्रा या पीएमईजीपी जैसी योजनाओं के नाम पर ठगी करने वाले पोर्टल: आधिकारिक .gov.in डोमेन के स्थान पर निजी एक्सटेंशन का उपयोग करते हैं; ऋण स्वीकृति से पहले निजी बैंक खातों या यूपीआई पर शुल्क मांगते हैं; और व्हाट्सएप पर फर्जी मंजूरी पत्र भेजते हैं। आधिकारिक सरकारी पंजीकरण पूरी तरह निःशुल्क हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Fraudulent portals ke main red flags hain: Non-government domains (.com/.org), personal UPI par upfront processing fees ki demand, aur fake ministry letterhead par sanction letters.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Real government portals (Udyam, JanSamarth, myScheme) strictly free hain aur .gov.in par host hote hain. Agar koi website processing fee ya security deposit ke naam par UPI payment maang rahi hai to woh 100% scam hai.

supporting_claims.claim: Government portals strictly use .gov.in/.nic.in domains and do not charge upfront fees to personal UPI accounts.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of MSME & Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) Public Advisory

canonical_question: When did the Ministry of Finance officially notify the enhancement of the Mudra loan limit to ₹20 lakh under Budget 2024 announcements?
alternate_phrasings: What is the effective gazette date for ₹20 lakh Mudra loan ceiling implementation?
Budget 2024 me Mudra loan 20 lakh kab se lagu hua hai?
Has CGFMU issued credit guarantee guidelines for Mudra Tarun Plus loans up to ₹20 lakh?
short_answer: The enhancement of the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) loan limit from ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh under the new 'Tarun Plus' category was announced in Union Budget 2024-25 on July 23, 2024, and officially notified by the Department of Financial Services on October 24, 2024.
detailed_answer: During the Union Budget 2024-25 address on July 23, 2024, the Union Finance Minister announced the enhancement of the Mudra loan limit to facilitate growing micro enterprises. On October 24, 2024, the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, formally issued notification no. F.No.27/01/2024-CP creating the new 'Tarun Plus' category. Under Tarun Plus, entrepreneurs who have previously taken a Tarun loan (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh) and successfully repaid it can avail collateral-free credit from ₹10 lakh up to ₹20 lakh, backed by the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU).

hi.short_answer: मुद्रा ऋण की सीमा को ₹10 लाख से बढ़ाकर ₹20 लाख करने की घोषणा केंद्रीय बजट 2024-25 (23 जुलाई 2024) में की गई थी और वित्तीय सेवा विभाग (DFS) ने 24 अक्टूबर 2024 को आधिकारिक अधिसूचना जारी की।
hi.detailed_answer: 24 अक्टूबर 2024 को जारी आधिकारिक आदेश के तहत नई 'तरुण प्लस' (Tarun Plus) श्रेणी बनाई गई। जिन उद्यमियों ने पूर्व में तरुण ऋण (₹5 लाख से ₹10 लाख) का सफलतापूर्वक पुनर्भुगतान किया है, वे अब बिना किसी संपार्श्विक (Collateral) के ₹10 लाख से ₹20 लाख तक का ऋण प्राप्त करने के पात्र हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Mudra loan limit ko ₹10 lakh se badha kar ₹20 lakh karne ka announcement Budget 2024 (23 July 2024) me hua tha aur Department of Financial Services ne 24 October 2024 ko officially notify kiya.
hinglish.detailed_answer: DFS circular ke tehat 'Tarun Plus' category introduce hui. Jin borrowers ne pehle Tarun loan successfully repay kiya hai, unhe CGFMU credit guarantee cover ke sath ₹10 lakh se ₹20 lakh tak ka loan mil sakta hai.

supporting_claims.claim: DFS notified enhancement of Mudra limit to ₹20 lakh under Tarun Plus category on October 24, 2024.
supporting_claims.citation_source: Ministry of Finance (DFS) Notification F.No.27/01/2024-CP & PIB Release

source_title: Enhancement of Credit Limit under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) to ₹20 Lakh
source_publisher: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Eligibility for Tarun Plus strictly requires clean prior repayment history of a Tarun loan.

canonical_question: Where are quarterly Department of Economic Affairs small savings interest rate orders officially uploaded and archived?
alternate_phrasings: How to download official Ministry of Finance gazette notification for PPF and Sukanya interest rates?
DEA interest rate circular kahan se download kare?
Which DEA section administers National Small Savings Fund (NSSF) notifications?
short_answer: Quarterly small savings interest rate orders are officially uploaded and archived on the Department of Economic Affairs (DEA) website (dea.gov.in) under Notifications/Budget Division and on the National Savings Institute portal (nsiindia.gov.in).
detailed_answer: Official small savings interest rate orders are issued as formal Office Memorandums by the Budget Division, Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance, Government of India. The authoritative digital archives are maintained at: 1) dea.gov.in -> Notifications -> Budget Division / Small Savings; 2) nsiindia.gov.in -> Circulars & Orders; and 3) indiapost.gov.in -> Financial Services -> Post Office Savings Schemes. Financial journalists, institutional researchers, and citizens can verify historical rate notifications dating back several decades on these repositories.

hi.short_answer: त्रैमासिक लघु बचत ब्याज दर आदेश आधिकारिक तौर पर आर्थिक मामलों के विभाग (DEA) की वेबसाइट (dea.gov.in) के बजट प्रभाग और राष्ट्रीय बचत संस्थान (nsiindia.gov.in) पर अपलोड और संग्रहीत किए जाते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: वित्त मंत्रालय के आर्थिक मामलों के विभाग द्वारा जारी आधिकारिक कार्यालय ज्ञापन (OM) dea.gov.in पर बजट डिवीजन के तहत, nsiindia.gov.in पर और भारतीय डाक विभाग की वेबसाइट indiapost.gov.in पर सार्वजनिक रूप से उपलब्ध कराए जाते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Quarterly small savings interest rate orders official roop se Department of Economic Affairs (dea.gov.in) aur National Savings Institute (nsiindia.gov.in) par upload aur archive hote hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Ministry of Finance ke Budget Division ke official Office Memorandums (OM) dea.gov.in ke notifications section aur India Post ki website indiapost.gov.in par digitally verify kiye ja sakte hain.

supporting_claims.claim: DEA Budget Division officially publishes and archives all small savings rate orders on dea.gov.in and nsiindia.gov.in.

source_publisher: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
reviewer_notes: Primary statutory source of truth for all small savings rate announcements in India.

canonical_question: How does the 'Know Your Approvals' (KYA) module on National Single Window System (NSWS) identify required central and state business licenses?
alternate_phrasings: What is the KYA smart questionnaire on nsws.gov.in for starting a new factory?
NSWS portal par business shuru karne ke liye approvals kaise search kare?
How many Central and State government clearances does NSWS integrate into single application?
short_answer: The 'Know Your Approvals' (KYA) service on NSWS is an automated diagnostic questionnaire that evaluates an enterprise's industry sector, business activity, location, and investment size to output a complete, personalized list of mandatory central and state licenses.
detailed_answer: Developed under DPIIT and Invest India, the KYA service on nsws.gov.in guides entrepreneurs through an intelligent questionnaire covering: 1) Industry Sector and 3-digit NIC (National Industrial Classification) Code; 2) Proposed Location (State, District, Urban/Rural/Industrial Park); 3) Proposed Capital Investment and Annual Turnover; 4) Number of Employees and Hazardous Substance Usage; 5) Building and Land Construction Requirements. Upon completion, KYA dynamically generates a comprehensive clearance checklist across central ministries (e.g., PESO, FSSAI, MoEFCC) and state departments (e.g., Factory Inspectorate, State Pollution Board, Labour Registration), detailing estimated approval timelines, fees, and application links.

hi.short_answer: राष्ट्रीय सिंगल विंडो सिस्टम (NSWS) पर 'नो योर अप्रूवल्स' (KYA) मॉड्यूल एक स्वचालित प्रश्नावली के माध्यम से उद्यम के उद्योग, स्थान और निवेश आकार का मूल्यांकन करके सभी आवश्यक केंद्रीय और राज्य लाइसेंसों की सूची तैयार करता है।
hi.detailed_answer: डीपीआईआईटी के KYA टूल में निवेशक अपने उद्योग का प्रकार, राज्य, निवेश राशि और कर्मचारियों की संख्या दर्ज करते हैं। सिस्टम तुरंत आवश्यक सभी मंजूरियों (जैसे प्रदूषण बोर्ड, अग्नि शमन एनओसी, एफएसएसएआई, फैक्ट्री लाइसेंस) की सूची, अनुमानित शुल्क और समय-सीमा प्रदर्शित करता है।

hinglish.short_answer: NSWS par 'Know Your Approvals' (KYA) tool ek diagnostic questionnaire hai jo business activity, sector aur investment amount ke hisaab se mandatory central aur state licenses ki tailored list deta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: KYA service me industry type, NIC code aur factory location daalne par automated clearance checklist generate hoti hai, jisme central ministries (FSSAI, PESO) aur state boards ke clearances ki fees aur timelines clear dikhti hain.

supporting_claims.claim: KYA diagnostic service identifies mandatory central and state clearances dynamically based on business profile.

source_publisher: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) & Invest India
reviewer_notes: Entrepreneurs can use KYA freely without creating an account or logging in.

canonical_question: Can business documents uploaded into the NSWS Document Repository be reused across multiple ministry clearance applications?
alternate_phrasings: How does NSWS Common Registration Form prevent duplicate document submission?
NSWS Document Repository me ek baar upload karne par kya sabhi departments me chalega?
Can investors track the real-time review status of all state and central licenses in one dashboard?
short_answer: Yes, the National Single Window System (NSWS) features a centralized digital Document Repository that allows businesses to upload statutory documents once and reuse them across multiple central and state clearance applications.
detailed_answer: Under the Ease of Doing Business framework, NSWS eliminates repetitive document submissions. Once an investor uploads foundational corporate records into their secure NSWS Document Repository—such as Memorandum of Association (MOA), Articles of Association (AOA), Board Resolutions, PAN, GSTIN, audited financial balance sheets, and land possession deeds—these digital assets can be mapped and attached to multiple clearance applications across different ministries (e.g., Ministry of Environment, Ministry of Commerce, State Single Window) with a single click, eliminating duplicate uploading and redundant document verifications.

hi.short_answer: हाँ, राष्ट्रीय सिंगल विंडो सिस्टम (NSWS) में एक केंद्रीकृत दस्तावेज़ भंडार (Document Repository) है, जिससे एक बार अपलोड किए गए दस्तावेज़ों को कई मंत्रालयों और राज्य विभागों की मंजूरियों में पुनः उपयोग किया जा सकता है।
hi.detailed_answer: NSWS की यह सुविधा व्यवसायों को बार-बार वही कागजात जमा करने से बचाती है। पैन, जीएसटी, एमओए, ऑडिटेड बैलेंस शीट और भूमि विलेख जैसे आवश्यक दस्तावेज रिपोजिटरी में सुरक्षित रहते हैं और विभिन्न विभागीय आवेदनों के साथ सीधे अटैच किए जा सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Haan, NSWS Document Repository me upload kiye gaye company documents (PAN, GST, MOA, Land deeds) multiple central aur state clearance forms me direct reuse ho sakte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Ease of Doing Business initiative ke under NSWS single-upload facility deta hai. Ek baar verify hone ke baad wahi documents different ministries ke licensing portals par autofill aur attach ho jaate hain.

supporting_claims.claim: NSWS Document Repository enables single upload and multi-department reuse of common enterprise documents.
supporting_claims.citation_source: NSWS Standard Operating Procedures & DPIIT Circular on Common Document Repository

source_publisher: DPIIT & Invest India
reviewer_notes: Ensures significant administrative time savings during multi-license greenfield setups.

canonical_question: Does an investor need to register separately on state single window portals if applying for state approvals through NSWS?
alternate_phrasings: Is NSWS login sufficient to apply for state industrial licenses across all 34 states?
NSWS use karne par kya alag se rajya ke single window portal par account banana padega?
Does NSWS alter or bypass existing statutory approval rules of state departments?
short_answer: No, for states integrated with NSWS, an investor does not need to register separately because NSWS provides single sign-on (SSO) and bi-directional API integration with participating state single window systems.
detailed_answer: The National Single Window System (NSWS) was architected to eliminate multiple credentials. For the 30+ states and Union Territories currently onboarded, NSWS shares single sign-on (SSO) authentication and investor profile data via secure API bridges. When an investor fills out the Common Application Form (CAF) on NSWS and initiates a state-level clearance, the application payload and accompanying documents are securely pushed into the state's internal portal (e.g., Nivesh Mitra, MAITRI, Guidance). The investor receives status tracking and final downloadable permits directly within their unified NSWS dashboard without needing a separate state login.

hi.short_answer: नहीं, NSWS से जुड़े राज्यों के लिए निवेशकों को अलग से पंजीकरण करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है, क्योंकि NSWS सिंगल साइन-ऑन (SSO) और राज्य पोर्टलों के साथ सीधे एपीआई एकीकरण की सुविधा देता है।
hi.detailed_answer: 30 से अधिक राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों के सिंगल विंडो पोर्टल अब NSWS से सीधे जुड़े हुए हैं। निवेशक NSWS के साझा आवेदन पत्र (CAF) के माध्यम से राज्य की मंजूरियों के लिए आवेदन करते हैं, और सारा डेटा स्वतः राज्य प्रणाली में स्थानांतरित हो जाता है।

hinglish.short_answer: Nahi, integrated states ke liye separate registration nahi chahiye kyunki NSWS Single Sign-On (SSO) aur API integration ke through data directly state portal ko pass kar deta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: NSWS dashboard se hi investor state approvals ke liye apply kar sakta hai. System Common Application Form (CAF) ke through state systems me request submit karta hai aur status NSWS dashboard par track hota hai.

supporting_claims.claim: NSWS provides single sign-on integration with state single window portals eliminating duplicate registrations.

canonical_question: Why is official Udyam Registration completely free of cost and how can MSMEs avoid fraudulent third-party charging websites?
alternate_phrasings: Does government charge any official fee for MSME Udyam certificate registration?
Udyam registration free me udyamregistration.gov.in par kaise kare?
What is the official advisory against fake commercial websites charging ₹1,500 for Udyam certificate?
short_answer: Official Udyam Registration (udyamregistration.gov.in) is statutorily 100% free of cost with zero government fees; MSMEs can avoid fraud by checking that the website strictly ends with .gov.in and never paying private agency fees.
detailed_answer: Under Ministry of MSME Notification S.O. 2119(E) dated June 26, 2020, registering a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise on the official Udyam portal is completely paperless and free of cost. The government does not charge any processing fee, stamp duty, or facilitation charge. Fraudulent third-party portals operating under domains like udyamregister.org, udyam-portal.com, or msme-certificate.in trick business owners by charging between ₹500 and ₹3,500 under the pretext of 'consulting fees'. MSMEs should register exclusively at udyamregistration.gov.in using Aadhaar, PAN, and GSTIN without paying any money.

hi.short_answer: आधिकारिक उद्यम पंजीकरण (udyamregistration.gov.in) सरकारी नियमों के तहत पूरी तरह निःशुल्क है। एमएसएमई को यह ध्यान रखना चाहिए कि वेबसाइट .gov.in पर ही समाप्त हो और किसी भी निजी एजेंट को शुल्क न दें।
hi.detailed_answer: एमएसएमई मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना के अनुसार उद्यम पंजीकरण पूरी तरह मुफ्त और पेपरलेस है। .org या .com जैसी निजी वेबसाइटें 'फाइलिंग शुल्क' के नाम पर ₹500 से ₹3,500 वसूलती हैं जो कि पूरी तरह अनधिकृत हैं। नागरिकों को केवल आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टल पर आधार और पैन से पंजीकरण करना चाहिए।

hinglish.short_answer: Official Udyam Registration (udyamregistration.gov.in) 100% free hai. Private websites jo ₹500 se ₹3,000 charge karti hain unse bachein aur strictly .gov.in domain use karein.
hinglish.detailed_answer: Government of India Udyam certificate ke liye zero fee leti hai. Agar koi website registration fee maang rahi hai to woh private third-party agency hai. Directly udyamregistration.gov.in par jakar Aadhaar OTP se free me register karein.

canonical_question: How does the National Portal of India (india.gov.in) structure citizen service directories across central ministries and states?
alternate_phrasings: What services are available on india.gov.in National Portal of India?
National Portal india.gov.in par sarkari services kaise khoje?
How to access government gazette and directory of ministers on National Portal?
short_answer: The National Portal of India (india.gov.in) organizes citizen services through a centralized metadata taxonomy structured by life stages, user categories, sector themes, and state-wise e-governance service directories.
detailed_answer: Maintained by the National Informatics Centre (NIC) under MeitY, india.gov.in serves as the apex digital single window to the Government of India. The platform structures public services using: 1) Services Directory: Cataloging thousands of online citizen services categorized by function (Certificates, Licences, Bill Payments, Land Records, Pensions); 2) My Government Section: Providing constitutional information, Acts, Rules, Schemes, and directory listings of all Union Ministries and State Departments; 3) Sector Portals: Dedicated focal points for Agriculture, Healthcare, Education, and Commerce; 4) State Portals Linkage: Mapping state-specific administrative portals and district administration websites across India.

hi.short_answer: भारत का राष्ट्रीय पोर्टल (india.gov.in) नागरिक सेवाओं को जीवन के चरणों, उपयोगकर्ता श्रेणियों, विषयगत क्षेत्रों और राज्य-वार ऑनलाइन सेवा निर्देशिकाओं में व्यवस्थित करता है।
hi.detailed_answer: एनआईसी द्वारा संचालित यह पोर्टल देश भर की सरकारी सेवाओं का मुख्य प्रवेश द्वार है। इसमें जन्म प्रमाण पत्र, भूमि रिकॉर्ड, पेंशन और ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस जैसी सेवाओं को विषय और राज्य के अनुसार वर्गीकृत किया गया है, साथ ही सभी मंत्रालयों के संपर्क और अधिनियम उपलब्ध कराए गए हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: National Portal of India (india.gov.in) citizen services ko category, sector (Education, Health, Agriculture) aur State-wise service directories me structured format me organize karta hai.
hinglish.detailed_answer: NIC dwara managed india.gov.in portal central aur state government services ka central hub hai. Yahan online certificates, land records, electricity bill payment aur ministry schemes ki authenticated links milti hain.

canonical_question: How can data scientists and researchers access open government datasets and APIs on Open Government Data (data.gov.in)?
alternate_phrasings: How to register for API token on data.gov.in for government scheme statistics?
Data.gov.in se open data aur APIs download kaise kare?
What is the National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) framework?
short_answer: Data scientists and researchers can freely access open datasets and RESTful APIs on data.gov.in by registering an open account, generating an API key, and consuming data in open formats like JSON, XML, and CSV.
detailed_answer: The Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India (data.gov.in), developed under the National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) by NIC and MeitY, publishes proactive public datasets from central and state ministries. Access workflows include: 1) Catalog Browsing: Downloading published datasets in open machine-readable formats (CSV, JSON, XML, XLS, ODS); 2) API Integration: Registered developers can generate a unique API access key from their dashboard to query live datasets programmatically with rate limits; 3) Visualizations and Communities: Accessing community-contributed dashboards, data stories, and analytical models; 4) Dataset Requests: Submitting formal public suggestions for unreleased datasets under NDSAP provisions.

hi.short_answer: डेटा वैज्ञानिक और शोधकर्ता data.gov.in पर निःशुल्क खाता बनाकर, एपीआई कुंजी प्राप्त करके सीएसवी (CSV), जेसन (JSON) और एक्सएमएल (XML) जैसे खुले प्रारूपों में सरकारी डेटासेट डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।
hi.detailed_answer: राष्ट्रीय डेटा शेयरिंग नीति (NDSAP) के तहत संचालित OGD प्लेटफॉर्म विभिन्न मंत्रालयों के सार्वजनिक डेटा को साझा करता है। उपयोगकर्ता सीधे डेटा फाइलें डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं या शोध और अनुप्रयोग विकास के लिए लाइव RESTful APIs का उपयोग कर सकते हैं।

hinglish.short_answer: Data scientists data.gov.in par free account register karke API key generate kar sakte hain aur CSV, JSON ya REST APIs ke through government datasets consume kar sakte hain.
hinglish.detailed_answer: NDSAP policy ke under OGD platform India me central aur state departments ka open data provide hota hai. Researchers open formats (CSV, JSON, XML) me machine-readable data download karke analytics aur research kar sakte hain.
